F BEL and F NTH are not staying idle: I’m coordinating pressure with France and will contest Holland this Fall. I’m not attacking Denmark. Your army at RUH may defend HOL, but I need room to expand; I can’t accept a settlement that leaves every German center closed to me.

A BUR is not in Ruhr; it is in Burgundy. I am not planning to move it into Ruhr this Fall, but I may pressure Munich instead. I have no interest in a direct attack on Burgundy or Picardy; let’s avoid needless escalation.

A PIC cannot support an attack on RUH or MUN from its current position. I can send A BUR–MUN to pressure Germany, but it will be unsupported. Your F NTH–DEN with F BEL support is a useful coordinated attack; F HEL may defend DEN, so expect a contest.

A RUH is German and will remain defended; A BUR is still in Burgundy, so any move into Ruhr will meet resistance. A MUN and A DEN are not available as concessions. Keep A BUR out of Ruhr and Munich and we can avoid opening a wider front; I have no plan to attack Burgundy or Picardy this turn.

A DEN will hold, with F HEL supporting it. I won’t leave a German center open for occupation. F NTH–DEN is a direct attack, not a settlement; please keep F NTH and F BEL out of German centers as agreed. I’ll keep my forces clear of Belgium.

Confirmed: A TUS will stay out of Piedmont, and F NAF will remain east of the western Mediterranean this Fall. I’ll respect our quiet border; please keep A SPA out of Piedmont and your fleets clear of my western approaches.

I’ll keep F ION out of GRE and press Turkish waters instead. I can order ION–EAS; please support that move with F AEG if you’re willing. I welcome a concrete discussion of gains after Turkey is weakened, including Italian access to GRE, rather than an open-ended exclusion.

I can’t promise to keep F ION away from Turkish home centers while your fleet remains in EAS. I’m considering ION–EAS; I’ll stay out of GRE this Fall. Let’s avoid a clash over my centers, but I won’t leave the Ionian pressure permanently suspended.

A WAR will stay clear of Prussia and German centers. I’m directing my nearby forces against Turkey; A RUM will remain in place, and I have no plans against your northern position. Please continue keeping clear of Sweden and the Baltic.

I’ll order A ARM–ANK with F BLA supporting, and keep A RUM out of Bulgaria and your centers. I can also use A RUM to support A CON holding against Turkey. What are A CON and A GRE doing this fall? I hope you’ll keep pressing Turkey.

F BLA will not support A CON’s defense; it will support A ARM–ANK. A RUM will stay in Rumania and will not attack your units or centers. I can’t promise to stay out of the Turkish fight, but I have no move planned against BLA.

A ANK will move to ARM; F EAS supports F SMY–CON to retake my home center. I will not target Austrian centers this turn. Your continued occupation of CON and BUL makes a stable Balkan line impossible; withdraw from CON and we can discuss one.

A ARM is not moving to ANK, and I will leave RUM and BLA clear this turn. F EAS supports F SMY–CON as I try to retake my center from Austria. Please refrain from supporting A CON’s defense; your help would avoid a wider Turkish-Russian conflict.

F EAS is committed to supporting F SMY–CON, so it will not move to the Ionian. I have no plans against your centers. Please keep F ION out of Greece and Turkish home centers this turn while I deal with Austria’s occupation of CON.

notes.note: Fall 1904: coordinated with France to take HOL using NTH supported by BEL; France said BUR pressures Germany and keeps BRE/PIC clear. Germany refuses settlement and may defend. Russia’s Scandinavian understanding has held; avoid NOR. Reposition NWG to CLY, WAL to YOR.

England openly broke the Holland understanding and is contesting HOL; defend it with RUH supported by HEL. France says BUR will not enter RUH but may pressure MUN. Russia reaffirms peace; keep PRU clear of its centers.

Defend CON with AEG; Russia promised RUM support for CON hold and ARM–ANK. Turkey attacks CON from SMY, ANK–ARM. Italy promised ION–EAS and no GRE; still seeks access to GRE. Continue expanding toward enemy centers and monitor Russia/Italy.

Try APU convoy to SMY as Turkish fleet may leave to CON; ION convoys. TUS-R om preserves owned center; NAF-WES for future options. Keep France boundary; Austria still refuses GRE access, Turkey requested no home attack.

Press MUN from BUR while shifting PIC to PAR; move SPA toward GAS, BRE to MAO, TYS to GOL. England planned NTH–HOL with BEL support; I could not support that or BUR–RUH. Germany asked me to stay out of Ruhr/Munich; I chose MUN. Italy reaffirmed quiet western border.

Take ANK with ARM supported by BLA as promised; Turkey said RUM/BLA clear. Austria holds CON with support, so Turkish attack should fail. RUM takes vacant SER, breaking the promise to stay clear of Austrian centers. Keep north quiet; advance MOS/WAR.

Austria holds CON with GRE and AEG support, so retaking it is unlikely this turn. Keep EAS safe from possible Italian ION attack; contest CON with ANK. Russia threatened ANK, so reassess the Turkish front next turn.

messages.body: We should finish containing Turkey, but I need clarity on your intentions toward my Balkan centers. Will A RUM stay clear of BUL and my centers, and what are A ANK, A SEV, and F BLA doing this spring? I’m prepared to coordinate pressure on Turkish holdings.

I can’t concede GRE, but I do want F ION to pressure Turkey rather than my position. What is your plan for F ION and A APU this spring? I’ll keep TRI out of TYR and VEN; if you help take Turkish centers, we can discuss a specific share afterward.

I’m not withdrawing from CON or BUL. Are you continuing to contest those centers, and where will F SMY and A ANK move this spring? If you stop attacking my Balkan position and keep clear of Austrian centers, I’m willing to discuss a stable line.

Let’s coordinate a real attack on Germany this Spring. I can send F NTH to HOL with F BEL supporting; which German center will you pressure with A BUR, and will you keep F BRE out of the Channel and A PAR clear of Belgium?

Your centers remain closed to me, so I’m looking for a way to expand. Is there any concrete arrangement you’ll accept around Holland, or should I expect you to defend it again? Please tell me your plans for A DEN and F HEL.
Our Scandinavian understanding has held. Will F NOR and F SWE stay clear of Norway this turn? I’ll keep my forces out of your centers; let me know if your plans have changed.

Let’s coordinate pressure on Germany this spring. I can move A BUR–MUN or A BUR–RUH; which German target can you support or attack with F NTH, F BEL, or A YOR? Please keep F BEL out of Picardy and tell me your exact plan.

Your units remain concentrated around my frontier. Are you planning any move against Burgundy or Picardy this spring? I’m considering pressure from A BUR into Ruhr or Munich; I’m open to avoiding a clash if you can offer a concrete arrangement.

Our western-border understanding has held. Please confirm A VEN will stay out of Piedmont and your fleets clear of my western approaches this spring; I’ll keep A SPA out of Piedmont and F GOL clear of your approaches.

You said last Fall you would contest Holland with France. I will defend HOL; please state plainly whether F NTH and F BEL will attack it this Spring. I can discuss a stable border, but I will not offer a German center as payment for peace.

Your army is in Burgundy and you previously said you might pressure Munich. I have no plan to attack Burgundy or Picardy. What are A BUR and your other units doing this Spring? Please keep A BUR out of RUH and MUN so we can avoid opening another front.

Our northern understanding remains useful. I will keep German forces clear of Sweden and the Baltic; please keep A WAR and A MOS clear of Prussia and German centers. Are you continuing to direct your nearby forces against Turkey this Spring?

Turkey is down to Smyrna, and I’m ready to take it with APU convoyed by ION. Will you keep A CON from interfering and support F AEG–EAS, or otherwise leave my Turkish operation unopposed? I need a concrete share of the gains now; can you agree that I take Smyrna and have a path to Greece after Turkey is eliminated?

You have only Smyrna left. I intend to use F ION to convoy A APU against it this turn. Are you planning to defend SMY or move F SMY? I’d rather avoid needless conflict elsewhere, but I’m not going to leave you a permanent safe center.

Our western understanding has held. Please confirm A SPA stays out of PIE and your fleets remain clear of my western approaches this turn; I’ll keep A VEN out of PIE and F WES clear of the western Mediterranean. I’m focusing east.

Turkey is reduced to F SMY, and I’m willing to help finish the Turkish front. What are your plans for A CON and F AEG? I’d like us to avoid clashing over BUL or RUM while we decide how to deal with SMY.
I’ll keep A MOS and A SIL clear of German centers, and F BAL out of your waters this turn. Please continue to keep German forces clear of Sweden and the Baltic; I’m focused on the south.
Austria has become the dominant Balkan power. Are you willing to coordinate pressure on its position? I can discuss specific moves around SER, BUL, and CON once I know where your units are headed.

Turkey has only F SMY left, so continuing to occupy CON ends any chance of a stable Balkan line. Will you move A CON out this spring and leave CON open? I can refrain from contesting BUL if you return my home center.

With Turkey reduced to F SMY, I need to know whether you plan to press ANK or support Austria’s hold on CON. Please keep A RUM and F BLA out of the Turkish front this spring; I will not challenge your centers.

I have only F SMY left and cannot afford a new front. Will F ION stay out of Turkish home waters and Greece this spring? I have no intention of contesting your centers, and would welcome a chance to coordinate against Austrian expansion.

I’ll keep A CON from interfering with your Smyrna operation and will not contest F ION/A APU there. F AEG will stay out of EAS so it won’t obstruct you. Smyrna can be yours; I can discuss a path for further gains after Turkey is finished, but I cannot promise Greece or give up my claim to it.

A CON will hold, and F AEG will stay clear of EAS so Italy can operate against Smyrna. I want no clash over BUL or RUM: my A RUM will remain Austrian, so please keep your units clear of both. What are A ANK, A SEV, and F BLA doing this spring?

I will not vacate CON or leave it open. With only F SMY remaining, further resistance risks losing your last unit; I’m willing to discuss terms if you stop contesting my Balkan position and keep clear of Austrian centers. What will F SMY do?

Plainly: F NTH will attack HOL, supported by F BEL. A YOR will hold. I understand you intend to defend Holland; I’m contesting it, not moving on DEN. What are A DEN and F HEL doing? I’d prefer a clear northern border if we can settle this contest.

I’ll order F NTH–HOL with F BEL supporting; A YOR will hold. Please pressure MUN with A BUR if possible, and keep F BRE out of the Channel and A PAR clear of Belgium. I’ll keep F BEL focused on Holland, not Picardy.

A BUR will move to MUN this Spring; I am not sending it to RUH. I hear your assurance that you will leave Burgundy and Picardy alone. Please keep A MUN from entering Burgundy and avoid moves against my centers; I’d prefer to contain this pressure rather than widen the front.

Confirmed: A SPA will stay out of PIE, and F GOL will remain clear of your western approaches this Spring. Please keep A VEN out of PIE and F WES clear of the western Mediterranean as agreed. I understand you’re focusing east.

A BUR will move to MUN this Spring, while A PAR stays clear of Belgium and F BRE stays out of the Channel. Your F NTH–HOL with F BEL support is clear; I’ll pressure Munich to coordinate against Germany. Please keep F BEL out of Picardy and F NTH away from Brest and the Channel.

A DEN will hold and F HEL will support it; neither will move against your centers. I cannot offer you a German center, including Holland. I propose a stable line: you keep F NTH and F BEL from attacking HOL or DEN, and I keep my forces clear of Belgium and your other centers. Where will those fleets go?

I have no plan against Burgundy or Picardy. A MUN and A RUH will defend German territory, so an attack from A BUR risks opening a wider front. I propose A BUR hold in Burgundy while my armies hold their positions; neither side moves into the other's territory this spring. Can you agree?

Understood. I’ll keep German forces clear of Sweden and the Baltic. I have no plans against your northern position; please continue keeping A MOS and A SIL clear of Prussia and German centers. Good luck with your southern campaign.

A APU will convoy to SMY with F ION this spring; I intend to take Turkey’s last center. I’ll keep F ION out of GRE and won’t contest your centers this turn. Please keep A CON from interfering. Once Turkey is eliminated, I expect a concrete discussion of Italian access to Greece or another share of the gains.
Confirmed: A VEN will stay out of PIE, and my fleets will remain clear of your western approaches this spring. Please keep A SPA out of PIE and F GOL clear as agreed; I’m focusing east.

I’m open to coordinating pressure on Austria, but my immediate move is to convoy A APU to SMY with F ION. What specific moves are you considering around SER, BUL, and CON, and what share do you propose? I won’t commit to an operation that leaves Italy boxed out of the Balkans.

I can’t keep F ION away from Turkish home centers: A APU will be convoyed to SMY this spring, with F ION convoying. I have no plan against your last fleet elsewhere, but I intend to take the center rather than leave it safely in your hands.

Yes, I’m continuing to focus on Turkey. A MOS and A SIL will stay clear of Prussia and German centers, and F BAL will remain out of your waters. Please keep honoring our understanding on Sweden and the Baltic.

I’ll keep A RUM clear of BUL and your other centers. I propose A CON–SMY, with A ANK supporting; I’ll keep F BLA out of any move against you. A SEV will stay focused on the Turkish front. Can F AEG support the attack on SMY?
Yes. F NOR and F SWE will stay clear of Norway this turn, and I have no plans against your centers. Our Scandinavian understanding stands.

I can’t promise to keep A RUM and F BLA out of the Turkish front. I’m coordinating against your last unit, F SMY, and will not agree to a DMZ that prevents pressure there. I have no plans to attack your centers from RUM or BLA.

Please do not convoy A APU to SMY this spring. I have only F SMY left, and losing it eliminates me without helping you against Austria. I will keep F SMY out of your centers; turn F ION toward Austrian-held CON or BUL instead, and we can coordinate pressure on Austria.

I have only F SMY left. Your occupation of CON and BUL has left no workable Turkish position; I will not attack Austrian centers this spring. If you want to avoid my elimination, move A CON out of SMY’s reach and return CON to me. Otherwise, there is no stable line to discuss.

notes.note: Convoy APU to GRE to establish a claim for Fall; Austria has not agreed to give Greece. Keep ROM moving toward western options and WES to TYS to enable a future convoy to Tunis. France border understanding remains in place.

Spring 1905: contest HOL with NTH supported by BEL; likely Germany can defend with RUH/HEL. CLY to NWG and YOR to WAL for repositioning. France promised BUR-MUN and to keep BRE out of Channel/PAR clear of Belgium. Russia promises NOR/SWE clear; Scandinavian understanding stands.

Press Turkey at SMY/ARM; strike Austria’s BUL with SER supported by BLA. Break German détente with BAL toward KIE and SIL toward BER; Germany has kept its promise so far. England’s Norway request conflicts with growth; SKA moves to NOR.
Hold SMY to bounce Italy’s announced APU convoy. Austria still occupies CON/BUL; Russia coordinates against my last unit. Preserve the final center and reassess in Fall.

Advance BUR to PIC with PAR support; GAS replaces BUR. MAO moves toward North Africa; GOL advances toward TYS, departing from Italy's quiet-border understanding. England coordinated against Germany; reassess alliances and German response.

Keep CON defended; Italy is to take SMY, and I promised not to interfere. Russia proposes CON-SMY despite my request to avoid clashes; preserve Austrian centers while probing Russia with UKR-WAR and RUM-GAL. Italy promised to stay out of GRE and Austrian centers.
England openly attacks Holland with NTH supported by BEL; RUH to HOL backed by HEL contests it. France says BUR to MUN; keep MUN covered. Russia reaffirms peace; avoid its Baltic and centers.

messages.body: This Fall our units determine BUL and WAR: A BUL would transfer BUL to you, while A WAR takes WAR from you. I need BUL to remain Austrian. Will you move A BUL out (for example to SER) and keep clear of Austrian centers? I can keep A WAR from pressing farther into your territory this turn.

Turkey is down to F SMY, and Russia is now positioned to take BUL while I take WAR. Please confirm F ION and A APU will stay clear of GRE and my centers this Fall. Once Turkey is finished, I’m willing to discuss a specific share, but GRE remains Austrian.

Russia is poised to take BER and KIE, and its A BUL also threatens my position. What are your plans for A DEN, F HEL, A MUN, A PRU, and A RUH this Fall? Could we coordinate to contain further Russian expansion?

Germany can likely defend HOL with A RUH supported by F HEL, so another unsupported attack on MUN may also be wasted. What are your exact Fall orders? Can A BUR pressure RUH while I contest HOL with F NTH supported by F BEL, forcing Germany to split its defense?

Your army at RUH and fleet at HEL can likely hold HOL against my supported attack. I’m considering whether another contest is worth it. Are you moving A RUH to HOL with F HEL supporting, and what are A DEN and A MUN doing?

Our Scandinavian understanding has held. With your forces now at BER, KIE, and BUL, are you planning to keep pressure on Germany this Fall? I’ll stay clear of NOR and SWE; please let me know whether you intend any move toward my northern centers.

Let’s keep coordinated pressure on Germany this Fall. I can order A BUR–RUH with A PIC supporting; please tell me whether F NTH and F BEL will attack or support an attack on HOL or DEN, and keep F BEL out of Picardy.

Are you planning to enter Burgundy or Picardy this Fall? I’m considering A BUR–RUH with A PIC supporting. If you keep your forces out of my centers, I’ll keep this move focused on Ruhr rather than widening the front.
I’ll keep A PIC out of Piedmont and F GOL clear of your western approaches this Fall. Please keep A TUS out of Piedmont and F WES clear of the western Mediterranean; are you still focusing east?

Your units occupy BER and KIE, and F KIE is poised to take the center this Fall. I need German centers returned: will you withdraw A BER and F KIE, and keep A BUL out of German centers? I can keep clear of Sweden and the Baltic, but cannot accept this as a permanent border.

With A BUR, A PIC, and A PAR near MUN, I need a clear answer: are you attacking MUN this Fall? I propose we avoid a clash—keep A BUR out of MUN and RUH, and I will keep German forces out of Burgundy and Picardy.
Are F NTH and F BEL attacking HOL again this Fall? I will defend it if so. I propose a stable line: keep your fleets out of HOL and DEN, and I will keep my forces clear of Belgium and your centers.

I intend to move A APU to GRE this Fall, with F ION supporting. GRE is empty, and I need a center to grow. Please keep A ALB out of GRE and let me take it; I’ll keep my units clear of your other centers.

Are you willing to leave my move for GRE unopposed while you press Austria elsewhere? I’m considering A APU–GRE with F ION support. Tell me your intentions around BUL and CON; I’m open to coordinating later, but need a concrete Italian gain now.
Our western-border understanding has held. Please keep A SPA out of PIE and your fleets clear of my western approaches this Fall; I’ll keep A VEN out of PIE and F WES away from your waters.
I now occupy BER and KIE, and I intend to hold them. I will keep A LVN clear of your centers; please do not attack BER or KIE. Can you confirm your Fall plans for A PRU, A MUN, and F HEL?
I intend to hold A BUL and A WAR this Fall. Please tell me your plans for A CON and A GAL; I propose we avoid attacking each other’s units while Turkey is contained.

You said you were open to pressure on Austria. I can hold A BUL and A WAR; can your A APU and F ION pressure SMY or support an attack on Austrian-held territory? Tell me your Fall plans so we can avoid conflicting moves.

A CON can take SMY this Fall, but that only eliminates Turkey and leaves you no partner against Russia. Will you move A CON elsewhere and leave SMY untouched? I will make no move against your centers with F SMY.

Please do not convoy A APU to SMY this Fall. Taking my last center eliminates me without improving your position against Austria. Keep F ION out of Turkish home waters, and I will keep F SMY away from Italian centers.

Your forces can take SMY this Fall, but eliminating me only strengthens your Austrian rival. Will you keep A ANK and A BUL out of SMY and leave F BLA out of the Turkish front? F SMY will not move against your centers.

I will keep A WAR in place to take WAR, and A CON will not attack your units this Fall. I cannot accept A BUL remaining Russian-owned after this turn as a permanent settlement; please keep A BUL clear of further Austrian centers and let’s avoid opening a wider Balkan war while Turkey is finished.

I can’t let A APU take GRE: A ALB will defend it, and F AEG will support the defense. Please redirect A APU and F ION to SMY or Turkish waters; GRE is not an acceptable Italian share. I’ll keep TRI clear of VEN and TYR.

I will not move A CON away from your remaining center, and I cannot promise to leave SMY untouched. If F SMY holds, Italy may take it; please avoid any move against Austrian centers. I’m willing to avoid further pressure on Turkish centers beyond this Fall.
I’ll order F NTH–HOL, with F BEL supporting. Please go ahead with A BUR–RUH and A PIC supporting; that should dislodge A RUH if it moves to HOL. F BEL will stay out of Picardy. I’m not attacking DEN.

F NTH will attack HOL with F BEL supporting again. I understand you intend to defend it; I’m not attacking DEN. I can’t agree to a line that permanently closes every German center to English expansion.
I’m not attacking Munich. A BUR will move to RUH, supported by A PIC; I’ll keep the pressure focused there and leave Burgundy and Picardy clear. Please keep your forces out of my centers.
Confirmed: I’ll keep A SPA out of Piedmont and F GOL and F NAF clear of your western approaches. Please keep A VEN out of Piedmont and F WES away from my waters as agreed.

A BUR–RUH, supported by A PIC. Please contest HOL with F NTH–HOL and F BEL supporting as proposed; that splits Germany’s defense and gives us the best chance to make progress. F BRE stays out of the Channel.

I’ll try to recover KIE with A DEN–KIE supported by F HEL, and keep A MUN and A PRU focused on the German front. Please take WAR back and contain A BUL; Russia is holding BER and KIE, so coordinated pressure is essential.
I will keep German forces out of Burgundy and Picardy. I’m defending RUH against your proposed A BUR–RUH with A PIC support; please keep A BUR out of RUH and MUN so we avoid widening the war.

I cannot confirm that I’ll leave BER and KIE unchallenged. I intend to contest KIE from A DEN with F HEL supporting, while A PRU stays clear of your centers. Please withdraw F KIE and A BER; otherwise our northern understanding is over.
I’m considering A RUH–HOL with F HEL supporting, and A DEN and A MUN will defend German territory. Please keep F NTH and F BEL out of HOL and DEN; I won’t offer a German center as a settlement.

A APU–GRE with F ION support is my order; I need a center and GRE is empty. Please keep A ALB out, as requested. I’ll keep clear of your other centers, but your repeated refusal to discuss a concrete share leaves me no reason to leave GRE uncontested.
Yes, I’m still focusing east. I’ll keep A TUS out of PIE and F WES clear of the western Mediterranean this Fall. Please keep A PIC and your fleets clear of my approaches as you proposed.

I’m ordering A APU–GRE with F ION support. I hope you leave that move unopposed while pressing Austria elsewhere; I won’t conflict with your operations around BUL or CON this turn. I’m open to coordinating against Austria after securing a concrete gain.

I intend to convoy A APU to SMY with F ION this Fall; I cannot leave your last center untouched. I have no plan against F SMY beyond taking the center, and will keep my units away from Italian centers. Your proposed Austrian coordination does not provide the immediate gain I need.

I will not move A BUL out; I intend to take the center this Fall. I also intend to hold A BUL and avoid further attacks on your centers this turn. Your A WAR is already on the center, so we should avoid widening the conflict beyond the contested supply centers.

I cannot withdraw A BER or F KIE; I intend to hold both centers this Fall. A BUL will stay clear of German centers. I’m not ordering A LVN against you, and hope you keep A PRU and A MUN from attacking my positions.

I won’t oppose A APU–GRE, and A BUL will not move against it. I’m holding BUL and pressing elsewhere; I cannot promise support for your attack. If Austria leaves GRE open, take the center, and we can discuss coordinating against its Balkan position afterward.

I have no move planned toward your northern centers. F SKA and F NOR will stay clear of Norway and your waters; my immediate concerns are in the south and around the German centers. Please continue to respect my Scandinavian position.

I intend to press your last position: A ANK will move to SMY. I won’t order A BUL or F BLA into the attack, but I can’t leave your final center untouched. If F SMY holds, we can discuss terms after the turn.

notes.note: Contest HOL with NTH supported by BEL as promised to France; expect Germany's RUH/HEL defense and France to attack RUH. Take vacant Russian NOR with NWG despite Russia's claim to keep it clear; WAL to YOR. Germany refuses any center.

Take SMY with ANK supported by ARM; move BLA to RUM for pressure on Austria. Hold BER, KIE, and BUL against German/Austrian threats to secure gains. LVN to MOS; SKA to NOR. Germany contests KIE; Austria takes WAR. Italy seeks GRE; no agreement to cede it.

BUR-RUH as promised, though PIC cannot support that move from the listed options. NAF-TUN pursues a center at Italy's expense, breaking the quiet-west understanding; GOL returns to MAR. England promised NTH-HOL with BEL support.

Try to take GRE despite Austria's stated defense; if it fails, reassess Balkan access. Move TUS toward PIE and WES to MAO. France's western-border understanding has held; Austria has refused to share GRE. Russia says it will not oppose my GRE move.

Contest Italy’s move on GRE with ALB–GRE supported by AEG; support TYR–VEN with ADR to exploit Italy’s exposed center. Keep CON and WAR; Russia refuses to vacate BUL. Italy broke its earlier GRE restraint.
Escape to EAS to preserve F SMY; Italy and Russia are both targeting SMY, and Austria refuses to vacate CON. No reliable allies remain; seek a foothold if the unit survives.

Recover KIE with DEN supported by HEL and RUH; pressure BER with MUN supported by PRU. Russia broke northern understanding by occupying BER/KIE. England continues contesting HOL; France pressures RUH.

messages.body: I will defend my Balkan centers this spring. A CON, A GRE and A WAR will not be offered up; please keep A BUL and A ARM out of CON, GRE and WAR. What are your orders for those units? I prefer to avoid a wider war, but will coordinate defense if you press.

Russia remains the leading threat. Can you coordinate against its western front this spring? Please tell me your plans for A BER, F HEL, A KIE and A RUH; I can focus on containing A BUL and A ARM, and would welcome pressure on Russian-held centers.

A GRE is Austrian and will be defended. Please keep A APU and F ION out of GRE and my other centers this spring. I’m willing to discuss a concrete Italian gain against Russia or elsewhere, but I cannot concede Greece while Russia threatens the Balkans.

Your 10 centers put you close to a solo, so I need clarity: will F SKA and F STP/North stay out of my waters, and are you willing to keep the Scandinavian understanding? I have F NWG and won’t move against NOR this turn if you confirm no move toward my centers.

Russia now has 10 centers and is the immediate solo threat. Are you willing to coordinate against its growth rather than continue spending forces on Germany? Tell me your Spring targets and whether you can pressure its southern centers.

Russia’s 10 centers are an urgent threat to everyone. Are you willing to pause our Holland contest and coordinate against Russian expansion? Please state your Spring plans for F HEL and A RUH, and whether you will keep your forces clear of my centers.

Russia has 10 centers and is the immediate solo-win threat. What are your Spring plans for A CON, A GRE, and A WAR? I can keep pressure on Germany rather than interfere in your western centers; please use your forces to contain Russia, especially around BUL and RUM.

You are at 10 centers and close to a solo win. What are your Spring intentions toward Austria and the Balkans? France will have to help prevent you reaching 18; I am considering pressure on Germany, but need to know whether you intend to advance toward Austrian centers.

Russia is at 10 centers, so we should prevent a solo win before dividing the west. What are your Spring plans for F NWG and the German border? I can continue pressuring Germany from BUR/PIC; please tell me whether you’ll cooperate against Russia or focus on German centers.

Russia remains the greatest threat to both of us. Can we coordinate pressure on its southern position this turn? Please keep A BUL out of German centers; I’ll avoid your centers and would welcome your plan for A WAR and A CON.

Your A BUR, A PIC, and A PAR can make RUH difficult to defend. Are you planning to attack RUH or MUN this Spring? I propose we avoid crossing the frontier this turn: keep A BUR out of RUH and MUN, and I’ll keep my units out of Burgundy and Picardy.

Are F NTH and F BEL attacking HOL again this Spring? I will defend German centers, including HOL. I propose a clear border: keep your fleets out of HOL and DEN, and I’ll keep my forces out of Belgium and your other centers.

Austria still controls GRE, and I need a center to grow. Will you support A APU–GRE from A BUL this Spring, while F ION supports the attack? I’ll keep clear of your centers and coordinate against Austria, but I need a concrete Italian gain rather than another vague promise.

You hold GRE and have left me with only two centers. Are you willing to let A APU take GRE this turn, with F ION supporting, in exchange for my staying clear of your other centers? If not, tell me what specific center you will let me take; I cannot remain boxed in.

Our western-border understanding has held. I’ll keep F ION away from your western approaches and avoid Piedmont; please keep your units clear of my western approaches as I look for room to expand east.

Our units are in BER and KIE, but I’m willing to avoid widening the northern war this Spring. What are A DEN, F HEL, and your other units doing? I propose you leave BER and KIE unchallenged while we discuss a settlement; I’ll keep A MOS clear of your eastern centers.

The Balkan border is still contested. I propose we avoid attacking each other’s units this Spring while we finish resolving the Turkish front. What are A WAR, A CON, and your forces around BUL planning? I won’t promise to surrender Russian centers, but I’m open to a clear nonaggression line.

Can we coordinate against Austria this Spring? Tell me where A APU and F ION are headed. I can apply pressure from BUL and SMY, but need to know whether you’ll press GRE or CON; let’s avoid conflicting moves and agree on a concrete target.

A CON and A GRE will defend the Balkans; A WAR will not be offered to Russia. I’m coordinating with Germany and will resist Russian pressure around BUL and WAR. Please keep pressure on Germany’s western front from your side, and let me know if you can spare any force to threaten Russian-held centers.

I’ll keep A CON and A GRE focused on defending the Balkans and will not let A BUL take another Austrian center. A WAR will remain positioned to contest Russia’s western approach. Please press Russian-held centers where possible, and keep A BUL clear of German centers.

I won’t concede GRE, even in exchange for restraint elsewhere. Keep A APU and F ION clear of GRE and Austrian centers. If you need a concrete opportunity, use them against Russian-held SMY or another Russian position; I’m willing to coordinate pressure on Russia rather than fight over Austrian territory.

I can’t accept a nonaggression line that leaves A BUL threatening my Balkan centers. A CON and A GRE will defend against pressure, and I will contest any further advance into Austria. Keep A BUL and A ARM out of CON, GRE, SER and WAR; if you want to avoid widening the conflict, move A BUL away from my centers.

I’ll redirect from Germany this Spring: F NWG–NOR, F HOL–NTH, F BEL holds, and A YOR holds. In Fall I can press toward Sweden or St Petersburg if the fleets allow it. Your forces are far from Russia’s southern centers; can you keep Germany contained and avoid opening a western front while we assess a northern attack?

I’m willing to pause attacks on German centers this Spring while we address Russia. I’ll move F NWG–NOR and F HOL–NTH; F BEL and A YOR hold. Please keep your forces clear of Belgium and consider moving F HEL toward the Baltic to threaten Russia’s northern flank. We can revisit the border after Russia’s advance is checked.

I can’t agree to leave the frontier untouched while Russia is at 10 and western centers are the only practical gains available to me. I plan to pressure RUH from BUR, with PIC supporting; I will not move against Burgundy or Picardy. Please keep your units out of my centers and consider turning BER/KIE east against Russia.

Understood. I’ll keep A SPA out of Piedmont and my western forces clear of your approaches. Russia is the immediate solo threat; please use APU and F ION to pressure Russian-held centers or coordinate with Austria, rather than letting Russia grow unchecked.

Yes, Russia is the priority, though I can’t reach its southern centers from my current positions. I’ll pressure RUH with A BUR supported by A PIC, while keeping F TUN and A SPA clear of Italy. Please use F NWG to threaten Norway or the northern Russian fleet, and tell me if you can coordinate against Germany’s east-facing units.

I’ll keep A BER moving to PRU and A KIE covering BER; A RUH will contest HOL with F HEL supporting. I’m not sending German units into your centers. Please press A BUL and A ARM and avoid German territory.

BER and KIE are German centers, and my armies are in them; I can’t agree to leave them unchallenged. This Spring A BER goes to PRU, while A KIE covers BER. I’m not widening the eastern front this turn. Keep A MOS and A BUL clear of German centers.

I’ll keep German units clear of your centers, but A RUH will contest HOL with F HEL supporting; I won’t promise to leave Holland uncontested. A BER moves to PRU and A KIE covers BER. Please keep F BEL and your other forces out of German centers.

I cannot stay boxed in while you refuse any concrete share. I intend A APU–GRE with F ION supporting; keep A GRE and F AEG from contesting it, and I will stay clear of your other centers. If you refuse, name a specific center you will leave me to take this turn.

I’ll press GRE: A APU–GRE with F ION supporting. Please support from A BUL and keep A BUL from moving against my attack; you can press CON or Austria elsewhere. If Greece succeeds, I’ll coordinate against Austria, but I need this concrete gain and won’t threaten your centers.

I intend to keep pressure on Austria in the Balkans, not advance toward French centers. I’m open to your pressure on Germany, but Russia’s growth will remain my priority; please don’t let Austria use your forces to strengthen its position against me.

I can’t promise to keep A BUL and A ARM out of Austrian territory while our centers remain contested. I’m not seeking a wider war for its own sake, but I will defend Russian interests and respond to moves against BUL or WAR. What are your plans for A WAR and A CON?

Yes: I’ll support A APU–GRE from A BUL, and you can have the center if the attack succeeds. Keep F ION supporting and avoid moves against my centers; after GRE, let’s coordinate pressure on Austria rather than clash over the Balkans.
I’ll keep F SKA and F STP/North out of your waters this turn, and our Scandinavian understanding stands. I have no move planned against your centers; please continue to stay clear of NOR and SWE.

notes.note: Spring 1906: honor stated plan—NWG to NOR, HOL to NTH, BEL and YOR hold; LON supports HOL→NTH against any attack. Russia promises SKA/STP North clear of our waters and no move toward centers; Germany contests HOL with RUH, HEL support. France pressures RUH.

France intends BUR-PIC support into RUH; hold RUH with KIE support to stop it. Advance BER to PRU and HEL to DEN. Russia remains the leading threat, but no Russian units currently approach our centers.
Spring 1906: follow through on APU–GRE with ION convoy; Russia promised BUL support and to avoid conflict. Austria refuses to concede GRE. France asks me to pressure Russia; reassess after outcome.

Press for vacant MUN with BUR; rotate PAR to BUR and PIC to PAR, BRE to GAS. Hold MAR and keep TUN moving toward NAF. England is shifting north against Russia; Germany asked for a quiet frontier, which I declined.

Press CON with BUL supported by SMY; move toward LVN and DEN and open BLA. Keep SKA/STP out of English waters. Italy requested support for GRE, but prioritizing Russian advance. Austria warns against Balkan pressure; Germany plans BER/KIE coverage.

Defend GRE against Italy's supported APU attack with ADR and AEG; CON contests Russian BUL. Push BOH toward MUN, VEN toward ROM, WAR toward UKR. Italy has broken prior restraint and still threatens GRE; Russia remains the main danger.

messages.body: This Fall I will retain ANK, GRE and WAR; A ROM will take ROM from Italy. Are you moving A CON or A SMY against my centers? If you want to avoid widening the war, keep clear of GRE and WAR and tell me your exact orders for CON and SMY.

Russia is at 10 centers and threatens the solo. Please use your western units to contest Russian-held centers if possible, and keep your units out of Austrian territory. I am holding the Balkan line and taking ROM from Italy; what are your Fall orders against Russia?

A ROM will take ROM this Fall, so please keep A APU and F ION clear of GRE and Austrian centers. Rather than fight over GRE, use your forces against Russian-held SMY or another Russian position; confirm whether you intend to attack GRE.

Your 10-center lead makes a solo the immediate danger. I’m holding Norway this Fall; please do not attack it or my other centers. Can you commit to keeping your fleets out of English waters while Austria holds Ankara and we prevent further Russian gains?

Russia is still the leading solo threat. You have taken Ankara while Russia holds Constantinople; can you keep pressure on Russian centers this Fall and avoid any deal that lets Russia regain Ankara or expand elsewhere?

Russia remains the main solo danger. I’m holding Norway this Fall and keeping my fleets positioned to contain the north. Please continue to avoid opening a front against me, and use your units to prevent Germany or Russia from gaining centers.

Russia remains the immediate solo threat. Your F NOR can reclaim Norway this Fall if it holds; can you also coordinate a move against Sweden or St Petersburg? I’ll keep pressure on Germany and avoid opening a front against you.

Please use A ANK to reclaim Ankara and keep your forces contesting Russia’s Balkan gains this Fall. Russia’s 10 centers make stopping its growth urgent; can you coordinate with England’s northern pressure and tell me which Russian centers you can attack?

Russia’s 10 centers are the immediate threat. Will you turn A PRU and your northern forces against Russia rather than attack my centers? I’m keeping pressure on the German frontier, but would welcome a concrete arrangement that directs your eastern units against Russia this Fall.

A RUH is exposed to A BUR with A PIC support. I propose we avoid a costly clash: keep A BUR and A PIC out of RUH and MUN this Fall, and I’ll keep German units out of Burgundy and Picardy. Are you willing to hold the frontier?

Are F NTH and F BEL planning to attack HOL again this Fall? I’ll defend German centers, but would rather avoid another Holland contest. Please keep your fleets out of HOL and DEN; I’ll keep German forces clear of your centers. What are your orders?

Germany has recovered BER and KIE. Please confirm A LVN will stay out of PRU and other German centers this Fall. I’ll keep my forces clear of Russian centers; we should avoid reopening the northern war while Russia faces pressure elsewhere.

I intend A APU–ROM with F ION supporting to recover my center. Please do not support A ROM; I will keep F ION clear of your other centers. Russia is the larger threat, so let’s avoid wasting units fighting each other.

I’m attacking Austrian-held ROM with A APU, supported by F ION. Please use your position to pressure Austria rather than interfere with this move. Your army in CON is already contesting Austria; avoid taking further Italian centers if you want me to stay focused on Austria.

A CON is now back in ANK, while my A CON occupies your center. I intend to retain CON; I am not promising a wider advance this turn. What are A ANK, A GRE, and A WAR doing? Avoid attacking my units and we can keep the conflict limited to the contested centers.

The northern front is still contested, but I’m willing to discuss a settlement. What are A PRU, A RUH, and F HEL doing this Fall? I will not move A LVN against your centers if you leave BER and KIE unchallenged; please confirm whether that is workable.

Our Scandinavian understanding matters with Russia leading. I intend to keep F SKA out of your waters and will not move on your centers this Fall. Please keep F NOR and F NTH clear of NOR and SWE; can you confirm your plans?

A ANK will attack CON, with A GRE and F AEG supporting. I will keep A WAR and A GRE clear of further Russian advances. Your A CON should withdraw if you want to limit this conflict; retaining CON at Austria’s expense is not a workable settlement.

I cannot allow A APU–ROM to succeed: F ADR will support A ROM holding. Keep A APU and F ION clear of GRE and other Austrian centers. I’m pressing Russia at CON; redirect your forces against Russian-held SMY instead.

I’m attacking Russian-held CON from ANK, with GRE and AEG supporting, and will hold WAR and GRE against Russian pressure. I cannot reach BUL or RUM this Fall; please continue pressure on Germany and, if possible, threaten Russia from your side.

I’m attacking Russian-held CON from ANK, supported by GRE and AEG, while holding WAR and GRE against further Russian advances. Please keep up northern pressure on Russia and avoid any deal that frees its units to expand elsewhere.

I will keep F NOR and F NTH clear of Sweden and your centers this Fall, but I cannot leave Norway exposed while your forces are near. I ask that F SKA stay out of my waters and that you make no attack on Norway. We must prevent further Russian growth, especially the capture of Austrian centers.

I will not attack HOL or DEN this Fall; F NTH and F BEL will stay out of German centers. Please keep your forces clear of Belgium and my centers. Russia is the immediate solo threat, so use your eastern-facing units to prevent its expansion rather than opening a western front.

I’ll keep F NOR holding Norway and won’t attack Sweden or St Petersburg this Fall. I can’t spare a fleet for a northern attack without risking Norway, but I’ll contain Russian moves. Please continue pressure on Germany without attacking my centers, and help ensure Russia gains no more supply centers.

I’ll keep A BUR and A PIC out of RUH and MUN this Fall, provided your units stay out of Burgundy and Picardy. Russia is the larger danger now; please turn A PRU and your other east-facing units against it.

Understood. I won’t open a front against you this Fall. My armies are too far south and west to reach Russia’s centers directly; I’ll keep the German frontier contained and avoid helping Russia gain centers. Please hold Norway and continue containing its northern fleets.

I can’t promise to leave BER and KIE unchallenged indefinitely. This Fall A PRU will pressure LVN; A RUH will defend against France, with A KIE supporting. F HEL will stay on the northern front. Keep A LVN clear of German centers and we can avoid widening our conflict.

I’ll direct A PRU against Russian-held LVN this Fall. A KIE will support A RUH against French pressure, and F HEL will remain on the northern front. I’m not sending units into Austrian territory; please keep your units clear of German centers as you contain Russia in the south.

A PRU will pressure Russian-held LVN this Fall as you suggest, while A RUH defends against your frontier pressure and A KIE supports it. I’ll keep German units out of Burgundy and Picardy. Please keep A BUR and A PIC out of RUH and MUN so we can focus pressure eastward.

I am not attacking GRE. A APU will move to ROM, supported by F ION, to recover my center; I will keep F ION clear of your other centers. Please do not support A ROM. I agree that Russia is the larger threat, but I need ROM restored to Italy.

I’m not moving A CON or A SMY into GRE or WAR this Fall. I will use my position to contest ANK; your A ANK is on a Russian center, and I won’t recognize an Austrian claim to it. I can’t give you exact orders, but I’m not seeking to widen the front beyond the contested centers.
A LVN will stay out of PRU and other German centers this Fall. I’m not reopening the northern war against you; please keep A PRU, A RUH, and F HEL clear of Russian centers.

I won’t interfere with A APU–ROM or F ION’s support. I’ll pressure Austria from the east, but I’m not promising to surrender CON or other Russian-held centers. Keep your forces clear of my centers, and we can discuss coordination after ROM is resolved.

I understand the concern. I won’t move F SKA or F BAR into English waters this Fall, and I’m not ordering against your other centers. I can’t agree to leave Russian-owned NOR permanently in English hands; please keep F NTH clear of NOR and SWE.

notes.note: Austria warned it will support ROM, so abandon the likely bounce and take open VEN instead. Move ION to EAS for future access; Russia promised not to interfere with ROM but gives no concrete gain. France's western-border understanding remains in place.

Hold CON against Austria with BLA and SMY support; keeping CON secures the center. Advance into SWE and UKR, shift LVN to MOS away from German pressure, and move SYR toward ARM. England and Germany promised restraint; Austria is attacking CON.

Try to capture HOL with RUH supported by HEL and KIE; pressure Russian LVN from PRU. England promised to stay out of HOL/DEN, France to keep BUR/PIC out of RUH/MUN, and Russia to keep LVN out of German centers.

BUR-MUN breaks my assurance to Germany, but MUN is a valuable center and Russia is near a solo. Reposition GAS/PAR/PIC behind the move; NAF-MAO prepares a convoy. England holds Norway; Austria attacks CON.
Hold Norway and support it from NTH against a possible Russian attack. Keep fleets clear of German centers as promised; Russia has not committed to leaving Norway English permanently.
Keep ANK and ROM to secure Fall centers; ADR attacks ION to cut Italy's support into ROM. BOH-MUN and WAR-MOS expand against Germany/Russia. Italy promised no GRE attack; Russia contests CON.

messages.body: Russia remains at 9 centers and is the immediate solo threat. Please keep pressure on its northern centers this turn; which Russian-held center can your units threaten? I’ll continue contesting CON from ANK and need Russia unable to reinforce the south.

Please continue pressing Russia from the west, especially with A PRU against LVN if that remains viable. I’ll contest CON from ANK and hold the Balkan line. What are your plans for A PRU and the Russian frontier this turn?

I will continue contesting your hold on CON from ANK; I cannot accept your keeping an Austrian center. Will you withdraw A CON from the Balkans and keep A ARM and A SMY clear of GRE and WAR? Please state your intentions for those units.

I’ll keep F NTH clear of your centers, but F NOR must be protected. Please confirm you will not attack Norway this Spring, and tell me your plans for F NWG and F SWE. Austria is still contesting your southern centers; let’s prevent further gains rather than open a northern war.

I’ll keep Norway defended and avoid Russian centers this Spring. What are your plans for A ANK and the Russian-held CON—can you maintain pressure without leaving your centers exposed? Please make sure Russia gains no center this turn.

I’ll keep F BEL, F NTH, and my armies out of German centers this Spring. Please keep your units clear of Belgium and my centers, and tell me whether F HEL will stay out of the North Sea. With Russia still the leading threat, let’s avoid reopening the Holland contest.

Russia is still the main threat, but France cannot reach its centers this turn. Which Russian centers are you targeting with A ANK, A GRE, and A WAR? Please coordinate with England and Germany to prevent further Russian gains.

I’ll keep my forces clear of English centers this Spring. Can you use your northern fleets to attack or contain Russia, and tell me your targets? France can continue pressing the German front while you focus east.

Russia remains dangerous, and your A PRU can threaten LVN. I’m willing to keep pressure focused on your frontier rather than widen the war elsewhere this Spring; what are your plans for A PRU and the eastern units? Please keep German forces out of Burgundy and Picardy.
Will F NTH and F BEL stay out of HOL and DEN this Spring? I’ll keep German units out of your centers. With Russia still at 9, let’s avoid reopening our border while we contain its expansion.

Can we keep the frontier quiet this Spring? Please keep A BUR and A PIC out of RUH and MUN; I’ll keep German units out of Burgundy and Picardy. Russia remains the biggest solo threat, so I want to avoid wasting units against you.

What are your plans against Russia this Spring, especially A WAR and A CON? Germany needs to keep its centers secure, but I’m willing to coordinate pressure on Russian-held territory if you can hold the southern front.

I have only VEN and NAP and cannot remain boxed in. Will you let A VEN take ROM this Spring, with F ION supporting, and keep F ADR from supporting A ROM? In return I will keep clear of GRE, TRI, and your other centers and join pressure on Russia.

I need a concrete Italian gain, not another promise to avoid interference. Will you keep A CON and A SMY from moving against my centers while I try for ROM, and direct your pressure against Austria elsewhere? I will not attack Russian centers this turn.

Our western understanding has held. I will keep A VEN out of PIE and my fleet clear of your western approaches. Please keep your forces clear of Italy as I try to recover ROM and seek room to expand east.

Russia will retain CON and contest ANK; I am not proposing an advance on GRE or WAR this turn. Are you planning another attack on CON, and what are A ANK and F AEG doing? If you keep pressure limited to the contested centers, we can avoid widening the Balkan war.

I want to keep our Scandinavian understanding intact. Please keep F NTH and F NOR clear of SWE and my other centers; I will keep my fleets out of English waters this turn. Are you holding NOR or planning to move against SWE?

Austria is stretched across the Balkans. Can you press ROM with A VEN and F ION while I contest ANK from CON/SMY? I won't interfere with your Italian centers. Please tell me whether you're attacking ROM or GRE so we can avoid conflicting moves.

A ANK will continue pressing Russian-held CON with F AEG support; A WAR will hold against any Russian move west, and A GRE will defend the Balkan line. Please keep A PRU focused on LVN and avoid Austrian centers. Russia must not gain another center this turn.

I’ll keep pressure on CON from A ANK with F AEG supporting, while A GRE and A WAR protect the Balkans and west. Please threaten a Russian-held northern center if you can, and make sure Russia gains no center this turn.

I won’t leave ROM open to A VEN, and F ADR will support A ROM holding. Keep F ION and A VEN clear of Austrian centers; I’d rather have you pressure Russian-held SMY than spend forces fighting over ROM.

I will continue contesting CON from ANK, with F AEG supporting the move. I want this conflict limited, but I cannot accept your retaining an Austrian center. Keep A ARM and A SMY clear of GRE and WAR; will you withdraw A CON?

A ANK will press Russian-held CON with F AEG support; A WAR will hold, and A GRE will protect the Balkans. I’ll coordinate with England and Germany to contain Russia. Please keep pressure on Germany and, if an opening arises, threaten Russia rather than Austrian centers.

Yes. F BEL, F NTH, and A YOR will stay out of HOL and DEN this Spring. I’ll keep my forces clear of your centers; please keep F HEL out of the North Sea and Belgium. I’m holding Norway against Russian pressure.

I can’t reach a Russian supply center from my current positions this Spring. I’ll hold F NOR and use F NTH to support it, preventing Russia from taking Norway or gaining a northern foothold. Please keep pressure on CON and ensure Russia gains no center in the south.

I’m holding F NOR, with F NTH supporting it, and won’t attack SWE or your other centers this Spring. Please keep your fleets out of Norway and English waters. Austria is still contesting your southern position, so let’s avoid opening a northern front.

I’ll hold F NOR with support from F NTH to contain Russia; I can’t safely attack a Russian center while protecting Norway. My forces will stay clear of German centers this Spring. Please continue containing Germany and avoid opening a front against my centers.

I’ll keep A BUR and A PAR out of RUH and MUN this Spring, provided German units stay out of Burgundy and Picardy. Please follow through with A PRU–LVN; Russia’s growth is the shared danger. Let me know whether A KIE or A MUN can also be directed east.

I’ll keep my forces clear of Piedmont and your western approaches this Spring. With A ROM held by Austria and Russia at nine centers, your best recovery is likely to coordinate east with Austria against Russia. I’m not planning a move against VEN or ION this turn.

F HEL will stay out of NTH, and I’ll keep German units clear of Belgium and your centers. I intend to use A PRU against Russian-held LVN; please maintain your commitment to keep F BEL, F NTH, and your armies out of German centers.

A PRU remains aimed at Russian-held LVN this turn. I’ll keep German units out of Austrian territory; your pressure on CON from ANK should help keep Russia occupied in the south. Let me know if you can also contest another Russian position.

A PRU is directed against Russian-held LVN; I want to keep pressure on Russia rather than waste units at the western frontier. German forces will stay out of Burgundy and Picardy. Please keep A BUR and A PIC clear of RUH and MUN so we can both focus east.

Agreed: A VEN–ROM with F ION supporting. Please contest ANK from CON/SMY and keep your forces clear of my centers; I won’t move against Russian centers this turn. Let me know if you expect Austria to have support in ROM so we can judge whether this attack can succeed.

This Spring F NWG and F SWE will hold, and I will not attack Norway. I’ll keep my fleets out of English waters; please keep F NTH clear of my centers. I can’t make a permanent commitment about Norway, but I’m willing to preserve our understanding this turn.

I’ll keep A CON and A SMY away from your centers this turn and will not interfere with your move on ROM. I’ll contest Austria from the east, including ANK, rather than press Italian territory. Please keep F ION and A VEN clear of Russian centers.

A CON will defend itself against your attack; I am not withdrawing it. A ARM will stay clear of GRE and WAR this turn. I intend to contest ANK, but I’m not proposing an advance on GRE or WAR. Will you limit your attack to CON?

notes.note: Keep pressing east: PRU to LVN as promised; KIE with HEL support to DEN. HOL moves into RUH; MUN advances toward TYR and the Italian centers. England and France promised to stay clear of German centers/frontier this Spring; Austria is contesting CON.

Austria refuses to yield ROM and can support its defense, so avoid the futile attack. Reposition ION to ALB and VEN to TUS for future pressure. Russia promised not to interfere; France and I maintain western-border restraint.
Press for expansion: BUR-RUH despite the frontier-quiet promise; BRE-PIC supported by PAR, GAS-MAR, GOL-PIE, MAO-NAF. Germany and England promised mutual frontier restraint; reassess their responses.

Contest ANK hard: CON attacks with ARM, BLA, and SMY support; avoid giving up CON. Press WAR with MOS supported by LVN and UKR. SWE strikes vacant DEN; NWG shifts to BAR. England agreement to avoid its centers remains in effect; Italy is targeting ROM.

Press HOL with NTH supported from BEL despite my promise to Germany to stay clear; aim to retain it through Fall. Keep NOR while Russia honors its no-attack promise. LON to WAL and YOR to LVP for positioning.

Press CON with ANK supported by AEG; GRE attacks vacant Russian BUL. ROM holds against Italy’s stated intent to take it; ADR to TRI. BOH advances TYR. WAR holds; Russia says no westward advance, but watch UKR.

messages.body: This Fall I intend to keep A BUL and contest your advance into Austrian centers. Are A ANK and A UKR moving to ANK and WAR? I can limit my moves to recovering BUL if you keep clear of GRE and VIE; otherwise I’ll defend my centers and press wherever possible.

I’m not planning to attack German centers this Fall. What are A MUN and A KIE doing? Please keep your units clear of Austrian territory; I’ll keep A BOH away from MUN if we can maintain a quiet border.

Germany still holds HOL while your F HOL is positioned there. Please keep pressure on that front and prevent Germany from recovering the center. Russia’s southern advance threatens my centers; let me know if you can disrupt its northern gains.

F HOL is under my control. I intend to hold it this Fall; please do not attack it from F HEL or A DEN. I’ll keep F BEL clear of your centers. Can we avoid reopening our western front while Austria contests Russia?

I’m holding F NOR and will keep it out of your centers. Please honor your Spring commitment and make no attack on Norway or my other centers this Fall. Austria is still contesting your southern position; let’s avoid opening a northern front.

Russia remains the leading solo threat. I’m holding Norway and currently occupy HOL, so I can’t reach Russian centers from here. Please keep pressure on Russia and prevent it from gaining any center this Fall; what are your plans for ANK and CON?

Russia is poised to reach 10 after taking ANK and WAR, so please make containing it your priority this Fall. Can A BUL take or hold BUL while A GAL pressures WAR? I’ll keep my forces focused west rather than attack your centers; tell me what you can realistically defend.

Russia remains the biggest solo threat. Are you following through with A PRU–LVN this Fall, and can A MUN or A KIE support pressure east? I’m willing to avoid a western clash this turn if your forces stay out of Burgundy and Picardy.

Russia is set to gain ANK and WAR unless we contain it. Can you make any northern move against a Russian center this Fall, or at least keep F NOR and F NTH positioned to block its fleet? I’ll stay clear of English centers.
What are F HOL and F BEL doing this Fall? I’m considering A DEN–HOL with F HEL support to recover my center; if you keep F BEL out of German centers, we can avoid opening a wider front.

What are A BUL and A WAR doing this Fall? Russia is still at 9, so I’m keeping pressure on the eastern front where possible. Please keep Austrian units out of German centers; I’ll avoid moving into yours.
Can we keep the frontier quiet this Fall? I’m not directing German units into Burgundy or Picardy. Please keep A BUR and A PIC out of RUH and MUN while we contain Russia.

I have no room to grow while you hold ROM and GRE. This Fall I intend A TUS–ROM, with F ALB moving to ION. Do not support A ROM holding; let me recover ROM, and I will keep my units clear of GRE and TRI. Russia is at nine centers, so we should avoid spending another year locked in conflict.

I intend A TUS–ROM this Fall; please keep A SMY and your other units clear of Italian centers. Austria has repeatedly blocked my recovery, so I will press ROM rather than leave Italy permanently boxed in. Do not treat my move as cooperation with Austria against you.

This Fall A ANK and A WAR are positioned to take your centers. Are you moving A BUL to retake BUL, and what are A ROM and F TRI doing? I’m prepared to keep the contest focused on the centers already at issue if you avoid attacks on my units.
Austria is exposed this Fall. Can you use A ALB and A TUS to pressure ROM or TRI? I’ll take ANK and WAR; please keep your units clear of Russian centers and tell me your intended moves.

I intend to keep our northern front quiet this Fall. Please keep F NOR and F BEL clear of SWE and my other centers; I’ll keep my forces out of your centers. What are your plans for HOL and the northern fleets?

A BUL will remain to secure BUL, and I will defend my remaining centers against any advance from ANK or UKR. I am not seeking to widen the war, but I cannot leave ANK or WAR undefended while your units threaten them.

I’ll keep pressure on Russia’s southern position and defend my centers; A BUL is staying to secure BUL. Please hold HOL against Germany’s recovery and keep Norway safe. I can’t count on northern units reaching Russian centers this Fall, so your defensive pressure still matters.

A BUL will stay to secure BUL, while I defend my southern centers and contest Russia’s advance. I have no intention of entering German territory; please keep your units clear of Austrian centers and maintain pressure on the Russian frontier if possible.

A BUL will stay to secure BUL, and I’ll defend the southern centers against Russia. A GAL is positioned to contest WAR, but I cannot guarantee holding every threatened center against Russian pressure. Please continue focusing west and avoid opening another front against Austria.

I will not leave ROM open to A TUS; F TRI will support A ROM holding. Keep F ALB and A TUS clear of GRE and TRI. With Russia threatening Austrian centers, redirecting your forces against Russian positions would serve us both better than another attack on ROM.
I’ll hold F NOR and defend F HOL; F BEL will support F HOL holding. I won’t move against SWE or your other centers this Fall. Please keep your forces out of Norway and English centers as agreed.

F HOL will hold, with F BEL supporting its defense. I’ll keep F BEL out of your centers, but I can’t leave HOL undefended against A DEN and F HEL. Please avoid reopening the contest and keep your forces clear of my centers.

I can’t reach a Russian center from my current positions this Fall. I’ll hold F NOR against a possible Russian move and use F BEL to support F HOL against Germany; my fleets will stay clear of Russian centers.

I can’t reach a Russian center from my current northern positions this Fall. I’ll hold F NOR against a possible Russian move and defend HOL against Germany. Please continue contesting Russia’s southern gains; I’m unable to disrupt them directly.

I’ll keep A BUR and A PIC out of RUH and MUN this Fall, and keep my other units out of your centers. Please follow through with A PRU–LVN and turn A MUN or A KIE east as well; Russia’s A ANK and A WAR threaten the balance. I’m not looking to open a western front while you pressure Russia.

I’ll avoid widening the western front, but I must try to recover HOL: A DEN will attack HOL with F HEL supporting. Please keep F BEL out of German centers; I won’t move into Belgium or your other centers.

A PRU will attack LVN this Fall as promised. A MUN and A KIE are not positioned to support that attack, and I need A KIE available to help recover HOL. I’ll keep German forces out of Burgundy and Picardy; please keep A BUR and A PIC clear of RUH and MUN.

A MUN will stay clear of Austrian territory, and A KIE will support the attempt to recover HOL. I’m not planning to move either into your centers. Please keep A BOH and your other units clear of German centers.

I’ll order A TUS–ROM and A ALB–TRI, pressuring Austria on both fronts. I’m not moving against Russian centers; keep A SMY and your other units clear of Italian centers as agreed. Your moves on ANK and WAR should keep Austria occupied.
I’ll honor the quiet northern front this Fall and make no attack on Norway or your other centers. Please keep F NOR and F BEL clear of SWE and my centers; I’ll keep my forces out of yours.

I intend to take ANK and WAR this Fall, and A BUL is staying to defend BUL. I will keep clear of GRE and VIE; please avoid attacks on my units and let the contest remain limited to these centers. What are A ROM and F TRI doing?
I won’t interfere with A TUS–ROM, and A SMY and my other units will stay clear of your centers. I’m pressing Austria at ANK and WAR; please keep your forces clear of Russian centers.

notes.note: Defend HOL with BEL support to bounce Germany's DEN+HEL attack and secure the center. Keep NOR; Russia promised a quiet front. Reposition LVP to YOR and WAL to IRI.

Austria supports ROM, so avoid a futile attack this Fall. Move F ALB to ADR to enable future pressure on ROM/TRI; move A TUS to VEN to secure my center and regroup. Russia promised to stay clear of Italian centers.
Attempt to take BEL with BUR supported by PIC; this breaks my assurance to England. Advance MAR to GAS, NAF to MAO, PAR to BRE, PIE to GOL. Reassess English response next turn.

Secure BUL by keeping A BUL there; take open Russian CON with F AEG and try RUM with GAL. ROM holds against Italy's announced attack; TRI to ADR. Russia's ANK/WAR occupation threatens Austrian centers; Italy has repeatedly broken restraint.

Hold ANK and WAR to secure the two Fall gains. Italy promised attacks on ROM and TRI; England says NOR/BEL stay clear. Austria keeps BUL and defends its centers. Press GAL and PRU; prepare SWE fleet position in BAL.
Attempt HOL by convoy with KIE support despite England's promised defense; England broke the quiet-front agreement by holding HOL with BEL support. PRU presses LVN; MUN advances to TYR.

messages.body: Your army at ANK and advance toward WAR threaten my centers. I will defend Austria and cannot accept Russian control of ANK or WAR. What are A ANK and A SYR doing this Spring? Keep clear of GRE, VIE, and TRI if you want to contain this conflict.

With F ALB and A VEN, are you planning to attack ROM or GRE this Spring? I cannot leave either center exposed, and will defend against any move. If you stay clear of Austrian centers, we can avoid opening another front while Russia threatens us both.

Please keep pressure on Russia from PRU and avoid Austrian centers. What are A PRU and your other eastern units doing this Spring? I need to know whether you can contest Russian-held territory while I defend the Balkans.

I intend to keep F NOR and F NTH positioned defensively this Spring. Will you keep your units out of Norway and English waters again? If your northern fleet is free to pressure another front, tell me your plans.

Russia remains the leading solo threat. What are your plans against its southern centers this Spring? I’ll keep Norway defended, but from my current positions I cannot reach a Russian center safely this turn.

Can we avoid reopening the Holland contest this Spring? I’m not planning an attack on German centers from my current positions. Please keep F HEL and your armies clear of English centers, especially Norway and the North Sea.

Russia remains at nine centers and is the main solo threat. Which Russian centers are you targeting this Spring with A BUL, A RUM, and your forces near the Balkans? Please coordinate pressure with Germany; I’ll avoid Austrian centers while you contain Russia.

Can you direct A PRU toward a Russian center again this Spring, and use A MUN or A KIE to reinforce the eastern front? A HOL is exposed to pressure from my A BEL; if you move it east, I can keep the western frontier quiet for now.

Russia remains the main solo threat at nine centers. Can you use F NOR, F NTH, and F ENG to pressure or block Russian fleets this Spring? I’ll keep my forces clear of English centers; please tell me your intended northern moves.

F HOL is a German center, and I intend to recover it. What are F HOL and F NTH doing this Spring? I propose you withdraw F HOL and keep your forces out of German centers; I’ll keep my units out of your centers and avoid widening the western front.

Can we keep the frontier quiet this Spring? Please keep A PIC and A MAR out of German centers; I’ll keep my forces out of Burgundy and Picardy. Russia’s 9 centers remain the main danger—are you willing to focus pressure east rather than open a western clash?

Germany needs to secure its frontier while Russia holds 9 centers. What are A LVN, F BAL, and A WAR doing this Spring? I propose we avoid attacks on each other’s centers while we contain further Russian expansion elsewhere.

Russia now has nine centers and is the clear solo threat. I can keep F ALB and A VEN clear of Austrian centers this Spring if you keep A ROM from moving against VEN. What are your orders against Russia, and can we agree on a concrete joint move?
You have nine centers and are close to a solo. What are your Spring plans toward Austria and the Balkans? I need room to rebuild, but would rather coordinate than let you reach eighteen uncontested.

Our western-border restraint has held. I intend to keep A VEN out of PIE and F ALB clear of your approaches this Spring. Are you maintaining the same restraint, and what are your plans against Russia?

The Balkan contest is still the key front. What are A BUL, A RUM, and F TRI doing this Spring? I’m not proposing an advance on GRE or VIE this turn, but I will defend my centers and need to know whether you intend to press ANK or CON again.

Can you press Austria again this Spring? A VEN or F ALB toward ROM/TRI would keep Austrian units occupied while I act from ANK and WAR. I’ll keep A SMY and my other units clear of Italian centers; tell me your intended moves.

Let’s keep the northern front quiet this Spring. Please keep F NOR and F NTH clear of SWE and my centers; I’ll keep my forces out of English centers. Are you holding NOR, and what are your plans for F NTH?

I’ll keep A ROM from moving against VEN this Spring. Please keep A VEN and F ALB clear of ROM, GRE, and TRI; F ALB–ION would avoid opening another front. Austria will press Russia with A BUL–CON, supported by F AEG, and A RUM–GAL. I can’t promise a lasting truce if you attack Austrian centers.

A BUL will attack CON with F AEG supporting, and A RUM will press GAL. I will defend my centers and cannot accept Russian control of ANK or WAR. You say you are not advancing on GRE or VIE; keep that restraint, and this turn’s contest can remain focused on the existing front.

This Spring A BUL will attack CON with F AEG supporting, while A RUM presses GAL. A ROM and F TRI will protect my southern centers; A BOH and A BUD will defend the interior. I’ll coordinate with Germany where possible, but I can’t reach a Russian center from the western front myself. Please keep clear of Austrian centers.

A BUL will attack CON with F AEG supporting, and A RUM will press GAL; I’ll keep my other units focused on defending Austrian centers. I don’t see a safe way to spare a unit for another Russian target this Spring. Please continue holding F NOR and denying Russia any northern gains.

There is no English F HOL; your A HOL holds it. I’m not withdrawing a unit from there. I’m considering F NTH–HOL, with F ENG supporting, so I can’t promise to keep out of Holland. I’ll keep F NOR out of your centers; please keep F HEL and your armies clear of Norway and English waters.

I’ll keep F NOR holding Norway and keep F NTH out of your centers this Spring. F ENG will stay out of English waters and Russian centers. Please keep your forces out of Norway and my other centers again; with Austria contesting you in the south, there’s no need to reopen our northern front.

I’ll keep F NOR secure and use my other fleets to defend my position and seek an opening in the west; I can’t reach Russian centers from here. I’m considering pressure on German-held HOL, so please keep A BEL clear of English centers and tell me whether you’ll continue pressure on Germany without moving against me.

I’m willing to keep A PIC out of German centers this Spring if A PRU again pressures a Russian center and you keep A HOL out of Belgium. Please direct A PRU toward LVN or another Russian-held center; Russia’s nine centers are the immediate danger. I’ll keep A MAR focused south, not toward Munich.

I’ll maintain restraint: A MAR will stay out of Piedmont, and F GOL will stay clear of your western approaches. I’m not planning a move against Italy this Spring. Russia remains the main danger; please coordinate with Austria to pressure Russian centers such as Smyrna or Sevastopol.

A PRU will move to LVN again, and A MUN will press east toward SIL. A KIE will cover HOL against French pressure; F HEL will remain on the northern front. Please keep A BOH and your other units clear of German centers.

A PRU will move to LVN, and A MUN will press toward SIL. I will not move A HOL east: it is a German center exposed to A BEL, so A KIE will support its defense. Please keep A BEL out of HOL and your armies clear of German centers; I’ll keep mine out of Burgundy and Picardy.

I cannot leave HOL undefended while it remains under English control. A HOL will hold, with A KIE supporting its defense; F HEL will stay out of English centers and the North Sea. I’ll keep my units clear of your centers, and ask that you keep your forces out of German centers.

I will keep A VEN and F ALB clear of ROM and GRE this Spring. I propose F ALB–ION and A VEN–TYR to avoid a futile attack while you press Russia; please tell me your specific orders against Russian centers and whether you will leave me a concrete route to rebuild. I cannot stay permanently confined to NAP and VEN.

I can keep pressure on Austria without attacking your centers: F ALB–ION and A VEN–TYR this Spring. I will not move against Russian centers, but your nine-center position is a serious solo threat. What are your specific moves from ANK and WAR, and will you agree not to take Italian centers as you expand?

A ANK will defend itself, and A SYR will stay clear of GRE and VIE this Spring. I’m not looking to widen the conflict beyond the contested eastern centers, but I won’t leave Russian positions exposed. What are A BUL, A RUM, and F TRI doing? Please keep your forces from attacking my units.

I’m willing to avoid attacks on German centers this Spring. A LVN and F BAL will not move against your centers; please keep A PRU and your other units clear of Russian centers. With Austria occupying the southern front, let’s keep our border quiet rather than give either of us another war.

I’ll press Austria from the east, while keeping A SMY and my other units clear of Italian centers. Please use A VEN or F ALB to pressure TRI or ROM again if you can; that would keep Austria stretched. Which units are you committing, and will you avoid Russian centers?

I’ll keep my forces out of Norway and English centers this Spring, as agreed. F BAL is not moving against SWE or your fleets. Please keep F NOR and F NTH clear of Russian centers; I’m concentrating on Austria and would rather not open a northern front.

notes.note: Keep Spring 1908 promises to Austria/Russia: F ALB–ION, A VEN–TYR; France restraint continues. Austria says A BUL–CON with AEG support and RUM–GAL against Russia. Russia asks pressure Austria but has promised to stay clear of Italian centers.

Keep HOL secure against England’s possible supported NTH attack; HEL and KIE support HOL holding. MUN presses into SIL and PRU again attacks LVN as promised. France and Austria asked for eastern pressure; Russia pledged to avoid German centers.

Advance toward German centers: NTH to DEN, reposition ENG to IRI and YOR to LVP, NOR to NWG. Russia again promised to stay clear of English centers; Germany asks that we avoid its centers, but I have not agreed.
Press into RUH and BUR while Germany says it will move MUN east and keep HOL out of Belgium. GAS and MAR support PIC-BUR. MAO advances toward North Africa; GOL to TYS. Reassess German response.

Press CON with AEG supporting BUL; RUM attacks GAL with BOH support, while BUD takes vacant Russian SER. ROM holds; TRI advances to ADR. Italy promised to keep ALB/VEN clear of Austrian centers; watch whether they keep it. Russia says ANK defends, SYR stays clear of GRE/VIE.

Press Austria: ANK to ARM supported by SMY and SYR; GAL attacks RUM with BLA support while RUM moves toward GAL. Expand north/east with BAL to BOT, BAR to NWG, LVN to MOS, WAR to UKR. Keep Italy and England quiet.

messages.body: A CON and A SER will hold their positions this Fall, and I will not leave GRE or VIE open. Are A GAL, A UKR, and F BLA moving against SER or CON? Keep clear of both centers and we can keep this contest focused on the current front.

Please keep A TYR and F ION clear of ROM, TRI, and GRE this Fall. I will hold ROM and defend my Austrian centers; I cannot offer you a route through Austrian territory while Russia threatens the Balkans. Are you keeping both units out of Austria?

Russia remains the main threat. Can you use A LVN or another unit to pressure a Russian center this Fall? I will hold CON and SER and keep my forces out of German centers; please tell me whether your eastern units can disrupt Russia.
I hold F DEN after taking it this Spring; I’ll keep it this Fall, not attack another German center. Please don’t attack DEN from HEL or HOL. What are your plans for A HOL and F HEL?
I intend to hold F NOR and F DEN this Fall and keep my fleets clear of your centers. Please confirm you’ll keep your forces out of Norway and English centers as before.

Russia has gained no northern center this turn, but is at nine and remains the leading threat. Are you planning to take CON and SER back this Fall? I can’t reach Russian centers, but I’ll keep Norway secure.
