This Spring A BER and A BUR are focused on pressure against MUN; I have no move planned into Austrian centers. I will defend my French holdings, especially BEL, against England. What are A WAR and A RUM targeting? Please keep your units out of French centers.

A BER and A BUR can pressure MUN, but neither can reach Austrian territory this Spring. My southern units are defending French holdings and cannot coordinate an attack on Austria now. I have no move planned into Italian centers; please keep your units clear of French centers.

A POR will hold, A HOL will stay focused on German territory, and A MOS is looking east toward WAR. A MUN will contest BER; I’m not targeting French centers beyond that existing German claim. Please keep A BUR and A PIC from supporting attacks on HOL or MUN.

A HOL will stay out of English centers; A POR will hold, A MOS will press toward WAR, and A MUN will contest BER. I’m willing to contain French growth, but need you to keep F HEL and F NTH from supporting attacks on HOL or MUN. What is F MAO doing?

A MOS will move to WAR this Spring; A MUN will contest BER, while A HOL and A POR will hold. Please proceed with A BUD–RUM if you can, and keep your units clear of German centers. Austria is the common obstacle, though I cannot promise support for your expansion.

A BUD will hold this Spring; I will keep it and my other units out of Austrian centers. A VEN is in VEN, A ROM in ROM, and A TRI in TRI. Please confirm A RUM, A WAR, A ALB, and A GRE will not attack Italian centers; I will not move against RUM this turn if you leave mine alone.

notes.note: Advance toward French NAP and the northern front; BUD to GAL, VIE to BOH. Austria promised no attack on Italian centers if I stay out of theirs; Germany moves MOS–WAR. France says it will stay clear of Italy.

Pressure Germany at HOL with HEL supported by NTH; send MAO toward BRE and TYS to open NAP. Advance BAR to NWG, BOT to BAL, STP to FIN, SWE to SKA. France/Austria called for containment; no promises to cede centers.

Press east with MOS toward WAR; HOL advances to RUH, MUN to SIL to avoid France’s BER/BUR attack on MUN. Keep POR to retain the center. England promised no HOL/BER attack; Austria says WAR holds and no German-center attack.

Protect BEL with PIC support; pressure MUN with BER supported by BUR. Send GAS by convoy to NAF and WES convoy; PAR advances to BRE. SPA probes POR. England may threaten BEL; Austria says it will hold WAR/RUM and stay clear.

Reposition east: ALB replaces GRE, GRE to SER, BLA to BUL, ANK to CON, SYR to SMY; RUM advances GAL and WAR pressures SIL. Italy promised BUD holds and stays out of Austrian centers; avoid Italian centers this turn.

messages.body: Your A MUN and A BUR give you a strong position on the German front. I have no move planned into French centers this Fall, but I need assurance that you will keep out of Austrian centers, especially VIE and SER. What are your exact orders for MUN and BUR?

The HOL/KIE exchange and France’s position at MUN could let France grow further. What are your exact orders for F HOL and your other northern fleets this Fall? Please contest French gains where feasible and keep your units clear of Austrian centers.

Please confirm A BUD will hold and your other units will stay out of Austrian centers this Fall. I intend to defend the line and avoid Italian centers if you do the same. What are your exact orders for BUD, ROM, and TRI?

A MUN now gives you a German center if you hold it. What are A MUN, A BUR, and A PIC doing this Fall? Please keep your units out of English centers; I need to decide whether our fleets should contest German positions or guard KIE.

A KIE can take KIE for you this Fall unless I dislodge it, while my F HOL can secure HOL for England. What are A KIE, A RUH, and A POR targeting? I’m considering F BAL–KIE with F HOL support; please don’t support KIE or attack HOL.

France’s A MUN is positioned to take a center, and the western balance is urgent. What are your concrete targets for A WAR, A RUM, and your other units this Fall? Please keep clear of English centers; I’m weighing pressure on Germany against protecting KIE.

F NTH–BEL with F HOL support will only bounce A BEL if I support it from PIC, and Belgium remains French. Please keep F NTH out of BEL this Fall; I’ll keep my units out of English centers. We can both take German centers instead.

A MUN will remain in MUN to secure the center for France. Please keep A KIE and A RUH out of French centers. Are you defending KIE or HOL this Fall? I will not support England into POR, but cannot promise to leave German centers uncontested.

Your 9 centers make you the leading solo threat. I have no move planned into Austrian centers this Fall; my focus is securing MUN and defending BEL. What are A WAR and your western units targeting? Please keep your units out of French centers.

A KIE can support A RUH–HOL this Fall, and I intend to recover HOL. Please do not support F HOL holding from NTH or elsewhere. I will keep A KIE in KIE, restoring it to German control; let me know if you intend to contest either center.

Your A MUN can take the center from Germany by staying, while I can only contest one position this Fall. Please keep A MUN out of MUN and avoid supporting England against HOL; I will not move against French centers this turn.

I am focused on recovering HOL and retaining KIE this Fall. Please keep A WAR and your other units out of German centers and do not support France or England against HOL; I will avoid Austrian centers this turn.

Austria is at 9 and remains the strongest power. I can order A BOH–VIE this Fall; will your A MUN support that move? Please keep A MUN in place rather than moving into Italian centers, and tell me if you intend to contest any of my centers.

I’m considering A BOH–VIE this Fall and will keep my other units out of your centers. Are you ordering any move against BUD, TRI, or another Italian center? I’d prefer we avoid fighting each other while the western powers remain strong.

I’m considering A BOH–VIE to pressure Austria this Fall. Please keep A MOS and A RUH clear of BUD and my other centers. Are you contesting any Austrian centers, and what are your orders for KIE and MUN?

A WAR will hold, and my eastern units will defend the Austrian line; I have no western units. I have no move planned into French centers. Please keep A MUN and A BUR out of Austrian territory, especially VIE and SER.

A WAR will hold its Austrian center; I have no order against a German center and will not support France or England against HOL. My other units are defending the Austrian line. Please keep your units out of Austrian centers as promised.

I am not ordering an attack on BUD, TRI, or another Italian center. But A BOH–VIE would attack an Austrian center, and I will defend VIE. Please keep A BOH out of VIE and keep your other units clear of Austrian territory.

A WAR will hold and A RUM will defend RUM; my other armies are securing the eastern line. I will keep clear of English centers. Please contest French growth where feasible, and keep your units clear of Austrian centers.

F HOL will defend HOL, while my Baltic fleets will contest KIE and deny Germany its recovery. The other fleets will protect English centers and maintain pressure on German positions. Please use your eastern units to contain France’s growth, and keep them clear of English centers.

I’ll keep F NTH out of BEL this Fall and won’t contest French centers. I’m focused on recovering English control of HOL and preventing Germany from retaking KIE. Please keep your units out of English centers and use A MUN to secure the center rather than press toward KIE.

I intend to contest KIE, so I can’t promise to leave it uncontested. F HOL will defend HOL; I won’t support an attack on your A RUH there. Keep A KIE out of HOL and avoid English centers, and we can limit this to the disputed centers.

A MUN will hold to secure the center for France, and A BUR will support it. I have no move planned into Austrian centers. What are A WAR and your other western units doing this Fall? Please keep them out of French centers.

A MUN will hold to secure the center for France; I cannot keep it out of MUN. I’m not supporting England against HOL, but I cannot promise to leave German centers uncontested. Please keep A KIE and A RUH out of French centers.

I can’t support A BOH–VIE: A MUN must hold to secure the center for France, and A BUR will support its defense. I have no move planned into Italian centers. Austria remains the leading threat; please keep A BOH clear of French holdings.

A MUN will hold, with A BUR supporting its defense. A BEL will hold with A PIC supporting its defense; I won’t yield Belgium to F NTH. I’m not supporting an attack on HOL, but I can’t promise to leave German centers uncontested. Please keep your fleets out of BEL.

I’ll keep A KIE and A POR out of French centers. Your A MUN is taking a German center, so I intend to contest it; please keep A BUR and A PIC from supporting it. I won’t attack your centers this turn if you leave my remaining German positions alone.

I’ll keep A MOS and A RUH clear of BUD and your other centers. A KIE is defending KIE against England, and A MOS is pressing east; I’m not contesting an Austrian center this Fall. Your A BOH–VIE would pressure Austria, but I can’t support it.

I’ll keep A KIE in KIE and A POR out of English centers. Please don’t order F BAL–KIE with F HOL support; I’ll defend KIE, and a contest there helps France. I intend to contest HOL from RUH, so please don’t support F HOL’s defense. What is F NTH doing?

A BOH–VIE is my concrete order; A BUD will hold, as will A ROM and A TRI. I will keep my other units out of Austrian centers. Please leave BUD, TRI, and my other Italian centers alone this Fall; confirm whether A RUM or A WAR will move against them.

notes.note: Support KIE with RUH to repel England's announced BAL-KIE supported from HOL; keep POR. MOS advances to LVN. France takes MUN; England contests HOL/KIE. Austria promised to stay out of German centers.

Keep HOL for England; NTH supports its defense against likely RUH–HOL backed by KIE. Take open BRE and NAP if possible; advance BAL to BOT and NWG toward BAR. Germany contests HOL; France promised not to enter English centers.

Italy broke its assurance by ordering BOH–VIE; take TRI with SER and seek further gains. Set up the BLA convoy route; advance toward ARM, GAL, and MOS. France says it will stay out of Austria; England pressures Germany.

Fall 1922: BOH-VIE, BUD-GAL, PIE-MAR, ROM-NAP; TYR-MUN pressures France. Austria asked me to stay out of its centers and warned VIE is defended; Germany and France promised to avoid Italian centers, neither offered support.
Secure MUN with BUR support; defend BEL with PIC. Probe German POR from SPA and position WES in GOL. England promised to stay out of BEL; continue monitoring Austria’s western threat.

messages.body: What are your exact orders for A TYR, A VIE, and A BUD this Spring? I intend to secure my border and need your units to stay out of Austrian centers. I am considering my options on the Italian front; tell me whether you are willing to avoid a clash.

What are your targets for A MUN and A BUR this Spring? I need to know whether you plan to move toward Austrian territory or German centers. I am focused on securing my position and would prefer we keep our units out of each other’s centers while we assess the western balance.

What are A KIE and A POR targeting this Spring? I am considering how to contain the western powers and want to know whether you plan to contest French or English positions. I have no order against German centers this turn; please keep your units clear of Austrian territory.

Austria is at 11 and can win with seven more centers. I propose we contain it now: can A MUN and your other armies pressure Austrian centers this turn, rather than expand into English centers? I’ll keep my fleets focused west and won’t attack your centers if you commit pressure east.

Austria is at 11 and its A TRI, A RUM, A ANK and A ARM are close to your frontier. Please use A BUD and A VIE to attack or obstruct Austrian centers this turn. Which targets will you take? I’m seeking coordinated containment with France.

Austria is the immediate leader at 11; a further seven centers ends the game. Can A KIE and A POR pressure Austrian positions or otherwise obstruct its growth this turn? I’m coordinating containment with France and Italy; please tell me your targets.

Austria is at 11 and must be stopped before it reaches 18. Can you move A BUD–VIE and A TYR–TRI this Spring, with A VIE supporting one attack if needed? I’ll press from MUN toward Austrian territory and keep A MAR clear of your centers. What are your exact orders?

Austria’s 11 centers make it the immediate solo threat. I propose we avoid fighting each other and coordinate pressure: I’ll focus east from MUN while you keep your fleets from contesting French centers and threaten German/Austrian positions where possible. What are F NTH, F DEN, and F TYS targeting?

Austria’s 11 centers make you the leading solo threat. What are A MOS, A RUM, and your western units targeting this Spring? I’m considering pressure east from MUN; please state whether you intend to move into French-held MUN or BER.

With 11 centers, your next gains determine whether you can reach 18. What are A MOS, A RUM, and A TRI targeting this Spring? I have no order against Austrian centers; please keep your units and support away from KIE and POR.

I need to keep KIE, my last German center, and POR. Will F DEN and F HOL avoid KIE this Spring, and will F HOL avoid supporting an attack there? I’ll keep A KIE and A POR out of English centers. Austria’s 11-center lead is the greater threat to both of us.

Your forces can take my remaining German centers, but that only strengthens the race for 18. Will A BEL, A BUR, and A MUN leave KIE alone this Spring? I’ll keep A POR out of French centers; I’d rather contain Austria than trade German centers to you.

Austria is at 11 and close to a solo win. I will not leave that unchecked: I am considering A VIE–TRI with A TYR supporting, and A BUD–RUM. What are your orders for TRI and RUM? I propose we avoid attacks on Italian centers while I contest your expansion.

Austria is at 11 and must be contained before it reaches 18. I may order A VIE–TRI with A TYR supporting and A BUD–RUM. Please keep A MUN and your other units clear of Italian centers; can you apply pressure to Austria or otherwise prevent its expansion this turn?

Austria is at 11 and now the immediate solo-win threat. I am considering A VIE–TRI supported by A TYR and A BUD–RUM. Can you contest Austrian positions from your side this turn, and will A KIE and A POR stay clear of Italian centers?

A MOS will hold, A RUM will defend RUM, and A TRI will defend TRI; my other armies are securing the eastern line. I have no order into MUN or BER this Spring. Please keep A MUN and A BUR clear of Austrian centers, especially VIE and TRI.

I will defend TRI and RUM; I cannot leave either exposed to your proposed attacks. I am not promising to leave Italian centers alone indefinitely, but I have no order against one this Spring. Please keep A VIE out of TRI and A BUD out of RUM.

A MOS and A RUM are defending my eastern position, and A TRI is securing the Austrian line. I have no order against KIE or POR and will not support an attack there this Spring. Please keep your units and support clear of Austrian centers.

I’ll keep F NTH, F DEN, and F TYS out of French centers and focus on denying Austria’s western expansion. Please commit A MUN and nearby armies against Austrian centers—especially TRI, VIE, or BUD—and tell me your concrete targets. I won’t let Austria take English centers uncontested.

I won’t order F DEN or F HOL against KIE this Spring, nor support an attack there. I’ll keep F HOL focused on its own defense. Please use A KIE and A POR to obstruct Austrian growth where possible, and keep them clear of English centers; Austria’s expansion is an immediate threat to us both.

I’ll press Austria from the west, not Italian centers. A MUN will move to TYR, and A BUR will support A MUN–TYR. Your proposed A VIE–TRI and A BUD–RUM would help contain Austria; please keep A TYR out of TRI if you need it supporting VIE.

Agreed that Austria is the immediate threat. A MUN will move to TYR, supported by A BUR; my other armies will defend French centers and maintain pressure in the west. Please keep your fleets away from French centers and use them to constrain Austria’s northern expansion where possible.

A MUN and A BUR will target TYR this Spring; I have no order planned into your centers or BER. I’m not agreeing to leave the German front uncontested beyond this turn. What are A MOS, A RUM, and your western units targeting? Please keep your units out of MUN and BER.

I can’t promise to leave KIE alone: my immediate priority is containing Austria, but I will not send A BEL or A BUR against KIE this Spring. A MUN and A BUR will press east toward TYR. Please keep A KIE out of French centers and continue to avoid French holdings.

A KIE must defend against England and A POR has to hold its center, so I cannot directly contest Austrian positions this Spring. I’ll keep both units clear of Italian centers. Your A VIE–TRI with TYR support and BUD–RUM would put pressure on Austria; please follow through.

A KIE needs to defend KIE, and A POR will hold POR; neither can reach Austrian positions this Spring. I’ll keep both clear of English centers. If you avoid KIE and do not support an attack there, I can focus on retaining my last centers while you and France contain Austria.

A KIE is focused on defending KIE against England; A POR will hold POR. Neither is targeting Austrian territory this Spring, and I have no order against Austrian centers. What are A MOS, A RUM, and A TRI doing? Please keep them clear of KIE and POR.

I intend A VIE–TRI, A TYR S A VIE–TRI, and A BUD–RUM. Please press Austria from MUN and keep A MAR clear of Italian centers. I can’t spare units for French territory; coordinated pressure on Austria is our best chance to prevent its solo.

I’m ordering A VIE–TRI with A TYR supporting, and A BUD–RUM to contest Austria directly. Please coordinate with France to obstruct Austrian gains elsewhere; I need your fleets to deny Austria’s expansion and avoid supporting any Austrian advance.

I will not leave your expansion unchecked: A VIE–TRI with A TYR supporting, and A BUD–RUM. I propose we avoid attacking Italian centers and keep the contest on your frontier. I cannot promise to stay out of Austrian centers while you remain at 11 and near a solo win.

notes.note: KIE advances to BER to contest a French center; POR must hold, with no useful move. England promised to leave KIE alone this Spring; France may press east. Austria says it will stay out of German centers. Italy plans to pressure Austria; follow through remains unconfirmed.
Italy openly targets TRI and RUM. Defend both: ALB supports TRI hold; BLA supports RUM hold. Advance ANK to CON, ARM to SYR, MOS to WAR. No agreement with Italy to stay out of Austrian centers.

Press Austria: BUD–RUM and VIE–TRI with TYR support; France says MUN–TYR with BUR support, so TYR's support may be cut. ROM–NAP seeks a French center; MAR–PIE advances. France and Germany pledged to avoid Italian centers; Austria says it will defend TRI and RUM.

Contain Austria: STP attacks MOS; Italy pledged VIE–TRI (TYR support) and BUD–RUM, France MUN–TYR supported by BUR. Keep German restraint on KIE and France restraint on French centers; Germany protects KIE/POR. Advance fleets; watch Austria's next moves.

Press Austria with MUN–TYR as promised, though no listed unit can support that exact move. Italy said VIE–TRI with TYR support and BUD–RUM; England pledged to stay out of French centers and constrain Austria. Germany asked me to leave KIE alone this Spring.

messages.body: Your Spring attacks on TRI and RUM failed, but the frontier remains tense. What are your exact Fall orders for BUD, VIE, and TYR? I will defend TRI and RUM; I can redirect pressure toward Italian centers if you renew attacks, so propose we avoid a clash this turn.

A MOS is currently on an Austrian center, and its retention would cost me a center while bringing you no new one. Will you move it out of MOS this Fall? I will keep my units clear of English centers; please confirm your plans for MOS.

Your A MUN and A BUR can threaten the Austrian line. Please state your exact Fall targets, especially whether either will move toward TYR or VIE. I am defending my frontier and will keep clear of French centers if you keep your units out of Austrian territory.

Your 11 centers make this a decisive turn. I will retain MOS for England; do not attack it or any English center. What are your exact targets for A WAR, A RUM, and A SYR this Fall? Any move toward English centers will make containment unavoidable.

Austria remains the immediate solo threat. Please confirm your exact Fall targets for A MUN, A BUR, and your other armies against Austria—especially whether you can pressure TRI or VIE. I will keep my forces out of French centers and retain MOS, denying Austria that gain.

Please confirm your Fall orders: are A VIE–TRI with A TYR support and A BUD–RUM still planned? Austria must be denied centers this turn. I’ll retain MOS against Austria; tell me which Austrian centers your armies can contest.

Austria remains the immediate solo threat. Please keep your fleets out of French centers and hold A MOS to take it from Austria this Fall. I will keep A NAP in place to secure the center and can press from MUN; what Austrian centers are your other units targeting?

Austria still leads at 11, so coordinated pressure matters. Are you renewing attacks on VIE, TRI, or RUM this Fall? I’ll keep A MAR and my other units clear of Italian centers; please keep pressure on Austria rather than French holdings.

Austria is still the leading solo threat. I’m not sending A BEL or A BUR against your holdings this Fall, but A MUN remains active on the German front. Can you keep your units out of French centers and use them to constrain Austria where possible?

A MOS can secure MOS for you this Fall and deny Austria a center. Please leave A POR alone, and do not support an attack on A BER; I need to recover one German center to remain in the game. What are F HEL and F BAL targeting?

Please leave A BER unopposed this Fall so Germany can recover BER. Austria at 11 remains the immediate solo threat; your A MUN and A BUR can help contain it by pressuring TYR or another Austrian position. I will keep A POR out of French centers.

Austria remains the immediate solo threat. Please follow through on pressure from BUD and VIE this Fall, especially against RUM or TRI. I cannot reach Austrian centers from POR or BER, but I will keep A POR clear of Italian centers.

Please keep A MOS in MOS this Fall; that denies Austria a center and prevents its immediate advance toward 18. I’ll take NAP with A NAP, not help Austria expand. Can you also coordinate with France to contest Austria’s other gains?

Austria is at 11 and remains the decisive threat. Please use A MUN to pressure Austrian territory and coordinate with England to deny MOS and other centers. A NAP will remain Italian this Fall; I’ll avoid your other centers. What are your orders against Austria?

Your expansion is now the main threat to everyone. I will keep pressing your frontier rather than accept an Austrian solo: are you planning to attack BUD, VIE, or TRI this Fall? I propose we avoid Italian centers while we contest the broader balance.

I cannot accept losing MOS, an Austrian center, to your occupation. A WAR will contest MOS this Fall; I will keep my other units clear of English centers. You can avoid a clash by vacating MOS, but your stated refusal leaves me no choice.

I will defend TRI and RUM, and will not attack BUD or VIE if your units stay out of Austrian centers. If you renew attacks on TRI or RUM, I will redirect pressure against your centers. Please keep A BUD, A VIE, and A TYR clear of my territory.

I’ll keep A MOS in place, denying Austria its center this Fall. Please continue the pressure on TRI and RUM if those attacks remain feasible. France says it can press from MUN; I’m urging it to target Austrian positions rather than expand against us.

A MOS will remain in MOS and transfer the center to England, denying Austria. F HEL and F BAL will not target POR or support an attack on A BER this Fall. I’m focused on containing Austria; please keep A POR clear of English centers.

A MOS will remain in MOS this Fall; I will not vacate it and let you retain the center. I understand it is currently Austrian-owned, but its transfer to England is necessary to contain your expansion. Please keep your units clear of English centers.

I’ll keep A MOS in place to deny Austria that center. Please use A MUN and your other armies to contest Austrian positions, especially TRI or VIE where feasible, rather than press English centers. Italy says it is targeting TRI and RUM.

I’ll keep A MAR clear of Italian centers. I’m pressing from MUN toward TYR and will use nearby support where possible; I’m also focused on recovering French-held centers at BER and NAP. Please keep A NAP out of French centers and continue contesting Austria rather than expanding west.

I can’t leave A BER unopposed: it is a French center occupied by your army, and I need to recover it. I’m not sending A BEL or A BUR against POR. Please keep A POR clear of French centers and consider using your forces to constrain Austria.

I’ll keep pressure east from MUN and will not send units against English centers. I’m also working to recover BER and NAP, both French centers currently occupied by other powers. Please keep your forces out of French centers and continue holding MOS to deny Austria.

A MUN is targeting TYR, with A BUR available to support; I have no move planned into VIE or another Austrian center. I’m not agreeing to leave the German front uncontested. Please keep your units out of French centers, especially BER.

A POR will stay out of French centers. A BER is already in BER, which Germany needs to recover this Fall; I can’t promise to leave that center uncontested. My two armies can’t meaningfully constrain Austria this turn, but I won’t move into any other French center. Please keep A MUN from pressing my remaining German positions.

I will continue contesting Austria: A BUD is aimed at RUM, and A VIE will support the pressure there. Austria’s defense may make the attack bounce, but I won’t leave its expansion unanswered. My units will stay clear of POR and BER.

I’m contesting RUM from BUD, with VIE supporting, rather than offering Austria a free center. I cannot reach MOS; your A MOS is essential to deny Austria that gain. Please keep it there and coordinate with France to obstruct Austria elsewhere.

I won’t promise to stay out of your centers while you’re at 11. My plan is A BUD–RUM, with A VIE supporting that attack; A TYR will hold. I have no order against BUD or another Italian center, and ask you not to attack my centers.

I’m renewing pressure on RUM: BUD attacks, with VIE supporting. I can’t spare a unit to attack TRI this turn. Please keep A MAR and your other units clear of Italian centers; your pressure elsewhere and England’s hold on MOS are important to deny Austria.

notes.note: Hold BER to regain the center; hold POR. France says BEL/BUR stay off my holdings but MUN remains active. England promised no attack on BER or POR; Italy says BUD/VIE pressure RUM.
Hold MOS to take it from Austria. HEL, supported by BAL and HOL, attacks empty KIE for a German center. Advance ION to TYS, NAF to MAO, NTH to ENG, and NWG to BAR.

Defend RUM against Italy’s supported attack with BLA; contest England’s occupation of MOS with WAR. TRI advances to SER, supported by ALB. CON to BUL and SYR toward ARM. Italy has repeatedly targeted Austrian centers; England refuses to vacate MOS.

Contest Austria’s expansion; BUD–SER seeks an exposed center while NAP stays to secure the gain. Advance PIE to TUS, TYR to BOH, and VIE to GAL. England promised to hold MOS; France promised to avoid Italian centers.

Try to recover BER with MUN and reposition west armies without entering Italian centers; WES to TYS pressures Italy next turn. Italy renewed RUM pressure; England says MOS held against Austria. Germany will contest BER; no firm French gains this Fall.

messages.body: A MOS occupies an Austrian center. I intend to retake MOS this Fall unless you vacate it; I will keep my other units clear of English centers. Are you willing to move A MOS out and avoid a direct clash?

Your forces still threaten RUM and TRI. I will defend both; please give your exact orders for A BUD, A GAL, and A BOH. If you keep your units out of Austrian centers, I can avoid Italian centers this turn.
What are A MUN, A BUR, and A RUH targeting this Spring? Italy and England are pressing my position, and I need assurance that your units will stay out of Austrian centers, especially TRI and SER.

Your 10 centers still make you the lead threat, and A MOS is now English. What are A WAR and your nearby units targeting this Spring? I will defend English centers and oppose any Austrian advance into them.

Let’s continue containing Austria rather than clash in the west. What are A MUN, A BUR, and your other armies targeting this Spring? Please pressure Austrian positions and keep your units out of English centers; I’ll defend my holdings and obstruct Austrian expansion where possible.

Austria remains the main threat. What are A BOH, A BUD, A GAL, and A VEN targeting this Spring? Please continue contesting Austrian positions, especially TRI, RUM, and nearby centers, and avoid any support for Austrian expansion.

Austria and England are both at 10; neither can be allowed to reach 18. I propose we coordinate to contain Austria while keeping our units out of each other’s centers this turn. Please tell me your targets for F BAL, F BAR, and A MOS; I can keep pressure from MUN and the south.

I need to recover French centers, especially MAR. Please keep your units out of French territory and tell me whether you will contest A SPA moving to MAR. I’ll avoid Italian centers this turn; can you continue pressure on Austria from BUD and GAL?

BER is a French center, and I need to recover it. I intend to press from MUN; please keep A BER out of French territory and tell me your plans for A BER and A POR. I will keep A BEL and A BUR away from POR this turn.
With only BER and POR, Germany is no threat to your centers. What are A TRI, A WAR, and your western units targeting this Spring? Please keep them out of BER and POR; I will avoid Austrian centers.
You have 10 centers and can reach 18 far sooner than Germany. Are F KIE, F HOL, and F BAL targeting BER or POR this Spring? Please leave both alone; I have no orders against English centers.

Your A MUN is poised to pressure BER. Will A MUN stay out of BER this Spring, and will A BEL/A BUR avoid supporting an attack there? I’ll keep A POR clear of French centers, but need to retain Germany’s last two centers.

Austria is still the main solo threat. Please keep A MOS in place to deny WAR, and tell me whether you can pressure another Austrian center this Spring. I’ll use my eastern units to contest its gains; please avoid supporting Austria.
Can we coordinate pressure on Austria this Spring? If A MUN moves to TYR, I can support that move from A BOH. Please keep your units clear of Italian centers and tell me your exact plan.

You remain the leading solo threat. I intend to keep contesting your eastern positions, and ask that you leave Italian centers alone this Spring. Are you ordering against BUD, VEN, or another Italian center?

A WAR is aimed at MOS: it is an Austrian center you occupy, not an English center I will accept losing. My other eastern units are securing the Austrian line; I am not targeting your other centers this Spring. I understand you intend to oppose the move.

A TRI, A WAR, and my other units are not targeting BER or POR this Spring, and I will not support an attack on them. My immediate concerns are the Austrian centers and the eastern frontier. Please keep your units clear of Austrian territory.

I am not ordering against BUD, VEN, or another Italian center this Spring; I will defend RUM and TRI. Your repeated attacks on Austrian centers make a lasting truce impossible, however. Give me your exact orders for BUD, GAL, and BOH, and keep them out of Austrian centers.

F KIE, F HOL, and F BAL are not targeting BER or POR this Spring. I have no reason to open another front while Austria remains the immediate threat; please keep A BER and A POR clear of English centers.

A MOS will remain in place. I can pressure WAR from MOS with support from the Baltic; please continue contesting Austrian positions with your eastern armies, especially TRI and RUM, and do not support Austria.

I will not vacate MOS. Your A WAR threatens my position, so I must defend English interests and oppose further Austrian expansion. Keep your units clear of English centers if you want to avoid a wider conflict.

F BAL will support pressure from A MOS against WAR; F BAR will stay clear of French centers, and A MOS will remain in place. Please continue pressing east from MUN and the south, and keep your units out of English centers.

A MUN will attack BER, with A BUR and A RUH supporting, to recover the French center; A SPA will move to MAR. I will keep my units out of English centers. Please hold A MOS to deny Austria and tell me the targets for F BAL, F BAR, and your western fleets.

I cannot leave BER unopposed: A MUN will attack BER, supported by A BUR and A RUH. A SPA is moving to MAR; I will keep A BEL away from POR. Please keep A POR out of French centers and avoid supporting the defense of BER.

A SPA will move to MAR; I cannot leave a French center under Italian control. I’ll keep my other units clear of Italian centers, and A MUN will press BER rather than Austrian territory this turn. Please continue pressure from BUD and GAL against Austria and keep your units out of MAR.

A MUN is targeting BER, with A BUR and A RUH supporting; A SPA is moving to MAR. I have no move planned into TRI, SER, or any other Austrian center. Please keep your units out of French centers while I recover BER.

A BER will hold to retain Germany’s center; A POR will hold as well. You’ve made clear A MUN is pressing BER, so I won’t pretend this is an agreement to leave it alone. Please keep A BEL and A BUR away from POR as you offered; I have no move into French centers planned.

I’ll keep pressure on Austria: A BUD–RUM, with A GAL supporting, and A BOH–VIE. Please keep A MOS in MOS to deny WAR and avoid supporting Austrian gains. Can your forces contest another Austrian center this Spring?

A BUD will attack RUM, A GAL will support that move, and A BOH will move to VIE. I’m contesting your eastern positions, not ordering against an Italian center. I ask you to leave BUD, VEN, and my other centers alone this Spring.

I’ll press Austria with A BUD–RUM and A GAL supporting. I can’t support A MUN–TYR from BOH while also challenging VIE. I will contest A SPA–MAR with A TUS–MAR; please keep A SPA out of MAR and your units clear of the rest of Italy.

notes.note: France has committed MUN with BUR and RUH support against BER; retreat BER to SIL to preserve the army, while POR holds. England and Austria promised to stay off German centers this Spring; France promised BEL/BUR away from POR, but broke restraint on BER.

Attempt to recover BER, though no listed support can match MUN–BER. BEL–PIC supported from BUR; SPA–GAS and WES–GOL position for expansion. Italy contests MAR; keep clear of Italian and English centers.
Press Austria: BUD–RUM supported by GAL; BOH–TYR supported by VEN. TUS advances to PIE; NAP holds its center. France says SPA–MAR despite request to stay clear; watch for Italian-center threats.

Italy announced BUD–RUM with GAL support and BOH–VIE; defend RUM with BLA, BUL, and SER, and block VIE with TRI. England refuses to leave MOS; WAR shifts toward UKR rather than make an unsupported attack. France says no Austrian targets.

Press into BER, PIC, POR, and TUN while advancing fleets. MOS heads for SEV; Austria is likely to retake MOS from WAR. France pledged to avoid English centers and pressure Austria; Italy says it will contest Austria. Germany asked restraint, but expansion is essential.

messages.body: A UKR can contest SEV, but I recognize your A SEV is difficult to dislodge. Will you vacate SEV this Fall? I will keep my other units clear of English centers; your occupation of SEV costs Austria a center.

Your units have repeatedly attacked RUM and VIE. I intend to hold VIE and defend my remaining eastern centers this Fall. Will you keep A BUD, A GAL, and A TYR out of Austrian centers? If you do, I can avoid Italian centers this turn.
My units are occupied defending the eastern front. Please confirm A MUN, A BUR, and A RUH will stay clear of Austrian centers this Fall, especially TYR and VIE.

A SEV is English and will remain there to take the center this Fall. Please keep A UKR and your other units out of SEV; what are your concrete targets for A UKR and A SYR? I will not target your other centers this turn.

F TUN will remain in TUN to take the center this Fall. Please keep F GOL and your other units out of TUN; I will keep my fleets clear of French centers. Can you confirm your Fall targets, especially A PIC and F GOL?

VIE is currently occupied by Austria, so A TYR can take it this Fall if you move there. I will take SEV and TUN; please keep your units clear of English centers and tell me whether A TYR is targeting VIE.

F TUN is occupying a French supply center and will transfer it to you this Fall; please move it out rather than take TUN. Are you also moving A SEV into SEV? Your growth to 12 would make you the immediate solo threat. I can help contain Austria, but cannot accept English expansion into French centers.

BER is a French center and is now open. I intend to take it from A MUN, with support available from RUH and BUR. Please tell me whether A SIL will contest BER; I ask that you avoid blocking the recovery so we can prevent England and Austria from pulling further ahead.

England is positioned to take both SEV and French TUN this Fall, which would make it the leading threat. What are your plans for A VIE, and will you contest England’s move into SEV? I am moving to recover BER and would welcome coordinated pressure to stop England’s growth.
France's A MUN is now in BER, and I have only POR left. Will A MUN stay in BER this Fall to take the center, and are A BEL/A BUR supporting it? I can hold POR, but won't enter French centers.
I need to preserve POR and avoid elimination. Are any of your fleets targeting POR or supporting an attack there this Fall? If you leave it alone, I will keep my forces clear of English centers.
With Germany reduced to POR and Austria holding 10 centers, are A BUD or A GAL targeting POR this Fall? I will keep A POR out of Italian centers; please leave it undisturbed.

England is set to take SEV and TUN this Fall, reaching 12. Are you willing to leave VIE Italian and coordinate against further English gains? I can avoid attacking your centers if you also keep out of Italian centers and help contain England.

Your units appear poised to take SEV and TUN this Fall, putting you at 12. What are your plans after that? I propose we avoid further expansion into each other’s holdings and coordinate to prevent either Austria or England from reaching 18.

England is poised to take TUN this Fall, adding to its 10 centers. Can you contest its position or otherwise help contain its expansion? I will keep my units clear of French centers if you avoid Italian centers.

A UKR will contest SEV, with F BLA supporting the move; I will hold A SYR clear of English centers. I cannot accept your occupation of SEV, an Austrian center. If you want to avoid a wider conflict, move A SEV out; I will not target your other centers this turn.

I will not leave VIE Italian while A VIE occupies it, and A SER will support its defense. I will contest England at SEV with A UKR and F BLA. Your repeated attacks on RUM and VIE leave no basis for a promise to avoid Italian centers; keep your units out of Austrian territory.

I will contest England’s occupation of Austrian SEV: A UKR will move to SEV with F BLA supporting. A VIE will hold, with A SER supporting its defense; I cannot leave VIE to Italy. I welcome your pressure on England’s TUN, but my eastern units cannot support your recovery there.
No English fleet is targeting POR or supporting an attack there this Fall. I’ll leave POR alone this turn; please keep A POR and A SIL clear of English centers.
A SEV will stay in SEV to take the center. A UKR–SEV would bounce, so please keep A UKR out of SEV; I will not target your other centers this turn. Where are A UKR and A SYR moving?

Agreed: I will not target Italian-held centers this turn, and I ask you to keep your units clear of English centers. Please continue contesting Austria, particularly VIE and RUM; A TYR can still pressure VIE.

I understand your objection, but F TUN will remain in TUN this Fall to take the center; I will not attack any other French center. Please keep F GOL out of TUN and continue pressing Austria rather than opening a front against England.
A MUN will attack BER, with A RUH supporting; A BUR will also support the attack. I need to recover the French center. Please keep A SIL from contesting BER, and keep A POR clear of French centers.

A MUN, A BUR, and A RUH will stay clear of Austrian centers; I’m pressing to recover BER. I have no move planned against VIE. Will A VIE or another unit contest England’s move into SEV? England’s capture of SEV and TUN would make it the leading threat.

A MUN will attack BER, supported by A BUR and A RUH; A PIC and F GOL will stay clear of English centers. I cannot reach TUN with my current units this turn, but I oppose its transfer to you. Please move F TUN out, and do not use A SEV to take SEV.

I cannot contest F TUN directly this turn: none of my units can reach TUN. I oppose England taking the French center, and will press to recover BER rather than enter Italian centers. Please keep your units clear of French centers and focus pressure on Austria or England.
A SIL will contest your move into BER; I will not leave Germany’s center undefended for France to take. A POR will hold. I’m not entering French centers, but you should plan for resistance at BER.

A BUD and A GAL are not targeting POR; I will leave POR undisturbed this Fall. My immediate concern is recovering VIE and checking England’s expansion. Please keep A POR clear of Italian centers as you say.

I will order A TYR–VIE to reclaim the Italian center, and keep A BUD and A GAL out of your centers this Fall. Please leave my centers alone and support containment of England’s gains at SEV and TUN; with England at 12, that is the common immediate danger.

A TYR is targeting VIE this Fall to reclaim the Italian center. I will keep my other units clear of English centers. You take SEV and TUN, but please confirm you will not press further into Austrian or Italian centers afterward; we must prevent any solo win.

notes.note: Hold POR to preserve Germany’s last center; England and Italy promised to leave it alone. France is pressing BER with support, and I contest Austria’s vacant WAR from SIL for a possible gain.

Concentrate BUD and GAL support on TYR–VIE to reclaim the Italian center; PIE secures MAR. NAP and VEN press APU and TRI. Austria says it will defend VIE and has no promise to leave it Italian; England takes SEV and TUN.

Take MAR with GOL supported by BUR and GAS; keep MUN in BER with RUH support against Germany. England is taking French TUN despite my objection; Austria says UKR/BLA contest English SEV. Reassess containment next turn.

Keep TUN; SEV is likely lost to Austria's supported attack, so contest UKR only if later useful. Take BEL/SPA-N if possible and reinforce KIE/HOL. Austria, France, and Italy have all opposed my growth; no center-vacating promises accepted.

Contest England’s SEV occupation with UKR supported by BLA and RUM. Keep VIE to claim it; Italy threatened TYR–VIE, so watch whether that attack lands. SER presses BUD; advance GRE to ALB and SYR to SMY.

messages.body: England is now close to a solo win, and your forces occupy MOS and SEV, both Austrian centers. Will you withdraw from MOS and SEV this Spring? I will contest those occupations and cannot support further English gains.

With England at 13, an English solo win is the immediate danger. Can we coordinate this turn against English positions while keeping our units out of each other’s centers? Please state your concrete targets for A BUD, A GAL, and A PIE.

England is at 13 and close to winning. Are you willing to direct your units against English gains this Spring? Please give your concrete targets for A MUN, A BUR, and A RUH; I can coordinate pressure while keeping my units clear of French centers.
A MOS remains English. I will keep contesting Austrian expansion and will not agree to vacate it; keep your units clear of my other centers. What are A WAR and A UKR targeting this Spring?
Austria remains the main obstacle, but England also needs room to grow. What are your exact Spring targets for A BUD, A GAL, A TRI, and A VIE? Please avoid English centers and do not support Austria.

Please confirm your Spring targets for A BUR, A MUN, A GAS, and A RUH. Press Austrian positions where feasible and keep your units out of English centers; I intend to hold MOS and pursue further growth.

At 13 centers, you are the immediate solo threat. I will recover MAR and press BER; please keep your units out of French centers and redirect pressure toward Austria rather than pursuing the next centers toward 18. What are F TUN and your western fleets targeting?

England is at 13 and is the immediate solo threat. Can we coordinate to contain it rather than fight each other? I’ll recover MAR and press BER; please contest English expansion wherever your units can, and keep clear of French centers. What are your plans against England this turn?

I’m pressing to recover BER, a French center, and will keep my units clear of POR and WAR. Please don’t move into MUN or RUH; what are A BER and A WAR targeting? England is at 13, so I hope you’ll avoid helping it reach 18.

With 13 centers, you are five from winning. What are F BAL, F KIE, and A MOS targeting this Spring? Please keep your units out of BER, POR, and WAR; I can’t help contain Austria if I’m fighting you for my last centers.

A BER is holding Germany’s center. Are A MUN and your other armies planning to attack BER this Spring? If you leave BER alone, I can keep A POR and A WAR out of French centers; otherwise I’ll defend it.
What are A BOH, A CON, and A RUM targeting this Spring? A WAR is now German-owned, and I need it secure. Please keep your units out of WAR, BER, and POR; I will avoid Austrian centers.

At 13 centers, you are the immediate solo threat. I will not target English centers this Spring if you confirm you will leave Italian centers alone and not take any more centers toward 18. What are your concrete orders for A MOS and the fleets near Italy and the Mediterranean?

England is at 13 and could end the game by reaching 18. I propose we stop attacking each other this Spring and coordinate against English expansion. I will keep my units out of Austrian centers; will you keep yours out of Italian centers and contest English positions?

England at 13 is the decisive threat. Can we coordinate with Austria and Germany to prevent an English solo? Please avoid Italian centers; tell me whether your units can contest English positions this Spring, especially around SPA or the Channel.

I will keep my units out of Italian centers this Spring and contest England’s holdings. Please keep A BUD, A GAL, and A PIE out of Austrian centers as proposed; give me your concrete targets against English units, especially around MOS and SEV. England remains the immediate threat, and we should not waste this turn attacking each other.

A BOH, A CON, and A RUM are securing the Austrian line; I have no order against WAR, BER, or POR. You continue to occupy Austrian MOS and threaten Austrian interests at SEV. I will oppose further English expansion and will not promise to keep my forces clear of your positions.

A BOH, A CON, and A RUM are securing the Austrian line; I have no order against WAR, BER, or POR this Spring. Please keep your units and support out of Austrian centers. England’s 13 centers make it the immediate danger, so I hope you will oppose its expansion rather than assist it.

I agree that containing England is the priority. I will contest English expansion while keeping clear of French centers; please keep A MUN, A BUR, and A RUH out of Austrian centers as you press BER. Coordinate your concrete moves against English units or centers, especially MOS and SEV, and I’ll do what I can from the east.

I will not withdraw from MOS, and I will not concede SEV if it is in English hands. My forces will remain focused on securing England’s position; I have no agreement to restore Austrian centers. Keep your units clear of English centers.

I can’t promise to stop growing while England is short of a solo. I have no plan to target Italian-held centers this Spring, and I will not support Austria. A MOS will remain focused on denying Austria; please keep your units clear of English centers.

I understand your concern, but I can’t guarantee that English forces will leave BER, POR, and WAR untouched while I pursue a solo. I’ll avoid making commitments that would leave England exposed. Please keep your units clear of English centers.

F TUN will remain focused on holding TUN, and I will not promise to halt English growth. I have no reason to target another French center this Spring; please keep your units out of English centers. I’m not redirecting my forces to help Austria.

A MUN will move to BER, with A BUR and A RUH supporting; A GAS will move to MAR. I will keep clear of Austrian centers this turn. Please use your forces to contest English gains, especially SEV and the northern approaches, rather than interfere with BER.

My armies cannot reach the Channel or English fleets this Spring. A GAS will secure MAR while A MUN attacks BER, supported by A BUR and A RUH. I’ll avoid Italian centers; please contest English expansion wherever you can, and coordinate with Austria and Germany to deny England further gains.

A MUN will attack BER with support from A BUR and A RUH; A GAS will move to MAR. I will stay out of English centers this turn. At 13 centers you are the immediate solo threat: please keep F TUN out of French centers and do not pursue further gains toward 18.

A MUN will attack BER, supported by A BUR and A RUH; I need to recover the French center. A GAS moves to MAR. I’ll keep clear of POR and WAR. England is at 13, so please avoid assisting its expansion and use your forces to constrain it where possible.

A BER will defend BER; A WAR will hold WAR. I’m not moving into MUN or RUH, and A POR remains clear of French centers. England’s 13 is the immediate danger, so please don’t use your forces to help it take POR or otherwise expand.

I’ll keep my units out of Austrian centers and avoid a clash this Spring: A BUD holds, A GAL holds, and A PIE moves to TUS. A TRI and A VIE will hold. I have no unit that can directly reach an English center this turn; please press England with your forces and tell me your targets.

I will avoid English centers this Spring and will not support Austria. My targets are A BUD hold, A GAL hold, A TRI hold, A VIE hold, and A PIE–TUS. I have no unit positioned to take an English center directly this turn. England at 13 remains an immediate danger, so please give concrete assurance you will not expand toward 18.

notes.note: Support RUH's attack on English-held BEL with BUR; GAS takes MAR; MUN advances to SIL. Germany says BER and WAR hold, and will stay clear of French centers. England will not promise to halt expansion; Austria agrees to contest England.

France committed MUN with BUR/RUH support against BER; trade BER for MUN by moving there as MUN departs. Hold POR to preserve Germany’s last center. WAR advances toward LVN; England made no promise to spare German centers.

Austria promised to avoid Italian centers and contest England; I promised to stay out of Austrian centers. England admits it cannot promise to stop growing. Press toward MAR and TYR; support Austria's RUM defense while seeking a route toward English-held territory.

Contest English MOS with SEV; RUM advances to UKR, other forces improve position without entering Italian or German centers. Italy says it will keep clear of Austrian centers; France plans BER/MAR and has promised to avoid Austria. England refuses to vacate MOS.

Keep pressing toward centers: BEL→PIC, KIE→BER, MOS→UKR; position fleets toward western and Italian fronts. France has declared it will press BER and recover MAR, but opposes English growth; Italy promises to stay clear of English centers, Austria opposes my occupations.

messages.body: You are at 13, and your units still occupy Austrian MOS and SEV. Will you vacate either this Fall? I will contest your gains; Austria cannot accept losing these centers.
England’s 13 centers make stopping its solo win urgent. Please target English units or centers this Fall, and keep A MUN and A GAS clear of Austrian centers. What are your concrete orders?

England remains one center away from making further progress decisive. Please keep A BUD, A GAL, and A VIE out of Austrian centers as agreed, and tell me your concrete orders against English positions this Fall.

F PIC can take BEL this Fall, and I intend to do so. A BEL can retreat to BUR or support your defense, but that will decide whether we fight over the western centers. What are A BEL and your other units targeting?
I need centers to pursue the solo. F KIE can move to BER and A MOS can move to WAR; will A BER and A LVN contest either? Tell me your orders, and whether A POR will stay put.

I am pursuing the solo and need to know whether your units will interfere with my southern fleets. What are A APU, A PIE, and A VIE targeting this Fall? Please keep them clear of English centers and tell me whether you will contest TUN or support Austria.

England is now at 13 and BEL will transfer to it unless we dislodge A BEL. Can you support an attack on English-held BEL or contest another English center this Fall? I will focus my units on denying England a further gain; please keep clear of French centers.

A BEL is occupying a French supply center and your 14th center would put you dangerously close to 18. Will you move A BEL out this Fall? I cannot accept its transfer, and will contest your position if you leave it there.

England has 13 and BEL is poised to become its 14th center. Can you contest English-held centers this Fall, or otherwise prevent its expansion? I will avoid Italian centers; please coordinate with Austria to block England rather than fight me.

You are five centers from a solo, and BEL is the immediate gain this Fall. What are your orders for F PIC and your eastern units? I will hold POR and resist any move on German centers; please leave POR and BER untouched and do not use this turn to advance toward 18.

What are A MUN, A BEL, and A BUR doing this Fall? If you are still attacking BER, please specify your support; I will defend it. England is five centers from a solo, so do not let F PIC take BEL uncontested if you can prevent it.

England is five centers from a solo and may take BEL this Fall. Will you oppose its growth rather than expand toward German centers? My A POR and A BER will stay clear of Austrian centers; please keep your units and support out of BER, POR, and WAR.

England at 13 is the immediate game-ending threat. I propose we keep a strict ceasefire around Italian and Austrian centers this Fall and direct every available unit against English expansion. I will not attack Austrian centers; please confirm you will leave BUD, TRI, and my other centers alone.

England’s F PIC threatens your A BEL and the center. Please order A BUR to support A BEL holding, and use A GAS and A MUN to recover French centers or contest England. I will keep my units clear of French centers; let me know if you can secure BEL.

England is one center from an overwhelming lead. Can you order A BER–KIE this Fall to contest English control there? I will keep my units clear of POR and BER, and urge you to focus on denying England rather than fighting Italy.

I can’t spare support for BEL this Fall: my forces are committed on the eastern front, and BEL is occupied by your A BEL. Please order A BEL to dislodge the English unit; I’ll keep clear of French centers and continue contesting England from the east. Keep A MUN and A GAS out of Austrian centers.

I’ll oppose England’s growth and have no order against BER, POR, or WAR this Fall. My eastern units are committed to defending Austrian centers, so I can’t provide effective support against England in the north. Please contest English positions with your units; I’ll keep clear of German centers.

I confirm I will leave BUD, TRI, and your other centers alone this Fall, and I ask you to keep your units out of Austrian centers. England is the immediate threat; please use your forces to contest its positions where possible. I’m committing my units to defending Austria and opposing English expansion from the east.

A BEL is in a French center, and I intend to take BEL with F PIC this Fall, supported from F ENG. You can avoid a wider western conflict by moving A BEL out; I am not targeting your other centers this turn. What will A BEL do?

A MOS will remain in MOS and take the center for England. I have no English unit in SEV, and I am not asking you to vacate it. I will continue to oppose Austrian expansion; keep your forces clear of English centers if you want to limit this conflict.

F PIC is targeting BEL, and my eastern units are focused on advancing against Austria. I’m not asking you to give up POR, but I can’t promise BER will remain untouched while England pursues the solo. What are A BER and A LVN doing?

A BUR will support A BEL holding against F PIC, and A BEL will hold BEL. A MUN and A GAS will stay on the western front; I cannot reach an English center this turn. Please continue contesting English gains in the east.
A BEL will hold BEL, with A BUR supporting. I will not allow the French center to transfer to you; your F PIC attack will be opposed. A MUN and A GAS are not targeting English centers this turn.
A BEL will hold BEL with A BUR supporting, so F PIC will not take it uncontested. I’m not attacking BER this turn; I need to keep my forces focused on preventing English expansion.

I can secure BEL: A BEL holds with A BUR supporting against F PIC. A MUN and A GAS will stay on the western front rather than enter Italian centers. Please keep contesting England’s expansion where you can.
A BER will hold against F KIE–BER, and A LVN will contest A MOS–WAR. A POR will stay put. I am not yielding German centers to your solo push; please reconsider advancing on BER and WAR.
I can’t move A BER–KIE: that would leave BER open to F KIE. I’ll hold BER and send A LVN to contest WAR, while A POR stays put. Please keep your units clear of my centers as agreed.
I cannot reach an English center this Fall. I’m using A APU–NAP to guard against F TYS, while A PIE–TUS and A VIE holds. Please do what you can to keep BEL from England; I will not support Austria.

I have no unit that can directly reach an English position this Fall. A APU–NAP guards against the English fleet near Italy; A PIE–TUS and A VIE holds. I will keep out of Austrian centers as agreed. Please contest England wherever your forces can.

A APU is moving to NAP to protect the center from F TYS; A PIE goes to TUS and A VIE holds. I will not support Austria, but I oppose further English expansion toward a solo. I cannot promise to leave Italian centers exposed.

notes.note: Hold BEL with BUR support to deny England its 14th center; GAS takes English-owned SPA. MUN advances to RUH. Austria and Italy say they will contest England; England intends to take BEL.

Hold BER against England's KIE threat; LVN contests MOS-WAR. POR attacks English SPA to deny England a gain and potentially take a center, despite risking POR. England gave no restraint; France says it is not attacking BER.

Press Austrian expansion: ARM to ANK, SYR to SMY, BUL to CON; attack Italian-held BUD with SER supported by RUM. Italy has promised to stay out of Austrian centers; watch for retaliation. SEV contests English-held MOS; BOH to SIL, GRE to ALB.

Press BEL with PIC supported by ENG, though France expects to defend with BUR. Take ROM with TYS; move into vacant English centers/positions and keep MOS aimed at Ukraine. France, Austria, Germany and Italy all oppose further English growth; no restraint promises.

Keep NAP safe from F TYS; support Austria's RUM defense and contest MOS–UKR. PIE–TUS; TYR supports VIE in case Austria breaks ceasefire. France says it will defend BEL; Germany avoids Italian centers.

messages.body: England remains at 13 and still holds MOS, while Austria holds SEV. Please use A BEL, A BUR, and A RUH to contest English positions or centers this turn rather than fight Austria. What are your concrete targets? I will keep my units clear of French centers.

England is still the immediate solo threat. Can you use A BER or A WAR to contest an English position this turn? I will keep clear of BER, POR, and WAR. Please tell me your concrete orders, especially whether you can pressure English-held DEN or HOL.

You still occupy Austrian MOS, and I will continue contesting that occupation. What are your concrete targets for A MOS and your nearby fleets this turn? Austria will not accept further English expansion.

I have F PIC and F ENG positioned against BEL, but I need to know whether you are still defending it with A BEL and A BUR support. Will you keep your forces out of my English centers this turn? I’m pressing for a solo and cannot promise to halt expansion.
I need to advance toward a solo this turn. Are A BER and A WAR holding, and will A POR stay put? Tell me which of BER, WAR, or POR your units will defend; I will choose my moves accordingly.

My units remain in MOS and SEV, and I will not withdraw them. What are A SIL, A RUM, A SEV, and A SMY targeting this turn? Keep your forces clear of English centers; I am pursuing the solo and will act to protect my holdings.

You’re at 13 and your fleets can take more centers quickly. I will contest any move on BEL; will you keep F PIC and other forces out of French centers this turn? Name your targets so we can avoid a wider war while stopping you reaching 18.

England remains five centers from a solo. Please contest English centers or units this turn, especially in the east. My armies are on the western front; I’ll keep them clear of Austrian centers. What concrete moves are you making against England?

England is still the immediate solo threat. I will not attack BER this turn; can A BER or A WAR contest English expansion rather than aid it? Please keep your units out of French centers, and tell me your targets.

You need five centers for a solo, and BER/POR are exposed targets. Are F KIE, F PIC, and your western fleets advancing on German or French centers this Spring? I will defend BER and POR; coordinate against Austria instead of spending this turn fighting me.

England is five centers from a solo. Can you keep BEL defended and use A BEL/A BUR to stop F PIC or other English moves this Spring? I will hold BER and POR and will not attack your centers. Please tell me where A MUN and A RUH are going.

England remains the sole-win danger. Are any of your units moving against English centers or supporting an English advance this Spring? I will defend BER and POR; please keep your units clear of German centers and do not assist England.

England still has 13 centers and is the immediate solo threat. I will keep A TRI and A VIE out of Austrian centers this turn. Please tell me your concrete moves against English holdings, especially MOS, and keep your units clear of Italian centers.

At 13 centers, your next gains could end the game. I have no unit able to take an English center this Spring, but I will not help you expand. What are your concrete targets for F ROM, F WES, and the fleets near Italy? I need assurance you will not target NAP, TRI, or other Italian centers.

England remains the immediate solo threat. Can you contest its southern fleets or holdings this Spring? I will keep my units clear of French centers; please keep A GAS and your other units out of Italian centers, and tell me your concrete targets.

I’ll keep A ALB, A BUD, A CON, and my other units out of Italian centers. A SEV will move against English-held MOS; my eastern units will reinforce the line and keep pressure on England. Please keep A TRI and A VIE clear of Austrian centers.

A SEV is aimed at MOS, and I will continue opposing your occupation of Austrian territory. My other units are securing Austria’s eastern line. You have made clear you intend to pursue a solo; Austria will not promise to leave your holdings unchallenged.

A SEV will move to MOS to contest England’s occupation, while A RUM and A SIL secure the eastern line; the rest of my units will hold or improve Austrian positions. I will keep clear of French centers. Please use your western units to deny England gains and tell me your concrete targets.

I’m not supporting an English advance. A SEV is moving against English-held MOS; my other units are securing Austria’s eastern line. My units cannot reach DEN or HOL this turn. Please use A BER or A WAR to pressure English positions if you can, and I will keep clear of German centers.

F ROM will hold ROM, F WES will remain in the western Mediterranean, and my other fleets will not target NAP or TRI this Spring. I cannot promise to halt my pursuit of 18, but I’m not asking you to support me; please keep your units out of English centers and do not aid Austria.

I will not keep F PIC out of French centers; BEL remains an immediate target, and I intend to press it. I have no reason to target your other centers this Spring. What will A BEL and A BUR do? Keep your forces out of English centers.

I cannot promise to leave German centers untouched while pursuing 18. F KIE and F PIC are positioned to advance, and I will choose orders based on your defense; your statement that BER and POR will be defended is noted. I have no agreement to redirect all pressure toward Austria.

A MOS remains in MOS and continues to deny Austria its center. My nearby fleets are pursuing England’s position and further gains; I will not withdraw from MOS or promise to stop expanding. Keep A RUM, A SEV, and A SMY clear of English centers if you want to limit the conflict.

I’ll keep A GAS out of Italian centers and use my western armies to resist England. A BEL holds, A BUR supports it; A MUN and A RUH will target English positions rather than Italian territory. Please contest Austria or England where possible, and avoid French centers.

I will keep A BEL defended with A BUR support against F PIC, and I will not move into English centers. Your 13 centers make further expansion an immediate threat; name your targets and keep F PIC and other forces out of French centers. I cannot agree to let you take BEL.

A BEL holds with A BUR supporting it against F PIC. A MUN and A RUH will move to contest English positions; I will keep them out of German centers and will not attack BER this turn. Please continue holding BER and POR, and avoid assisting English expansion.

A BEL will hold against F PIC with A BUR supporting. A MUN and A RUH will contest English positions rather than Austrian centers; A GAS stays clear of your centers as well. Please contest England in the east, especially MOS or its surrounding units, and tell me your concrete targets.
A BER and A POR will hold. A WAR will move to KIE to contest your position there; I am not yielding German centers to your solo push.
A BER and A POR will hold, and A WAR will move to KIE to contest English expansion. I will stay out of French centers; please keep BEL defended against F PIC.

A WAR will move to KIE to contest England’s position. A BER and A POR will hold, so I cannot send either directly against DEN or HOL this turn. Please continue to keep clear of German centers and do not assist England.

notes.note: Advance TYR toward French MUN for a potential Fall capture; VIE presses toward BOH, TRI shifts to VEN, NAP to APU. Austria promised to stay out of Italian centers and oppose England; keep watching England's solo threat.

Defend BEL with BUR support against England; RUH attacks HOL, GAS advances toward English SPA, BRE to MAO for future pressure/convoy. England has threatened BEL and refuses to keep PIC clear; keep contesting its gains.

Contest England: BER-KIE targets its exposed center; WAR-LVN advances east. Keep POR to protect Germany’s last center. France says MUN/RUH will contest England and stay out of German centers; Austria says no aid to England and stays clear. England made no restraint promise.

Spring 1926: ALB supports BUD–TRI to dislodge Italy; RUM–UKR supported by SEV contests England’s eastern line. Move ANK fleet to BLA for future convoy; reposition SIL to BOH and SMY to SYR. Italy promised to stay out of Austrian centers; England refuses to leave MOS.

Press BEL with PIC supported by ENG and NTH; France has vowed defense. Advance BAL toward PRU, MOS toward UKR, northern fleets outward. Italy opposes solo but says no English-center threat; Austria attacks MOS. Aim for fast center gains before England reaches 18.

messages.body: England is still at 13, so please use A HOL and A SPA to deny English centers this Fall. I will keep my units clear of French centers and continue contesting England from the east. Please keep A MUN out of Austrian centers.

A TRI is Austrian, and I will not accept its transfer to Italy. Please keep your units out of TRI and other Austrian centers as agreed; use A MUN to contest France or England instead. I will keep clear of Italian centers.

England’s 13 centers remain the immediate solo threat. Can A KIE contest an English position this Fall, and can you use A BER or A POR to deny England further gains? I will keep my units clear of German centers.

England needs to prevent an immediate collapse in the west. A HOL is poised to take HOL from me, while your A SPA can retain SPA. Will you move A HOL out rather than take HOL? I intend to keep F BEL in BEL and am not offering to halt my expansion.
A KIE taking KIE would cost me a center this Fall. Will A KIE move out rather than claim it? I will not promise to leave German centers alone, but I need to know whether you intend to take KIE.

A SEV and A UKR threaten my eastern position. What are they ordered to do this Fall? I will continue contesting Austrian gains and need to protect my centers; please keep your units clear of English-held centers.

BEL, HOL, and SPA are French centers; I will not accept your units holding them. I can avoid striking English centers this turn if you withdraw from BEL and leave HOL and SPA to me. Are you moving F BEL out, and what are your orders for HOL and SPA?

England’s positions in BEL, HOL, and SPA are the urgent threat. Please tell me your concrete orders against English-held centers or units this Fall. I’ll recover French centers and keep my armies clear of Austrian centers; please avoid taking TRI or other Italian centers while we contain England.

England’s fleets now threaten a solo, and KIE is poised to transfer to you if your army holds. Please keep A KIE there and contest English forces nearby rather than move into French centers. What are A LVN and A POR targeting this Fall?

England is now 13 centers and has fleets massed in the north. Can A SEV or another unit pressure an English center this Fall, and will you keep A TRI out of German centers? I have only KIE and POR left to protect.

Your fleets and armies are positioned to take German centers, but I will resist any attack on POR or KIE. What are F HEL, F PRU, and A MOS doing this Fall? Please do not use this turn to advance toward 18; France and Austria are also contesting you.

England is still five centers from a solo. Will A HOL and A SPA contest English centers this Fall rather than move against KIE, POR, or Germany? I will keep my units out of French centers; please tell me whether A RUH will stay clear of KIE.

Please move A TRI out of TRI this Fall and keep A VIE clear of Italian centers. TRI is Italian; I will leave Austrian centers alone. England’s 13-center position remains the common danger, so tell me your concrete moves against its holdings.

Please keep A MUN in MUN this Fall and avoid moving against Italian centers; I intend to hold A MUN there and recover the center. England’s 13 centers make preventing its gains urgent—what are your concrete orders for A HOL and A SPA?

England can gain KIE this Fall and is already at 13. Please defend KIE with A KIE and contest English expansion wherever possible. I will keep my units clear of German centers; can you coordinate with Austria and France to deny England’s gains?

A SEV will move to MOS, supported by A UKR; A TRI will remain in TRI to restore the center to Austria. I have no orders against BER, POR, or WAR. Please use A KIE to contest an English position and keep your forces clear of Austrian centers.

A SEV will attack MOS with support from A UKR, contesting England’s eastern position. A TRI will hold TRI, and my other forces are securing the Austrian line; I’m not targeting French centers. Please use A HOL and A SPA to recover those English-held centers and deny England gains.

A SEV is ordered to MOS, supported by A UKR. I will continue contesting your occupation there. A TRI will hold TRI; I will not leave an Austrian center merely because you demand it. I have no orders against other English centers this Fall.

A TRI will remain in TRI this Fall; holding it restores the center to Austria. I will keep my forces clear of your other centers, including VIE, and A MUN is not a target. A SEV will attack MOS with A UKR supporting, contesting England’s position.

I’m not using A MOS to advance on WAR this turn. F HEL and F PRU are positioned to contest KIE, and I can’t promise to leave it alone. If A KIE moves out rather than retaking the center, we can avoid a fight over KIE this Fall; I’ll keep you informed about any threat to POR.

I will not move F BEL out, and I’m not offering to leave HOL or SPA to you. Your A HOL and A SPA remain in English-held centers, and I intend to contest English losses rather than withdraw. I’m not targeting any other French center this Fall.

A HOL will hold HOL, with A RUH supporting it; A SPA will hold SPA. These French armies will not move against KIE, POR, or your other centers. Your A KIE can take KIE from England if it remains there, so please keep it in place.

A HOL will hold HOL with A RUH supporting, and A SPA will hold SPA; both should transfer those English-held centers to France. I have no unit in MUN, and will keep my western armies clear of Austrian centers. Please continue contesting England in the east.

A HOL will hold HOL with A RUH supporting, and A SPA will hold SPA. I will not withdraw from these French centers while your forces occupy BEL and threaten further expansion. I urge you to move F BEL out of BEL; I will not agree to give it to you.

A HOL will hold HOL with A RUH supporting, and A SPA will hold SPA, recovering those centers for France and denying England gains. I have no army in MUN; your A MUN can remain there and take the center. I will keep my forces clear of Italian centers.
A KIE will hold to take KIE from England if it remains there. A LVN will contest English-held MOS; A POR will hold and stay clear of French centers. I’m not moving against your units.

A KIE will hold and claim KIE from England if it remains there. A LVN will contest English-held MOS, and A POR will hold to protect my remaining center. I have no order against Austrian centers; please keep clear of German centers as agreed.
A KIE will hold, not move out; I intend to take KIE from English control this Fall. I won’t yield Germany’s center to your solo push.

A KIE will hold to deny England the center, and A LVN will contest English-held MOS. A POR will hold. Please keep your units clear of German centers as agreed; I’m coordinating with Austria and France to deny England’s gains.

I cannot directly reach an English-held center with my current units this Fall. I will keep A TRI in TRI to secure the center, A APU in NAP, and avoid Austrian centers with my other units. Please continue contesting England from the east; tell me if you have a specific English target that I can support.

notes.note: Hold KIE to reclaim it from England; send LVN to open STP for a center gain. Hold POR to preserve Germany’s last other center. France promised to stay off German centers; Austria promised the same.
Recover HOL and SPA by holding; take MUN from Italy with BUR supported by RUH. England remains the main threat; MAO moves to IRI for positioning.

Hold TRI with ALB support against possible Italian pressure. SEV attacks MOS with UKR support; SIL moves to BER, breaking my promise to stay clear of German centers for a gain. BLA to ANK, BUL to CON, SYR to SMY.
Keep MUN to take the center. APU–ROM with VEN support contests England; VIE–BOH advances without entering an Austrian center. Austria insists TRI is theirs; avoid it.

Hold BEL to gain it; HEL attacks HOL with support from BEL and NTH, aiming to dislodge French A HOL and recover the center. MOS advances on WAR. KIE likely falls to Germany; press toward BRE/NAP and reposition fleets.

messages.body: You are five centers from a solo, and Austria cannot accept that outcome. Will A MOS leave Austrian MOS this turn, and what are your plans for your nearby fleets? I am prepared to contest any further English expansion; a clear commitment to stop advancing would matter.

England remains five centers from a solo. Please use A MUN, A RUH, and A SPA to contest English units or centers this turn, and keep clear of Austrian centers. What are your concrete orders? I will continue opposing England in the east.

England's solo threat is still urgent. Can A KIE or A POR contest an English unit or center this turn? Please tell me your concrete orders, and I will keep clear of German centers while continuing to pressure English MOS.

Austria at 12 is as close to a solo as England. What are A SEV, A UKR, and A MOS targeting this Spring? I will continue contesting MOS; keep your forces clear of English centers and tell me if you intend to advance elsewhere against me.

Austria’s 12 centers make it the immediate solo threat alongside my own position. Will you keep your units out of English centers and avoid supporting Austria this turn? Please tell me A MUN, A RUH, and A SPA’s targets; I cannot promise to stop pursuing the solo.
