Austria is at 12 centers and could also win. Will you keep A KIE and A POR clear of English centers, and can either unit pressure Austria rather than interfere with my eastern position? Please give me your Spring targets; I cannot promise to leave German centers untouched.

England remains five centers from a solo, but you are also only six away. What are your concrete Spring targets? I propose we focus pressure on English-held centers and keep clear of one another’s centers; please do not move against MUN or other French holdings.

You still threaten a solo, and I will contest your western holdings. What are F BEL, F HOL, and your other nearby units targeting this Spring? Withdraw from French centers and I can avoid widening the war elsewhere; I will not leave BEL or HOL uncontested.
Please contest England rather than France this Spring. What are A KIE and A POR targeting? I will keep my units clear of your centers if you hold your ground and do not assist England’s expansion.

England remains close to a solo, but you are also at 12 centers. What are A BER and A UKR doing this Spring? I will defend KIE and POR; please keep your units clear of both and avoid supporting English gains.

Can A RUH or A MUN pressure an English position this Spring, rather than move against KIE or POR? I will hold both German centers and stay out of French territory. Please keep German centers clear and contest England where you can.

I will defend KIE and POR this Spring; I will not voluntarily yield either German center. What are your units near KIE doing? With Austria also at 12, please avoid using this turn to gain a center toward 18.

Your 13 centers make any further gain potentially decisive. What are F NAP, F WES, and F BAL targeting this Spring? I will defend my Italian centers and will not facilitate a solo; please keep your fleets out of NAP and ROM.

England remains the immediate solo threat. What are your concrete Spring orders against English-held centers, especially MOS and WAR? I will keep my units out of Austrian centers this turn; please keep yours clear of ROM and VEN.

I intend to contest English expansion, but my units cannot reach an English center immediately. Please tell me your concrete targets for A MUN and A SPA this Spring, and keep your units clear of Italian centers. Can you help prevent England’s next gain?

A MOS will move against English-held WAR, with A UKR supporting; I am contesting England rather than targeting Italian centers. I will keep clear of ROM and VEN. Please keep A TRI and A VIE out of Austrian centers.
A BER will hold, and A UKR will support A MOS against English-held WAR. I have no orders against KIE or POR and will not support English gains. Please keep your units clear of Austrian centers.

A MOS will attack English-held WAR with A UKR supporting; I am keeping pressure on England in the east and will avoid French centers. Please use your western units to contest English holdings, and keep them clear of Austrian centers.

A MOS and A UKR are targeting your position in WAR; A BER will hold. Austria cannot accept your solo, and I will continue contesting your forces. I have no order against your other centers this Spring.

A MOS will not leave MOS; I intend to keep contesting your eastern line. A WAR is positioned to press MOS, while F BAL and F BOT will maintain pressure in the Baltic. I will not promise to stop expanding. What are A SEV and A UKR doing this Spring?

F NAP will not move to ROM this Spring, and F WES is not targeting an Italian center. F BAL is operating in the Baltic, far from Italy. I cannot promise to halt expansion or help you, but please keep A TYR and your other units clear of English centers and do not support Austria.

F BAL and F DEN are positioned to pressure KIE; I cannot promise to leave it untouched. A KIE and A POR should stay clear of English-held centers. I will not redirect my eastern forces toward Austria on your assurance alone. What are A KIE and A POR actually ordered to do?

F BEL will remain in BEL, and F HOL will remain in HOL; I will not withdraw from either. I have no commitment to halt expansion. Please keep A RUH and A MUN out of English centers and tell me whether A SPA will move toward MAR or remain in SPA.

I’ll use A RUH to contest English-held HOL, A MUN to RUH, and F IRI toward MAO; A SPA will hold. I’m not moving against Austrian centers. Please keep pressure on England, but do not move into French centers—your 12 centers make you a serious solo threat too.

A RUH will contest English-held HOL, A MUN will move to RUH, A SPA will hold, and F IRI will move toward MAO to pressure the English fleets. I’ll keep clear of Italian centers. Please use whatever position you can to deny England further gains, and avoid helping Austria expand.

A RUH will contest English-held HOL and A MUN will move to RUH; A SPA holds and F IRI heads toward MAO. I’ll keep clear of German centers. Please use A KIE and A POR to resist English expansion, and do not assist Austria’s growth.

I will not leave your western positions uncontested: A RUH is targeting HOL, A MUN is moving to RUH, and F IRI is heading toward MAO. A SPA will hold. I’m not offering a truce while you remain at 13 and continue pressing French centers.

A KIE and A POR will hold this Spring. I cannot safely spare either unit to pressure an English position while KIE and POR are exposed, and I have no unit in range to threaten an Austrian center. I will keep clear of Austrian territory.

A KIE and A POR will hold this Spring to protect my two remaining centers. I will not move into French territory or assist English expansion. I cannot spare a unit to contest an English position without leaving a German center exposed.

A KIE and A POR will hold this Spring; neither will move into an English center or pressure Austria. I cannot promise to keep German centers untouched if you attack them, but I am not advancing against your eastern position this turn.

notes.note: Hold KIE and POR this Spring to preserve Germany’s last two centers; English fleets threaten KIE. France and Austria promised to stay clear of German centers; Austria says BER holds and UKR supports MOS-WAR, France says RUH contests HOL. England made no restraint promise.

Take and secure VIE with TYR supported from BOH; advance ROM to TUS. France says MUN/RUH contest HOL and F IRI toward MAO; Austria targets WAR and promises to avoid Italian centers. England says its nearby fleets will not target Italy this Spring.

IRI to MAO for possible SPA convoy next turn; MUN to SIL, RUH contests English BEL, SPA to GAS for pressure on POR. Austria says it will attack WAR and avoid French centers; Germany holds KIE/POR; England refuses to withdraw from BEL/HOL.

Press KIE with BAL supported by DEN and HOL; defend HOL against France. Advance fleets toward NOR/NWG, stage BOT in FIN, and probe GOL. Austria is contesting WAR with MOS/UKR; move WAR to SIL rather than hold. France, Germany, and Austria oppose further English growth; no restraint promises.

Press England: MOS->WAR supported by UKR; take Italian VIE with TRI supported by BUD, breaking Italy's request to keep clear. Advance ALB to GRE, ANK to BLA, CON to BUL, SMY to SYR; BER probes MUN. England has refused to stop expanding; Germany/France claim restraint.

messages.body: A WAR will return to Austria this Fall, and I remain opposed to your solo. What are F KIE, A PRU, and your northern fleets targeting? I intend to contest English positions, not leave you a clear path to 18.

Please use A MUN and A RUH to contest English-held KIE and nearby positions this Fall, and keep A SPA clear of Austrian centers. I will take WAR and continue opposing England in the east. What are your concrete orders?
Please keep A BOH, A TUS, and A TYR out of Austrian centers this Fall, especially TRI and VIE. I am taking WAR and continuing to oppose England; tell me if you can contest any English unit or center.

A WAR is already in your hands, and you are at 12 centers. What are A MOS, A UKR, and A BER ordered to do this Fall? I will contest any further advance toward English centers; please keep your units out of KIE and the north.

What are A MUN, A RUH, and A SPA targeting this Fall? F BEL and F HOL are exposed to your nearby armies. I cannot promise to stop expanding, but tell me whether you intend to attack either fleet or support Austria.

Your A POR is your only listed unit, while my F KIE can recover KIE this Fall. Are you ordering A POR to move or hold? I cannot promise to leave German centers alone, but I need to know whether you intend to contest KIE or pressure my western units.

England’s 13 centers remain the immediate danger. What are your concrete Fall targets? Please use A WAR to take or contest English-held territory, and keep A TRI, A GRE, and the other French-facing units clear of my centers. I’ll contest English gains, not Austrian centers.

Your fleets remain poised to reach 18, and I will not leave French territory uncontested. Are you withdrawing F BEL or F HOL this Fall? I intend to use my armies against your western positions; please name your targets.

I’ll keep my forces clear of Italian centers this Fall. Can your units help deny England a gain, or at least avoid supporting Austria’s expansion? Please tell me your concrete targets, especially for A BOH, A TUS, and A TYR.
KIE is yours to hold this Fall; I have no unit there to contest it. Austria is also at 12 and poised to take WAR. What are your plans for this Fall, and will you leave POR alone?
You are at 12 and WAR is set to transfer to you this Fall, while England can take KIE. What are A BER and A UKR doing? Please keep A BER and A TRI clear of POR.
A POR is my only unit and POR my only secure center. Please keep F MAO and your armies clear of POR this Fall; what are F MAO and A SPA targeting?

England is still near a solo, but you are also at 12. What are your exact Fall targets? I will keep my units out of Austrian centers if you keep A TRI and your other units clear of Italian centers; please contest English gains rather than expand toward 18.

What are F ION and your other southern fleets targeting this Fall? My units are in BOH, TUS, and TYR; I will not move into English centers, but I need you to keep your fleets clear of Italian centers while you contest Austria.
England remains close to a solo. What are your exact Fall orders for MUN, RUH, and SPA? I can avoid French centers if you keep your armies clear of Italy and focus on contesting English holdings.

A WAR will hold the English center, with A UKR supporting its defense; A BER will also support WAR rather than risk an English counterattack. I’m not moving against French centers. Please use A MUN and A RUH to contest English-held KIE and keep clear of Austria.

There is no A MOS now: A WAR holds the position you are contesting. A UKR and A BER will support WAR’s defense. I’m not moving against your northern centers this Fall, but I will not leave WAR open to an English advance.

A BER and A UKR will support A WAR against an English counterattack; I’m not moving against POR or KIE this Fall. England remains the danger, so please keep your units clear of Austrian centers and contest its gains where you can.

A WAR will hold, with A UKR and A BER supporting its defense against England. I’ll keep my units out of ROM, VEN, and VIE; please keep A BOH, A TUS, and A TYR clear of Austrian centers, especially TRI.

I am not withdrawing F BEL or F HOL. A PRU is focused east, and my other fleets are occupied defending English positions and contesting Austria. I cannot promise to leave your western positions alone; keep A RUH and A MUN out of English centers and do not support Austria.

F KIE and A PRU are focused on preserving my eastern position and contesting your hold on WAR; I will not promise to withdraw or stop advancing. My northern fleets are defending English centers and maintaining pressure in the north. What are A MOS and A UKR ordered to do this Fall?

I intend to hold KIE and contest Austria’s position at WAR. I have no unit currently positioned to take POR this turn, but I cannot promise to leave it alone in future. What is A POR doing, and will Germany avoid supporting Austria against my units?

F ION is not targeting an Italian center this turn; my southern fleets are occupied contesting Austria and protecting my position. I cannot promise to halt expansion, but please keep A BOH, A TUS, and A TYR out of English centers and do not support Austria.

I’ll use A MUN–RUH and A RUH–HOL to pressure England’s western position; A SPA will hold. I’ll keep clear of Austrian centers. Please ensure A WAR takes or contests WAR and keep your other forces focused on England, not my holdings.

A RUH will attack HOL and A MUN will support that attack; A SPA will hold. I will not support Austria, but I will contest your holdings while you remain at 13 and refuse to stop expanding. Are F BEL and F HOL holding, or moving elsewhere?

F MAO will move to IRI; A SPA will hold, and I will keep clear of POR. My armies will pressure English positions rather than KIE. Please keep A POR out of French centers and resist England where your position allows.

A MUN will move to RUH, A RUH will attack HOL, and A SPA will hold. I’ll keep clear of Italian centers and focus on denying England. Please keep A BOH, A TUS, and A TYR away from French centers and avoid helping Austria expand.

A POR will hold; it is my only unit, and I have no way to contest KIE this Fall. Austria’s move on WAR may gain it a center, so your eastern position is at risk. I cannot offer support, but please leave POR alone; taking it would eliminate Germany without advancing your solo as much as pressure on Austria.

I’ll keep A BOH, A TUS, and A TYR out of French centers and will not support Austrian expansion. My units cannot reach an English-held center this Fall. Please keep MUN, RUH, and SPA focused on recovering French centers or contesting England, and clear of Italian centers.

I’ll keep A BOH, A TUS, and A TYR out of Austrian centers this Fall. My units cannot directly contest an English center. Please specify your exact targets and keep A TRI and your other units clear of Italian centers; England’s 13 centers remain the immediate danger.

notes.note: Hold POR: it is Germany’s last center, and France’s A SPA could move in if POR is vacated. France says SPA holds and stays clear; England says it has no unit positioned to take POR this turn.

BOH–MUN to capture France’s center as France says A MUN moves to RUH; TYR–VIE reclaims our center. TUS–PIE advances toward France. Austria promised to stay clear of Italian centers and hold WAR; England and France give no halt-to-expansion promise.

Contest England at KIE with MUN supported by RUH; MAO into ENG pressures the western fleets. SPA advances to GAS. Austria promised WAR and to avoid French centers; Italy says it will stay clear of French centers.

Keep WAR to claim its center, with UKR supporting its defense. Take Italian-held VIE with TRI; reposition others into open Austrian centers and toward expansion. England remains the solo danger; France and Italy promised restraint, though prior restraint promises were broken.

Hold KIE to take it; BEL supports HOL against France's RUH+MUN attack. Take MAR with GOL and advance south/east. PRU cannot dislodge supported WAR; move to SIL. Austria contests WAR; France attacks HOL; Germany promised POR holds.

messages.body: You are at 13 and I am at 13; neither can afford to let the other reach 18. What are your concrete Spring targets for F ADR, F BAL, and A PRU? I will contest any move against Austrian centers, and I need to know whether you intend to attack WAR.

England is at 13, but I am also at 13 and cannot allow either of us a solo. What are your concrete orders for A GAS and A RUH this Spring? Please keep them clear of Austrian centers; I will not promise to leave English-held centers uncontested.

I will keep my units out of Italian centers this Spring if A TYR stays clear of TRI and VIE. What are A MUN, A PIE, and A TYR targeting? England and Austria are both at 13, so I cannot commit to holding back from expansion.

You are at 13 and so am I; neither can afford to leave the other a clear solo route. What are A WAR, A UKR, and A BER targeting this Spring? My forces remain focused on protecting English holdings and contesting your line. Please keep your units out of English centers.

What are A RUH, A GAS, and F ENG targeting this Spring? Your armies can still threaten my western centers, while Austria is also at 13. I need to know whether you intend to attack HOL or support Austria; please keep your units clear of English centers.

Austria and England are both at 13, so this turn matters. What are A MUN, A PIE, F ROM, and A TYR targeting? Please keep your units out of English centers and avoid supporting Austria. My forces are focused on protecting my holdings and contesting the immediate solo threat.

You and England are both at 13, so neither can be allowed to solo. What are A SER, A UKR, A WAR, and your fleets targeting this Spring? I will keep A GAS and A RUH clear of Austrian centers if you keep A TRI, A BUD, and A SER clear of French centers; please do not move against PAR, SPA, or KIE.

Your 13 centers make you an immediate solo threat. What are F ENG, F PIC, F MAR, and A PRU targeting this Spring? I will contest further English expansion; are you willing to hold your western units clear of PAR, SPA, and KIE rather than press French centers?

Austria and England are both at 13, so their expansion threatens everyone. What are A MUN, A PIE, A TYR, and F ROM targeting this Spring? Please keep clear of PAR, SPA, and KIE and avoid supporting Austria; I can keep A GAS and A RUH clear of Italian centers.
A GAS is the immediate threat to my only center, POR. Will it stay out of POR this Spring? I’ll keep A POR in place and out of French territory.
Austria and England are both at 13, so either could reach 18 first. What are your targets this Spring? Please avoid any move or support that helps Austria gain a center toward a solo.
You and England are both at 13. What are A BER and A TRI doing this Spring, and are you contesting English centers? Please keep A BER clear of POR.

Please give your exact Spring targets and confirm you will keep your units out of Italian centers, especially VIE. I need to recover VIE; will A TYR–VIE be opposed? England remains at 13, but your 13 is also a solo threat, so I will not facilitate either power reaching 18.

What are your exact Spring orders for F ADR, F MAR, and your other southern fleets? Please confirm they will stay out of Italian centers, especially ROM and VIE. With you at 13, I will not support further English gains; I need to know whether Italy is under immediate threat.

What are your exact Spring targets for A GAS, A RUH, and F ENG? I can’t help England reach 18, and I need room to expand. Please keep your units out of Italian centers; would you leave A MUN unopposed so I can reclaim it and focus your forces on English holdings?
A WAR will hold, A UKR will move to MOS, and A BER will move to PRU. I am contesting your eastern position, not opening a clear route for either of us to 18. What are F ADR, F BAL, and A PRU doing?

A BER will move to PRU, and A TRI will move to VIE. I am contesting English-held MOS with A UKR; A WAR will hold. I have no order against POR, but I cannot promise to keep A BER clear of German territory indefinitely.

A SER will hold, A UKR will move to MOS, and A WAR will hold; A TRI will move to VIE. I will keep A BUD clear of French centers, but I cannot promise to keep A TRI clear of KIE or other positions if the board requires it. What are A GAS and A RUH doing?

A TRI will move to VIE, supported by A BUD. I will keep my other units out of ROM and VEN, but VIE is a center I intend to take. A WAR will hold and A UKR will move to MOS to contest England. What are A MUN and A PIE targeting?

F ADR is focused on the Balkan approach, not an attack on TRI this Spring. F BAL and A PRU are positioned to contest your eastern line, including WAR; I will not promise to leave Austrian centers alone. What are A WAR and A UKR actually ordered to do?

My forces are focused on protecting English holdings and contesting Austria’s position; I have no reason to help Austria gain a center. I’m not targeting POR this Spring, but I can’t promise to leave it untouched in future. What is A POR doing?

F ENG is occupied defending the Channel approaches, while F PIC and A PRU are focused on the broader contest with Austria and protecting my position. I’m not promising to leave PAR, SPA, or KIE alone in future, but I have no need to attack those centers this Spring. What are A RUH and A GAS ordered to do?

F ADR is not ordered to attack ROM or VIE this Spring, and F MAR is not targeting an Italian center. My southern forces are focused on the Balkan front and on protecting English holdings; I cannot promise Italy is under no threat later. Are A TYR and your other units staying clear of Austria’s side?
A RUH will contest HOL, A GAS will pressure SPA, and F ENG will move to PIC. I won’t leave your western holdings uncontested while you remain at 13. What are F PIC and F MAR targeting?

A RUH will contest HOL, A GAS will pressure English-held SPA, and F ENG will move to PIC. I’ll keep these units clear of Austrian centers. Please keep A TRI, A BUD, and A SER clear of French centers and tell me your eastern targets.
A GAS will not move to POR this Spring; it will pressure English-held SPA. I’ll keep my other units clear of German centers as well. Please keep A POR in place and out of French territory.

A RUH will contest HOL, A GAS will pressure English-held SPA, and F ENG will move to PIC. I have no unit in MUN, and won’t move against Italian centers. You can use A MUN to reclaim MUN; please keep your units clear of French centers and avoid supporting Austria.

A MUN will hold, A PIE will hold, F ROM will hold, and A TYR will press VIE. I will not enter English centers or support Austria. Please keep F ADR and F MAR out of Italian centers, especially ROM and VIE, and tell me their exact targets.

A MUN and A PIE will hold; F ROM will hold; A TYR is moving to VIE to reclaim my center. I will stay out of your other centers. Will A TRI oppose the move or support VIE? Please keep your units clear of ROM and VEN.

A MUN will hold, A PIE will hold, F ROM will hold, and A TYR will move to VIE. I will keep clear of PAR, SPA, and KIE and will not support Austria. Please keep A GAS and A RUH out of Italian centers, especially MUN, and confirm their exact targets.

notes.note: Move POR-Spa: France promised GAS pressures English-held SPA, not POR; England says POR is not targeted. Try to take a center while keeping France’s army engaged; note that leaving POR risks losing Germany’s last center if either power breaks restraint.
Contest England’s eastern line while taking VIE from Italy with BUD support; advance BER into French-held KIE. Italy said TYR–VIE; my move should dislodge it. England has not promised restraint.

Contest England: ENG supports GAS–BRE; RUH pressures HOL. Keep clear of Italian and Austrian centers. Italy says MUN holds and will avoid French centers; Austria says BUD clear but cannot promise TRI clear. England refuses future restraint.
Austria plans TRI–VIE supported by BUD; TYR–VIE should bounce it and preserve VIE. England says southern fleets are not targeting Italian centers. Seek NAP with ROM; keep pressure moving.

Defend HOL with BEL support; hold PIC against ENG. Push BAL into French KIE and MAR into SPA/S. Austria remains the immediate solo rival; PRU to SIL and ADR to APU stage further pressure. Avoid same-destination conflicts: BOT-FIN, SWE-DEN.

messages.body: This Fall decides whether either of us can pull ahead. What are F APU, F BAL, A PRU, and your fleets targeting? I intend to hold VIE and contest your eastern line; please specify whether you are trying to retake BRE or NAP.
A BRE can transfer BRE from England to you this Fall. Please keep it there and use A RUH to contest an English center rather than Austrian territory. What are A RUH and your fleets targeting?
A VIE is in VIE and will hold it for Austria this Fall. Please keep A TYR and your other units clear of VIE and Austrian centers. What are A BUR, A TUS, and F NAP targeting?

We are both at 13, so neither can afford to give the other a center. What are A WAR, A BER, A MOS, and A VIE ordered to do this Fall? I am contesting your eastern line and will defend English centers; please keep your units out of them.

What are A RUH, A BRE, and F ENG targeting this Fall? Your units can threaten HOL and BRE, while Austria remains at 13. Please tell me whether you intend to attack an English center or support Austria; I will defend my holdings and cannot promise to leave French centers alone.

What are A TYR and your other units targeting this Fall, especially regarding VIE and NAP? Austria and England are both at 13, so please avoid supporting an Austrian gain. My forces are focused on stopping the immediate solo threat; keep your units clear of English centers.

A BRE is now your target and you can reclaim it this Fall; F PIC and F MAR also threaten my remaining centers. Are you moving against PAR or SPA? I need a concrete commitment that your units will not attack French centers this turn.

You and England are both at 13, so a solo must be denied. What are A BER, A VIE, and the eastern armies targeting this Fall? Please keep them away from KIE and my centers; I will contest England rather than Austrian centers.

Your A BUR can take MUN from England, while your F NAP can recover NAP. Are those your Fall targets? Please keep A TUS and A TYR clear of French centers, especially MAR and PAR, and do not support either 13-center power.
A POR is my only unit and POR my only center. I will hold it this Fall. Your F MAO could move to POR; please leave it alone and keep your forces focused on denying Austria a solo.

Please keep your units clear of POR this Fall. A POR will hold, and I will not move against French centers. With Austria and England both at 13, denying either a solo matters more than eliminating Germany.

Your TRI–VIE with BUD support will take my center unless I can dislodge it. Will you order TRI out of VIE this Fall and keep clear of my other centers? I will not target Austrian centers this turn; please specify your exact orders for TRI, BUD, and nearby units.

You and Austria are both at 13; neither can be allowed to reach 18. What are your exact Fall orders for F APU, F ADR, and F MAR? Keep them clear of my centers, especially NAP and ROM, and tell me which Austrian-held centers you are contesting.

What are your exact Fall orders for A RUH, A BRE, and F PIC? Please keep clear of Italian centers. Austria’s supported attack has taken VIE, and England and Austria are both at 13; focus on denying their gains rather than opening another front with Italy.

A BRE’s occupation will restore the center to you; please hold it and keep A RUH clear of Austrian centers. A BER and eastern armies are focused on protecting Austrian holdings and contesting England. I will not promise to avoid every position that may be needed to deny a solo.

A WAR will hold, A BER will support WAR, and A MOS will support WAR; A VIE will hold. My priority is denying either of us a solo, and I will contest any English attack on WAR. I am not targeting your western centers this Fall.

A VIE will hold VIE this Fall; I will not order it out. My other units are not targeting ROM or VEN. England remains a threat, but I cannot give up a center I have taken. Please keep A TYR clear of VIE and Austrian centers.

I can’t give a commitment to leave French centers alone. BRE is an English center, and I intend to contest your occupation there; I’m not targeting PAR or SPA this turn. What are A RUH and F ENG doing? Keep them from supporting Austria or attacking English centers.

My forces are focused on protecting English centers and contesting your position; I won’t provide a clear route for you to grow. I’m not promising to leave Austrian centers untouched. What are A WAR, A MOS, A BER, and A VIE doing this Fall? Keep your units out of English centers.

F APU is focused on protecting NAP and contesting the immediate threat there; F MAR is not aimed at ROM. I’m contesting Austria’s position, but won’t promise to leave Austrian centers alone. What are A TYR and your other units doing regarding VIE, and will you avoid supporting Austria?

I’ll leave POR alone this turn and keep my forces focused on denying Austria a solo. I can’t promise to leave it untouched in later turns. Please keep A POR clear of English centers and don’t support Austria against my units.

A BRE will hold to transfer BRE to France. A RUH will attack HOL, supported by F ENG. I’ll keep my units clear of Austrian centers; please keep your units clear of KIE and French centers and focus on denying England.

A BRE will hold, taking BRE for France. A RUH will attack HOL with support from F ENG. I’m contesting your gains to deny a solo; your refusal to leave French centers safe gives me no reason to stand aside.

A BRE will hold to transfer BRE to France; A RUH attacks HOL, supported by F ENG. I’ll keep clear of Italian centers. Please keep A TUS and A TYR clear of French centers and avoid supporting either Austria or England.
I will keep my units clear of POR this Fall. A BRE holds to take BRE for France, while A RUH attacks HOL with F ENG support to contest England. Please keep A POR in place and out of French centers.
A BUR, A TUS, and F NAP will stay clear of French centers; F NAP will hold to recover NAP. A TYR will contest VIE. I’m not supporting either 13-center power.
F NAP will hold, recovering NAP for Italy; A TYR will contest Austrian-held VIE. A BUR and A TUS are not targeting English centers. I won’t support Austrian expansion.
A TYR will contest VIE; I intend to recover my center, and F NAP will hold to recover NAP. A BUR and A TUS will stay clear of your centers. I’m not supporting your expansion toward 18.

notes.note: Hold BRE to regain the center; F ENG supports its defense against England. A RUH attacks HOL to contest England. Italy promised to stay clear of French centers and not support either 13-center power; England refused a no-attack commitment.
Hold POR to preserve Germany’s last center. France and England both promised to leave it alone this Fall; France targets HOL with RUH/ENG, England says it is focused on denying Austria a solo.

Hold NAP to secure the center; take empty MUN and move TYR into empty Austrian TRI, while TUS advances toward PIE. Austria refused to leave VIE; England’s southern fleets claim to avoid Italian centers.

Keep VIE with support against Italy’s TYR attack; WAR holds with BER support against English pressure. MOS advances on STP; RUM and SYR reposition toward the eastern front. Italy intends to contest VIE; France says BRE stays French and RUH attacks England.

Attempt to reclaim BRE with MAO supported by PIC; DEN supports BAL into vacant KIE. BEL supports HOL against France's supported attack. Advance elsewhere; Austria and England both remain at 13, so deny Austrian growth while seeking centers.

messages.body: Austria is at 13 and cannot let you reach 18. What are F BAR, F DEN, F HOL, A LVN, and F NWG targeting this Spring? I propose a mutual standstill around WAR/PRU while we coordinate against any imminent solo threat.

I’m at 13 and need to prevent England from reaching 18, but I will not leave VIE exposed. Will A TYR stay out of VIE and Austrian centers this Spring? I propose you hold your line in Italy while I focus east and north.

With Austria and England both near a solo, please keep A RUH and A BRE clear of Austrian centers and tell me your Spring targets. Can you pressure English positions rather than move against Austria? I will focus on denying England’s next gain.

You have 13 centers and are five from a solo, so I will contest any move that adds to your count. What are A BER, A WAR, A MOS, and your southern units targeting this Spring? Keep them clear of English centers; I need your concrete orders.

Austria is five centers from a solo. Will A TRI, A VEN, and A MUN contest Austrian-held centers rather than support Austria this Spring? I can apply pressure from the north and west, but need to know your targets, especially regarding VIE and TRI.

Austria is five centers from a solo, and a gain this turn could make the game unwinnable for everyone else. What are A RUH, A BRE, and your other units targeting? Please keep them from attacking HOL or supporting Austria; I need to focus on denying Austrian gains.

You need five centers to win, so please state your Fall targets now. My A BRE, A RUH, and F ENG will contest England, not your centers, if you keep A TRI, A VIE, and your western forces away from PAR and SPA. Do not take French centers to reach 18.

Austria is at 13 and is the immediate solo threat. What are F PIC, F BEL, and your other western units targeting? I can keep A RUH and F ENG contesting your positions, but will you keep your forces out of PAR and SPA and focus on denying Austrian gains?

Austria is at 13 and close to a solo. Please use A MUN, A TRI, and A VEN to contest Austrian centers rather than moving into PAR or SPA. What are your exact targets? I’ll keep my units clear of Italian centers while I pressure England.
You are five centers from a solo, with England close behind. What are A BER and A TRI doing this turn? Please keep them clear of POR; I’ll hold A POR and won’t move against Austrian centers.

Austria is five centers from a solo. Please keep pressure on its gains rather than target POR; I’ll hold A POR and won’t move against English centers this turn. What are F MAO and your other nearby fleets doing?
Please keep A RUH and your other units clear of POR this turn. I’ll hold A POR and stay out of French centers. Austria is five centers from a solo, so please avoid helping it gain centers.

Your A VIE and A BUD threaten my TRI directly, and I cannot accept further losses while you are at 13. What are their exact Spring orders? Keep them out of TRI and my other centers; I will not support an Austrian gain toward 18.

Austria at 13 is the immediate solo threat. What are your exact Spring targets for F ION, F KIE, and F PIC? Keep your fleets clear of NAP and my other centers, and contest Austrian gains rather than press Italy.

Can you pressure Austria or England this Spring instead of Italy? Please keep A BRE and A RUH clear of MUN, PIE, and my other centers. Let me know your exact targets; Austria at 13 is close to winning.

A WAR will hold, A MOS will move toward STP with A UKR supporting, and A BER will contest PRU. My southern units will secure Austrian positions and press where they can. I cannot promise a standstill that leaves you free to gain centers; I intend to deny your solo route.

A VIE will move against TRI, with A BUD supporting; I will not leave that opportunity unused. A TRI will hold, and my other southern units will protect Austrian centers. I have no orders against ROM or VEN, but I cannot agree to keep Austrian units out of TRI.

A BRE and A RUH can help contest England, and I appreciate your focus there. A WAR will hold, A MOS will press toward STP with A UKR supporting, and A BER will contest PRU. I will keep A TRI, A VIE, and my western forces away from PAR and SPA this turn.

A BER will contest PRU, and A TRI will hold; neither is ordered to POR. My eastern armies are focused on contesting England and defending Austrian centers. I cannot promise to keep A BER out of German territory indefinitely, but I have no order against POR this turn.

I will coordinate against any move that gains you a center, but a standstill around WAR/PRU is not acceptable while you are five from a solo. My northern units are contesting your eastern line; keep A BER, A WAR, A MOS, and the southern armies out of English centers. What are your actual orders?

F ION will stay clear of NAP and other Italian centers; F KIE and F PIC are focused on denying Austrian gains, not supporting Austria. Please use A TRI, A VEN, and A MUN to contest Austrian-held centers, especially VIE, and avoid any support that lets Austria add a center.

F PIC and F BEL are focused on the Austrian threat and protecting English holdings; I will not give Austria support. I cannot promise to leave PAR or SPA untouched indefinitely, but I have no need to attack them this Spring. Keep A RUH and A BRE from attacking HOL or helping Austria.

F MAO is not targeting POR this Spring. My nearby forces are focused on denying Austria a solo and defending English centers. Please keep A POR holding and do not support Austrian moves against my units; Austria’s gains threaten both of us.

A RUH will attack HOL with support from F ENG; A BRE will hold. I have no other units to commit. I’m contesting English holdings, not supporting your growth. Please keep A TRI, A VIE, and your western armies away from PAR and SPA, and tell me your Fall targets.

A RUH will attack HOL, supported by F ENG; A BRE will hold. I’m contesting your holdings because Austria is close to a solo, not supporting Austria. Please keep F PIC and F BEL from attacking PAR or SPA and focus on stopping Austrian gains. What are your eastern units targeting?

A RUH attacks HOL with support from F ENG, and A BRE holds; I will keep clear of Italian centers. Please use A MUN, A TRI, and A VEN to contest Austrian centers, not French ones. What are your exact targets this Spring?

A RUH attacks HOL with support from F ENG, and A BRE holds. I will keep all my units clear of POR. Please keep A POR in place and out of French territory; if possible, resist Austrian expansion rather than assist it.

I will not keep A TRI out of Austrian centers: it will attack VIE, with support from A MUN. A VEN will support A TRI’s defense. I cannot accept Austria’s continued expansion at 13 centers. Please keep A VIE and A BUD clear of TRI and resolve this without opening a war between us.

A TRI will attack VIE, supported by A MUN; A VEN will support TRI’s defense. F NAP will hold, and A PIE will hold. I am contesting Austria directly and will not support its expansion. Keep your fleets clear of Italian centers.

A TRI will attack VIE, supported by A MUN, while A VEN supports TRI’s defense. A PIE will hold and F NAP will hold. I’m directly contesting Austria rather than moving into French centers; please keep A BRE and A RUH clear of Italian centers and continue pressuring England.

notes.note: Hold POR; it is my sole center. England and France say they will leave it alone this Spring; both focus on resisting Austria. Reassess in Fall.

Defend TRI against Austria's supported VIE attack with VEN support; seize open MAR and move NAP to TYS. Austria has broken the prior peace by targeting TRI. England and France urged pressure on Austria; both claim to avoid Italian centers.
Keep BRE safe from English pressure with ENG support; advance RUH to BUR for future options. Austria remains the immediate solo threat; promises to keep French centers clear are not guarantees.
Contest Austria: BAR to STP/N with FIN support; LVN supports that move. BEL supports HOL against France's promised RUH+ENG attack. Probe ADR, BAL, and WES; NWG occupies NOR.
Protect VIE against Italy's TRI+MUN attack; UKR supports WAR as MOS presses STP and BER enters PRU. Italy refuses restraint; England contests my growth. Keep advancing and deny either rival a solo.

messages.body: Your eastern line still threatens my centers, while you remain close to a solo. What are F STP/NORTH, A LVN, and your Baltic fleets ordered to do this Fall? I intend to contest STP; do not support an attack on Austrian centers.

We are both spending units fighting over VIE/TRI while England holds 12 centers and threatens a solo. Can we stop attacking each other this Fall and coordinate against English centers? My eastern units will pressure STP; please tell me whether A MAR and your fleets will target English holdings.

England remains near a solo. Please use A BRE, A BUR, and F ENG to contest English centers this Fall rather than Austrian territory. What are your exact targets? I am pressing STP from the east and will keep my western units clear of your centers.

You are still five centers from a solo, and I will contest any move that gains you one. What are A MOS, A WAR, A PRU, and your southern units ordered to do this Fall? Keep them out of English centers.

Your A BRE and F ENG can still threaten my western holdings. Austria remains close to a solo, but I will defend English centers and cannot promise French centers are safe. Are you attacking HOL or supporting Austria this Fall? Please keep your units from attacking English centers.

Your A TRI and A MUN can contest Austria, but F WES and F PIC can challenge A MAR, which currently occupies English MAR. What are your exact Fall orders? I intend to recover MAR and need to know whether you will defend it or coordinate against Austria.

You are at 13 and five centers from winning. What are your exact Fall targets? Keep your units away from PAR, BRE, and SPA; I will not support Austrian gains. Coordinate with England and Italy to block any route to 18.

Austria is the immediate solo threat. What are your Fall targets, especially for F PIC, F BEL, and your eastern fleets? Please use them to block Austrian gains and keep them out of PAR and SPA; I can’t afford another French center lost.
Please use A BOH, A TRI, and A VEN to contest Austria and keep them out of PAR and SPA. A MAR taking MAR gives you a center, but Austria must not reach 18; what are your exact Fall targets?

F WES can attack POR, my only center. Please leave POR untouched this Fall as you have before; I will hold A POR and will not move against English centers. Austria is five centers from a solo, so your forces are better used to deny its gains.

Please keep A BRE and your other units clear of POR this Fall; A POR will hold, and I will stay out of French centers. Austria is five centers from a solo. Can your forces continue contesting English gains without opening a route into POR?

Austria is five centers from a solo, and MAR will return to you if A MAR remains there. Are you contesting Austrian centers this Fall? I have only A POR and will keep it clear of Italian centers; please keep your units clear of POR.

Your supported attack on TRI failed last Spring. A TRI will hold this Fall; I will not support your route to 18. What are your exact Fall orders for A BUD, A SER, and A ALB? Keep them out of Italian centers.

A MAR is positioned to recover MAR for Italy this Fall. Please keep F PIC and your other units clear of Italian centers, and use your forces to deny Austria’s next gains rather than attack Italy. What are your exact Fall orders near MAR and the Austrian front?
I intend to recover MAR with A MAR this Fall. Please keep A BRE and A BUR clear of Italian centers, especially MAR and MUN, and continue denying Austrian gains. What are your exact Fall orders?

A MOS is pressing STP, with A PRU supporting the attack; A WAR will hold and A UKR will support its defense. My southern armies are securing Austrian positions, not targeting English centers this Fall. I will contest any English move against WAR.

A BRE and A BUR should contest English holdings, as you proposed. My western and southern units will stay clear of PAR, BRE, and SPA. A MOS is pressing STP; A WAR holds, and my other eastern units are protecting Austrian positions. I will not support England’s growth.

A BUD and A SER are protecting Austrian positions; A ALB will hold. I am not ordering them into Italian centers this Fall. A MOS is pressing STP, and I would rather stop contesting VIE/TRI than give England an opening. I cannot promise to leave TRI uncontested in future turns.

I understand POR is your only center. Austria remains five centers from a solo, but I can’t promise to leave POR untouched when F WES can take it. I’m weighing the immediate threat against that opportunity; keep A POR holding and don’t support Austria.

I will contest any attempt to take an English center, especially STP. What are A MOS, A WAR, A PRU, and your southern units ordered to do this Fall? Keep your units out of English centers; I will not agree to a standstill that leaves you free to gain centers.

Austria is still the immediate solo threat, but I must defend my own holdings. Are A BRE, A BUR, and F ENG attacking or supporting an attack on HOL this Fall? Keep them from English centers and do not help Austria. I won’t promise that PAR or SPA will remain untouched.

I intend to contest A MAR with F WES and F PIC, so I cannot promise to leave MAR to Italy. Are A TRI and A VEN contesting Austrian centers this Fall, and what is A MUN doing? Please avoid supporting Austria’s gains; its solo threat endangers us both.
A BRE will attack PIC, supported by A BUR and F ENG. This contests England without opening a route into POR; I’ll keep my units clear of it.

A BRE will attack PIC, with A BUR and F ENG supporting; A BUR and F ENG will not support Austrian gains. I’ll keep my units clear of PAR, SPA, and your centers. Please ensure your Fall moves do not threaten French centers.

A BRE will attack PIC, supported by A BUR and F ENG; I am not attacking HOL or supporting Austria. Austria remains the immediate solo threat, so I cannot promise to leave your centers uncontested. Keep your forces focused on denying Austrian gains and out of PAR and SPA.

A BRE will attack PIC, supported by A BUR and F ENG; I will keep clear of MAR, MUN, and your other centers. I am not supporting Austria. Please keep your units focused on contesting Austrian gains and away from PAR and SPA.
I’m contesting Austria: A BOH will pressure VIE, with A TRI also directed against Austrian positions. A POR is safe; none of my units will target it. Please keep A POR clear of Italian centers.

I will continue contesting your expansion: A BOH and A TRI are directed against VIE. Do not mistake this for support for England; my A MAR is recovering the center. What are your exact Fall orders for A BUD, A SER, and A ALB?

A BOH and A TRI are directed against Austrian positions, while A VEN protects TRI. A MAR is recovering MAR; I cannot spare it for another front. Please keep A BRE, A BUR, and F ENG clear of Italian centers and continue denying Austria’s gains.

A MAR is holding to recover MAR for Italy. Please keep F WES and F PIC out of MAR and other Italian centers; your pressure is better spent denying Austria. A BOH and A TRI are directed against Austrian positions, and A VEN protects TRI.

notes.note: Move POR-Spa to seize France’s vacant center; POR appears safe from immediate occupation. England may still target it later; France and Italy have promised to stay clear this Fall.

Concentrate BRE, BUR, and ENG on PIC as promised; aim to take an English center while denying Austria a route to 18. Italy intends to recover MAR; Austria says its western forces will avoid French centers. England has not promised French centers are safe.

Contest Austria: TRI attacks VIE with BOH support; VEN supports TRI holding. Keep MAR to secure its capture. TYS to GOL prepares a convoy toward TUS next turn. Austria proposed coordinating against England, but I have not agreed to support its expansion.

Austria is five centers from solo; protect STP with FIN, NOR, and LVN support while STP holds. BAL attacks vacant BER to contest Austria. Italy retakes MAR; French attack threatens PIC. Keep English centers covered and pressure TYS.
Press TRI with VIE supported by ALB and SER; BUD replaces VIE. Hold WAR with UKR support. MOS attacks STP; PRU contests LVN. Keep advancing against England and Italy; both resist my growth.

messages.body: Both of us are within reach of a solo, so neither can afford to let the other gain freely. What are F STP/NORTH, A LVN, and your Baltic fleets targeting this Spring? I will defend WAR and contest any move against it; tell me whether you will avoid supporting attacks there.

We are wasting forces contesting VIE/TRI while England remains at 12. I propose we stop attacking Austrian centers this Spring: I will not order A VIE or A BUD into TRI, and ask that A TRI and A BOH stay clear of VIE. What are your exact orders for them?

I am focused on preventing England's solo and may need to expand elsewhere. A TYR can move to MUN; I am considering taking the open center. Will A SPA stay clear of Austrian centers, and what are your plans for POR this Spring?

You remain five centers from a solo, so I will contest any move that adds to your count. What are A MOS, A WAR, A PRU, and your southern units targeting this Spring? Keep your units out of English centers; I need your concrete orders.

Austria is still the immediate solo threat. Will A TYR and A BOH attack or support an attack on VIE, and what are A VEN and A MAR doing? I can pressure Austria from the north; please avoid supporting any Austrian center gain.

Austria is still five centers from a solo. Are A BUR and your other units targeting Austrian positions or English centers this Spring? Please keep A BUR and F ENG from attacking or supporting attacks on HOL or other English centers, and tell me your concrete plans.

You are still the immediate solo threat at 13. I will not support Austrian gains. Please confirm your Spring targets and keep A TRI, A VIE, and your western units away from PAR and SPA; I need to know you are not opening a route into France.

Austria is at 13 and must be stopped before it gains five more centers. I propose we both focus on denying Austrian gains this Spring. What are your targets for F BEL, F BER, and your eastern units? Keep them out of PAR and SPA, and I will avoid attacking English centers this turn.
Please direct A BOH, A TRI, and A VEN against Austrian positions this Spring and keep your units out of PAR and SPA. Austria is at 13; any gains could end the game. What are your exact targets?

Austria is five centers from a solo and has forces at PRU, WAR, and MOS. What are your orders against its holdings this Spring? I have only A SPA and will avoid English centers; please leave POR and SPA alone while we deny Austria any gains.

You are five centers from a solo, and I cannot afford to be eliminated. What are A PRU and your western-facing units doing this Spring? I will keep A SPA out of Austrian centers; please keep your units clear of POR and SPA.

Thanks for contesting Austria. What are A BOH and A TRI targeting this Spring? I have only A SPA and will stay clear of Italian centers; please keep your units clear of POR and SPA as we deny Austria a solo.

Austria is five centers from a solo and cannot be allowed another gain. I’ll use A BOH and A TYR to contest VIE; please tell me your exact orders against Austrian centers this Spring. Keep F TYS and your other fleets clear of Italian centers, including MAR and NAP.

Austria remains five centers from a solo. I’m contesting VIE from A BOH and A TYR; please pressure Austria rather than Italy and keep A BUR and A SPA clear of Italian centers. What are your exact Spring targets?

You are five centers from a solo, and I will continue contesting your expansion. What are your exact orders for A VIE, A BUD, and A TRI this Spring? Keep them out of Italian centers, especially MAR and VEN; I will not support your gains.

A VIE and A BUD will not move into TRI this Spring. I ask that A TRI and A BOH stay out of VIE; I will defend my centers and cannot leave VIE exposed. My eastern forces are focused on the English threat, not Italian centers.

A PRU will support the eastern line, while my western-facing units are focused on nearby threats. A TYR may move toward MUN; I have no order against POR or SPA this Spring. Please keep A SPA clear of Austrian centers as you proposed.

A TRI, A VIE, and my western units will stay clear of PAR, BRE, and SPA this Spring. My eastern units are focused on the English line; I will not open a route into France. Please keep contesting England rather than supporting its growth.

A WAR will hold, and A MOS will press STP with A PRU supporting. My southern units will defend Austrian positions; I am not targeting English centers elsewhere this Spring. I will contest any move against WAR, so tell me whether your forces will stay clear of it.

F TYS and my other fleets will stay clear of MAR, NAP, and your other centers. My northern units will secure STP and contest Austrian positions around PRU and WAR; I will not support any Austrian center gain. I’m glad A BOH and A TYR are pressing VIE.

My eastern units are securing STP and contesting Austria’s northern line; I will not support Austrian gains. I will leave POR and SPA alone this Spring. Please keep A SPA out of English centers and do not assist Austria against my eastern units.

I’ll keep F BEL and my other western forces out of PAR and SPA this Spring, and focus my eastern units on denying Austrian gains. Please keep A BUR and F ENG from attacking or supporting attacks on HOL or any other English center, as you proposed.

F STP/NORTH and A LVN are securing STP against your pressure; my Baltic forces will contest your northern line. I will not agree to avoid supporting a defense of WAR while you have 13 centers and can still gain toward a solo. Keep your units out of English centers.

A BUR will hold, and F ENG will hold; neither will enter or support an attack on an Italian center. A SPA is not a French unit. Please keep A BOH, A TRI, and A VEN focused on Austrian positions as you proposed, and let me know if Austria threatens your attack.

A BUR and F ENG will hold this Spring; I will neither attack nor support an attack on English centers, and I will not support Austria. Please use your eastern forces to deny Austrian gains and keep them out of PAR and SPA. I cannot leave my centers undefended, so I make no broader promise beyond this turn.

A SPA will hold this Spring; I have no unit in POR, and I will keep A SPA clear of Austrian centers. I urge you not to take MUN: each center brings you closer to a solo. Please use A TYR against England instead, and keep A PRU clear of POR and SPA.

A BOH and A TYR are targeting VIE; I’ll use one to support the other’s attack. A VEN will stay clear of your centers and help protect my position. Please keep A SPA clear of Italian centers as we deny Austria another gain.

A BOH and A TYR will pressure VIE; A VEN will protect my position, and A MAR stays in MAR. I’m not targeting PAR or SPA. Please keep A BUR clear of Italian centers and tell me your exact targets against Austria this Spring.

A BOH and A TYR are targeting VIE, with one supporting the other; A VEN will stay out of Austrian centers and protect my position. A MAR remains in MAR. Please keep F TYS and your other fleets clear of Italian centers and use your northern forces to deny Austria gains.

I cannot agree to leave VIE unchallenged while you are five centers from a solo. A BOH and A TYR will pressure VIE; A VEN will stay out of your centers. I’m not supporting your expansion. What are your exact orders for A VIE, A BUD, and A TRI?

notes.note: Austria is five centers from solo; contest VIE with TYR supported by BOH. Keep Italian centers protected: MAR holds, GOL holds, VEN supports Austrian TRI defense. England claims northern pressure and no Italian targets; France says no Italian attack. Austria asks us to leave VIE, declined.

Advance BUR to GAS and ENG to MAO for options against the southern centers; no attacks on English or Italian centers this turn. Austria remains the solo threat; its promise to stay clear of France is not guaranteed.
Move SPA to POR to secure my sole center; England and Italy say they will leave my centers alone, while Austria is still poised to grow. Reassess in Fall.

Support STP/NORTH with FIN and NOR against Austrian pressure; LVN contests WAR and BER stages to BAL. Advance elsewhere without entering Italian centers, honoring this-turn promises to Italy, France, and Germany. Austria remains the immediate solo threat.
Press Italian TYR with TRI supported by VIE; protect VIE with BUD and SER. MOS attacks LVN with PRU support; UKR backs WAR. Reposition ALB/ARM/CON toward southern expansion.

messages.body: I’m at 13 and need to stop your eastern pressure while finding a route to 18. What are F STP/NORTH, A LVN, and F BAL doing this Fall? I will defend WAR; if you keep your units from supporting attacks there, I can focus south and west rather than escalate on your centers.

A TYR has retreated to MUN, and your A BOH and A MAR face my southern line. Can we stop the VIE/TRI fight this Fall? I propose A VIE and A BUD stay out of TRI if A TRI and A BOH stay clear of VIE. What are your exact orders?

A TYR’s retreat to MUN leaves a chance to take that center. Will A POR remain in place and A SPA stay clear of Austrian centers this Fall? I’m considering pressure on MUN and need to know whether you intend to contest it.

Austria at 13 remains the immediate threat. Will you use A BOH and A MUN to attack or support an attack on VIE this turn, and keep A VEN from supporting any Austrian gain? I will direct my northern forces to contest Austria rather than your centers.

Austria is still five centers from a solo. Please keep A POR out of English centers and do not support Austria; can you use A POR to pressure an Austrian position this turn? I will avoid POR and SPA as agreed last turn.

Austria’s 13 centers make stopping its next gain urgent. Will A GAS or F MAO be directed against Austria or to help deny an Austrian gain, and will you keep your forces from attacking English centers this turn? I’ll keep my western forces focused away from PAR and SPA.

Austria is still the immediate solo threat. Please use your eastern forces to attack or block Austrian centers this Fall, especially MOS, WAR, and SEV, rather than spend them on France. I’ll keep F MAO and A GAS clear of English centers; what are your exact targets?

Austria is at 13 and must be stopped. Please press VIE with A BOH and A TYR again, and use A VEN to support or protect that attack. Keep your units out of PAR and SPA. What are your exact Fall orders?

At 13 centers, any further gains risk ending the game. State your exact Fall targets, especially whether A TYR, A SYR, or your western armies threaten PAR, BRE, or SPA. I will not support your growth, and I’m coordinating with the other powers to deny your gains.

Austria remains five centers from a solo, but F MAO can take my POR. Please leave POR untouched this Fall and keep contesting Austrian gains. My A POR will hold; what are your nearby fleets targeting?
A GAS can move to my POR, my only center. Please keep A GAS clear of POR this Fall; I will not move against BRE or PAR. Austria remains five centers from a solo, so let’s avoid helping it expand.
Please keep your armies clear of POR and SPA this Fall. I will not move against Austrian centers. Austria is still five centers from a solo; are you contesting England’s holdings or targeting Italy?

You are still five centers from a solo, so I will not help you expand. What are your exact Fall orders for A TYR, A VIE, and A TRI? Keep them out of Italian centers. I’m prepared to discuss a mutual pause, but not to leave my centers exposed.

Austria remains five centers from victory. Please use your northern forces to deny Austrian gains this Fall, especially around WAR and STP, and keep your fleets clear of Italian centers. I’ll keep A BOH and A VEN focused on contesting Austria; what are your exact orders near the Austrian front?

Austria is five centers from a solo. Please use A GAS and F MAO to contest Austrian gains rather than Italy, and keep them clear of Italian centers. I’ll keep A BOH and A VEN focused on Austria. What are your Fall targets?

I’m turning south against Italy rather than moving on POR or SPA. A TYR will pressure MUN; A PRU and the eastern armies are not ordered into German centers this Fall. I cannot offer a long-term guarantee while the solo remains at stake.

A TYR will attack MUN this Fall, so I cannot agree to a mutual pause on those terms. A VIE will hold rather than move into TRI, and I have no order for A TYR into MAR or VEN. I will defend my centers against any attack.

A TYR will pressure MUN; A TYR, A SYR, and my other western-facing units are not ordered against PAR, BRE, or SPA this Fall. I’m not asking you to support Austrian gains. The immediate expansion is directed toward Italy, not France.

F STP/NORTH will hold to deny your pressure on STP, and F BAL will contest PRU. A LVN is your unit, not mine; my army is A EDI. I will not promise to keep my forces from contesting WAR while your 13 centers leave you five from victory. What are A MOS and A PRU doing this Fall?

I’ll leave POR and SPA alone this Fall as agreed, and keep my northern forces focused on denying Austria’s gains. F BAL will contest PRU and F STP/NORTH will guard STP. Can A POR put pressure on an Austrian position, or at least avoid supporting Austria?

F STP/NORTH will guard STP and F BAL will contest PRU; I’m directing my northern forces against Austria, not Italian centers. Are A BOH and A MUN attacking or supporting an attack on VIE, and will A VEN stay clear of supporting any Austrian gain?

F STP/NORTH will guard STP and F BAL will contest PRU, keeping my eastern forces aimed at denying Austria. I’ll keep my western forces clear of PAR and SPA. Are A GAS and F MAO doing anything to hinder Austria this Fall, and will you keep them clear of English centers as promised?

A GAS will stay clear of POR this Fall; I will not attack your center. It will hold, and F MAO will remain clear of Portuguese territory. Please keep A POR out of French centers and continue resisting Austrian expansion where possible.

A GAS will hold and F MAO will move to WES; neither will enter or support an attack on Italian centers. I cannot reach Austrian positions directly from here this Fall, so please keep A BOH and A VEN contesting Austria as you proposed.

A GAS cannot reach an Austrian position this Fall, so it will hold; F MAO will move to WES to stay clear of English centers. I will neither attack nor support an attack on your centers. Please use your eastern forces to block Austrian gains, especially around MOS, WAR, and SEV.

A POR will hold this Fall; I have no unit in SPA, and I will not move against Austrian centers. Please leave POR and SPA untouched. With Italy’s A MUN in place, I urge you to focus on denying England gains rather than taking MUN.

A POR will hold to protect my center; it cannot reach an Austrian position this turn. I have no unit in SPA. Thank you for avoiding POR and SPA as agreed—please keep your fleets focused on contesting Austria’s gains.

I cannot agree to leave VIE unchallenged while you remain five centers from a solo. A MUN will attack VIE, supported by A BOH. A VEN will not support an Austrian gain. Keep A VIE and A BUD out of TRI and other Italian centers; I am not ordering an attack on them this Fall.

A MUN will attack VIE, supported by A BOH; A VEN is not supporting an Austrian gain. My other units are protecting Italian positions, not targeting PAR or SPA. Please keep A GAS and F MAO clear of Italian centers and use them to deny Austria.
Yes: A MUN attacks VIE with support from A BOH. A VEN will not support any Austrian gain. Please contest Austria around WAR and STP as you proposed, and keep your fleets clear of Italian centers.

notes.note: Hold POR to preserve my sole center. France, England, and Austria have promised not to target German centers this Fall; France says GAS holds, England leaves POR/SPA alone. Austria says turning south against Italy.

Try to take SPA while keeping MAO clear of English and Italian centers. Austria remains the immediate solo threat; Italy says BOH/VEN pressure Austria, England says eastern forces contest Austrian gains. I told Germany GAS would stay clear of POR.
Protect MUN from Austria’s promised TYR attack with BOH support. VEN attacks TRI; convoy MAR to German-held SPA. Austria is the immediate solo threat; do not help it expand.

Italy attacks VIE from MUN with BOH support; defend VIE with BUD and TYR supports. Hold PRU against English BAL with LVN support. Advance GRE to ALB; move WAR toward MOS and UKR to SEV. All centers owned; seek openings against Italy while preventing English expansion.

Austria at 13 remains the solo threat. Attack vacant TRI with ADR; contest PRU with BAL and AEG with ION, while FIN/NOR support STP and STP holds. Italy promised MUN-VIE supported by BOH and no help to Austria; Germany holds POR; France avoids English centers.

messages.body: What are F BAL, F STP/NORTH, and A LVN targeting this Spring? I’m focused on the southern front. If you keep clear of WAR and PRU, I can avoid opening a new front against your centers this turn.

I’m ordering A TYR against MUN. Please keep A TRI and A BOH clear of VIE this Spring; I’ll keep A VIE and A BUD out of TRI and won’t target MAR or VEN. Can we stop spending units on the VIE/TRI fight while England remains a threat?

What are A GAS and F WES targeting this Spring? I have no immediate order against French centers. Please use your position to contest English holdings rather than supporting English pressure on my eastern line.

Austria remains five centers from a solo. Are A MUN and A BOH still attacking VIE with support, and what are A VEN and A MAR doing? Please keep A VEN from supporting Austrian gains; I’ll keep my forces focused on checking Austria this turn.

You remain five centers from victory, so I will contest any center you try to gain. What are A MOS, A PRU, A WAR, and your southern units targeting this Spring? Keep them out of English centers; I will defend STP and contest your northern positions.

Austria is still the immediate solo threat. What are A GAS and F WES targeting this Spring, and will you keep them clear of English centers? Please avoid supporting Austria; I’ll use my northern forces to contest its gains.

You are at 13 and five centers from a solo. What are your exact Spring targets? Keep A TYR and your other western units out of PAR, BRE, and SPA. I will not support Austrian gains; please do not open a route into France.

Austria remains the immediate solo threat. Please use your eastern forces to attack or block Austrian positions this Spring, especially MOS, WAR, and SEV, rather than French centers. What are your exact targets? I will keep my units clear of English centers this turn.

Austria’s 13 centers make denying its next gains urgent. Please direct A BOH, A VEN, and your other units against Austrian positions and keep them out of PAR and SPA. What are your exact Spring targets, especially around VIE and TYR?
You are still five centers from a solo. What are A TYR, A TRI, and your western-facing units doing this Spring? I have only A POR and will hold it; please keep your units clear of POR and SPA.

Austria remains five centers from a solo. What are your eastern forces targeting this Spring to deny its gains? I will hold A POR and stay clear of English centers; please leave POR and SPA untouched.

Austria remains the immediate solo threat. Are A BOH, A MUN, and A VEN contesting its centers this Spring? I have only A POR and will stay clear of Italian centers; please keep your units clear of POR and SPA.

Austria remains at 13 and close to a solo. I’ll continue contesting VIE from MUN/BOH and keep VEN out of Austrian gains. Please use your northern units to prevent Austrian gains around WAR and STP, and keep your fleets clear of Italian centers. What are your exact targets this Spring?

Austria is still five centers from a solo. I’ll pressure VIE from MUN with BOH support; please keep GAS and WES clear of Italian centers and use them to deny Austria wherever possible. What are your exact Spring orders?

I will continue contesting VIE and will keep my units out of Austrian centers other than VIE. Is A TYR again targeting MUN this Spring, and what are A VIE and A TRI doing? I will defend my Italian positions and will not support Austrian expansion.

A TYR is again pressuring MUN; A TRI and my other western-facing units are not ordered against POR or SPA this Spring. I cannot offer an indefinite guarantee, but I have no order into either German center now. Please keep A POR clear of Austrian territory.

A MOS will press STP, with A PRU supporting; A LVN will support the defense of PRU, and A WAR will hold. My southern units are defending Austrian positions and seeking openings against Italy, not targeting English centers. I will contest any move against WAR or PRU.

A TYR is again targeting MUN. A VIE will hold and A TRI will stay clear of VIE; I have no order into MAR or VEN. I ask that A BOH and A TRI avoid VIE this Spring so we can stop wasting forces on the border, but I will defend it if attacked.

A TYR will pressure MUN; my other western-facing units are not ordered against PAR, BRE, or SPA this Spring. I have no immediate order against French centers. Please use your position to contest English holdings rather than support England’s pressure on my eastern line.

F BAL will contest PRU, while F STP/NORTH holds STP against Austrian pressure. I’m also directing F AEG toward CON and F ADR toward TRI to deny Austria gains. I’ll leave POR and SPA untouched this turn; please keep A POR clear of English centers and do not assist Austria.

F BAL will contest PRU and F STP/NORTH will defend STP. F AEG will pressure CON and F ADR will contest TRI, so I’m acting against Austrian gains rather than Italian centers. I’ll keep my fleets clear of your centers; please keep A VEN from helping Austria.

F BAL will contest PRU and F STP/NORTH will defend STP against Austrian pressure. I’m also sending F AEG toward CON and F ADR toward TRI to block Austrian gains. I’ll keep my forces clear of PAR and SPA; please keep your units clear of English centers and do not help Austria.

F STP/NORTH will hold STP, and F BAL will contest PRU; I won’t agree to leave your northern positions unchallenged while you remain five centers from a solo. I’m also pressing CON and TRI from the sea. Keep your forces out of English centers; I will defend them.

A GAS will move to SPA, with F WES supporting A GAS–SPA. Neither unit will enter or support an attack on an English center. Please keep your western forces clear of French centers and use your eastern units to block Austria.

A GAS will move to SPA, supported by F WES; this is aimed at Germany, not Italy or Austria. I cannot reach an Austrian position from here this Spring. Please keep pressing VIE and keep your units out of PAR and SPA.

A GAS will move to SPA, with F WES supporting A GAS–SPA. These orders do not target Austrian centers, and I will not support Austrian gains. I cannot reach your eastern positions this Spring; please keep your units clear of PAR and SPA.

A MUN will hold, supported by A BOH, to defend against A TYR. I cannot credibly attack VIE while Austria threatens MUN; A VEN will contest TRI and A MAR will hold. My units will stay clear of POR and SPA.

Austria has A TYR attacking MUN, so A MUN will hold with support from A BOH rather than leave the center exposed. A VEN will contest TRI; A MAR holds and F GOL stays clear of Italian centers. Please keep pressing Austria in the north, especially around WAR and STP.

A TYR is attacking MUN, so I will defend: A MUN holds with A BOH supporting. A VEN will contest TRI, while A MAR holds; F GOL stays clear of your centers. I cannot press VIE this turn without giving Austria MUN. Please continue denying Austria where you can.

I won’t agree to leave VIE unchallenged while you remain five centers from a solo. Since you’re ordering A TYR–MUN, A MUN will hold with A BOH support; A VEN will contest TRI. I’m not ordering into your centers beyond that contest.

notes.note: Move GAS–SPA with WES support as promised; attempt to take German center in Fall. Austria remains five centers from solo; Italy and England say they are contesting its eastern line. No new French centers are unowned.

Move POR-Spa to defend my German center; France’s GAS could threaten it. Austria says no move into POR/SPA this Spring; England and Italy also promised to leave them alone. Reassess Fall and protect both centers.

Protect MUN from Austria’s TYR attack with BOH support. Convoy MAR toward English-held TUN, aiming to gain it in Fall. VEN contests TYR; continue denying Austria’s solo. England promised northern pressure and to keep fleets clear of Italian centers.

Austria says MOS-STP supported by PRU; defend STP with NOR support, but BAR holds. Contest PRU with BAL and take CON with AEG. Italy promises continued pressure on VIE/no aid Austria; France avoids English centers and goes SPA; Germany holds POR.

England contests PRU and TRI; move LVN into vacated PRU as PRU attacks BER, while MOS presses STP. Protect TRI with ALB/VIE support and SER supports TRI hold. TYR continues against MUN; Italy likely defends. England, Italy, France all refuse restraint; seek openings next turn.

messages.body: You now hold BER and I hold CON, while your fleets press my northern line. Are you moving F CON–CON to reclaim it and targeting BER this Fall? I will contest any English advance into Austrian centers; I propose we avoid further gains against each other while we contain the other fronts.

With A TYR now in MUN, can we stop the VIE/TRI fight this Fall? I propose A MUN hold and A BOH stay out of VIE; I will keep A VIE and A BUD out of TRI and have no move against MAR or VEN. What are your exact orders?

Your A SPA is due to take SPA this Fall, and I have no order against French centers. Are you keeping F WES clear of my southern units? Please confirm your Fall targets; I need to plan around the English and Italian fronts.

Austria is still the immediate solo threat. Will A MUN attack VIE with A BOH supporting, and will A VEN contest TRI? Austria has A TRI and A TYR, so please give me your exact targets; I’ll keep my fleets focused on denying Austrian gains.

A SPA can take the German-owned center if it remains there at turn’s end. Please keep A SPA in SPA and avoid supporting Austria; I’ll keep my western forces clear of French centers. What are your orders for A SPA and F WES?

Austria remains the immediate threat. A POR can’t reach an Austrian center this turn, but please avoid supporting Austria and don’t move against English centers. Are you contesting A SPA, or will you leave it for France to claim?

Austria’s A BER will take your center unless dislodged. Can F BAL attack BER with F HOL supporting? Please make this your priority and keep pressure on Austria’s gains elsewhere. My A SPA will stay in SPA, taking it for France.
Your A BER is poised to take an English center, bringing you closer to a solo. I’m not supporting your expansion. What are your Fall targets? Keep your units clear of French centers.

Austria remains the immediate solo threat. Please keep contesting Austrian centers this Fall, especially with A MUN and A BOH against VIE, and keep your units clear of French centers. What are your exact targets?

Austria is poised to gain BER and move to 14 centers. What are A BER and your other western-facing units doing this Fall? Please avoid any move against POR; I have no unit able to contest your northern gains.
A SPA can take my POR, my only remaining secure center. Please keep A SPA out of POR this Fall; I will keep A POR clear of French centers. Can you confirm your plan for A SPA?

Austria is set to gain BER and remains the main solo threat. Are your eastern forces contesting Austrian gains this Fall? I have only A POR and will stay clear of English centers; please leave POR untouched.

Austria is still the immediate solo threat, and A BER may give it another center this Fall. Please use your northern forces to contest Austrian gains; what are your exact orders around BER, WAR, and STP? I’ll keep my units out of English centers.
I will not support your expansion. A MUN and A BOH can continue to contest your southern line; what are A TYR and A VIE doing this Fall? I’ll keep my units out of your centers other than VIE.
France’s A SPA may take SPA from you this Fall. Can A POR contest SPA? Austria remains the larger solo threat, and I’ll keep my units clear of POR and SPA.

A BER will hold to secure the center; my western-facing units have no order against POR or SPA this Fall. I am focused on preventing English gains and dealing with Italy’s pressure around VIE. Please keep A POR clear of Austrian centers.

A TYR will attack MUN again; A VIE will hold against pressure, and A TRI will support its defense. A BUD will stay out of TRI, and I have no order against MAR or VEN. I cannot leave VIE exposed while your forces threaten it.

A BER will hold this Fall; my other western-facing units have no order against PAR, BRE, or SPA. I am focused on the English and Italian fronts. Please keep A SPA clear of Austrian centers, and let me know whether F WES will remain clear of my southern units.

I won’t agree to stop contesting your gains while you remain one center from victory. F BAL attacks BER with F HOL supporting, and F CON holds to reclaim CON. Keep your forces out of English centers; I will defend them.

My eastern forces are contesting Austria: F BAL attacks BER with F HOL supporting, while F CON holds CON. I’ll leave POR untouched as agreed. France says A SPA will stay in SPA, so you risk losing that center unless you can dislodge it.

F BAL attacks BER with F HOL supporting; F CON holds to reclaim CON, and my northern forces remain focused on denying Austria. I’ll keep my units clear of Italian centers. Please keep contesting Austrian positions and don’t support its gains.

A SPA staying in SPA means France takes it from Germany, so I won’t interfere there. F BAL attacks BER with F HOL supporting, and F CON holds to reclaim CON. Please keep your units clear of English centers and avoid helping Austria.

F WES will support A SPA holding SPA; I will keep it clear of your southern units and will not support Austrian gains. Please keep your units out of French centers. I need you to stop taking English centers before you reach 18.

A SPA will remain in SPA and take the center for France. I understand this costs you your last center, but France has only BRE and PAR and needs to expand. A POR can hold and stay clear of French centers; I will not order A SPA to POR.

A SPA will hold and F WES will support it, taking SPA for France. I cannot spare F WES to help dislodge A BER; please attack BER with F BAL and any available support. Keep pressure on Austrian gains and keep your western units clear of French centers.

A POR will contest A SPA with a move to SPA; I won’t support Austria or move against English centers. If France holds SPA, the attack may bounce, but I can’t simply leave Germany’s other center uncontested.
A POR can move to SPA, and I intend to contest France there rather than leave the center undefended. I’ll keep clear of Italian centers; please continue keeping your units clear of POR and SPA.

I will not agree to a pause that leaves your 13 centers unchallenged. A MUN and A BOH will pressure VIE; A VEN will continue contesting TRI. My units will stay clear of your other centers. What are A TYR and A VIE doing this Fall?

I’ll keep contesting Austria: A MUN and A BOH will pressure VIE, and A VEN will contest TRI. Please use your northern forces to deny Austria’s gains, especially BER, WAR, and STP, and keep your fleets clear of Italian centers. What are your exact orders there?
