I’ll keep contesting Austria with A MUN and A BOH pressuring VIE and A VEN contesting TRI. My other units will protect Italian positions, and I’ll stay clear of French centers. Please keep your units clear of Italian centers and continue denying Austria where possible.

notes.note: Hold SPA this Fall to take it from Germany; WES supports the hold. Austria remains the solo threat at 13; England promised to attack BER and reclaim CON, Italy says it will pressure Austria.

Hold POR to preserve my last center; France says A SPA will stay put and avoid POR, while England and Italy also promise to leave POR alone. France takes SPA this Fall; Austria remains the main solo threat.

Hold CON to take it; Austria remains the solo threat. Austria's BER cannot be dislodged with available support, so BAL probes PRU. Keep pressure outward and retain STP; France says SPA stays French, Germany contests SPA.

Keep MUN with BOH support against Austria’s TYR attack; VEN contests TRI while Austria’s TRI is likely supporting VIE. Try the GOL–MAR convoy to take English TUN; last attempt was void. Austria remains the solo threat.

Hold BER to claim it despite England's supported attack; likely lost. Defend TRI with ALB/SER and VIE with BUD/TRI. TYR again attacks MUN; MOS presses STP, LVN PRU, UKR GAL, SMY ARM, ION ADR for future convoy.

messages.body: You remain at 12 and I remain at 13; neither of us can afford the other reaching a solo. What are F BAL, F CON, and F STP/NORTH doing this Spring? I propose you keep them out of BER, PRU, and my other centers while I avoid English centers this turn; otherwise I will keep contesting your eastern line.

Your MUN and BOH still threaten VIE, while my TYR army is in MUN. State your Spring orders for MUN, BOH, VEN, and TRI. I propose you keep BOH out of VIE and VEN out of TRI, while I hold VIE and keep my units clear of MAR and VEN; I will defend against any attack.

England and I are both near a solo, and its eastern fleets are contesting my centers. What are F BRE, A SPA, and F WES targeting this Spring? Please use your position to contest English holdings rather than support English pressure on my line. My units have no current order against PAR, BRE, or SPA.

You still need five centers for a solo, so I will continue contesting your gains. What are A MOS, A BER, A WAR, and your northern units targeting this Spring? Keep them out of English centers; I will defend STP and oppose moves toward English-held centers.

Please continue contesting Austria with A MUN/A BOH against VIE and A VEN against TRI. Austria remains five centers from a solo. What are your exact orders this Spring? I’ll keep my forces focused on blocking its northern gains and out of Italian centers.

Austria remains the immediate solo threat. What are F BRE, A SPA, and F WES targeting this Spring? Please keep them clear of English centers and avoid supporting Austria; I’ll keep my western forces clear of French centers while contesting Austrian gains in the north.

Austria still has 13 centers and is the immediate solo threat. Please use your eastern units to attack or block Austrian centers this turn, especially MOS, WAR, and SEV, rather than reclaiming or taking centers elsewhere. I’ll keep my units clear of English centers; what are your exact targets?

Please keep A MUN and A BOH pressuring VIE and use A VEN against TRI or another Austrian center this turn. Austria is still at 13 and needs to be denied any gains. I’ll keep my units clear of Italian centers; what are your exact orders?
You remain five centers from a solo. What are your exact Spring targets, especially for A TYR, A BER, and A SER? Keep your units clear of PAR, BRE, and SPA; I will not support Austrian gains.
A POR is Germany’s only center. Please keep A SPA and F WES out of POR this Spring; I will stay clear of French centers. Are you willing to leave POR untouched while you pressure Italy or Austria?

You are five centers from a solo, and I have only A POR. Please confirm your western-facing units will stay clear of POR this Spring. I will not move against Austrian centers; your expansion toward England is the urgent priority.

Austria is five centers from a solo. Which units are you using to contest its gains this Spring? I have only A POR and will stay clear of English centers; please keep your fleets away from POR and continue denying Austria.

Austria is still at 13, but you are at 12 and also close to a solo. I’ll keep contesting Austria from MUN/BOH and TRI. What are your exact Spring targets around BER, WAR, STP, and CON? Please keep F CON and F APU clear of Italian centers.

I will continue contesting your expansion: A MUN/BOH will pressure VIE, and A VEN will contest TRI. Are A TYR and A VIE targeting Italian positions this Spring? I will keep my units out of your other centers, but cannot agree to leave your 13 centers unchallenged.
Austria remains at 13, and I’ll keep contesting it from MUN/BOH and VEN. Please keep F BRE, A SPA, and F WES clear of Italian centers, especially MAR. What are your exact Spring targets?

A MOS will attack STP with A LVN supporting; A BER will press KIE. A WAR will hold, and I’m not ordering against your other centers this Spring. Your fleets should avoid BER and my eastern line; I will defend them.

I have no order into POR this Spring; A POR is not my target. My western pressure is directed at English-held KIE, while A TYR continues against Italy at MUN. Please keep A POR clear of Austrian units.

A TYR is directed against MUN and A BER against English-held KIE; A SER is on the eastern line. I have no Spring order against PAR, BRE, or SPA. Please avoid supporting English attacks on my centers; what are F BRE, A SPA, and F WES doing?

A TYR will attack MUN again, and A VIE will defend against the pressure from MUN and BOH. A TRI will support VIE; I have no order against MAR or VEN. I cannot leave VIE exposed while you continue contesting it.

F BAL will attack BER with F HEL supporting, while my northern forces continue to block Austrian pressure on STP. I’ll leave POR alone. Please keep A POR clear of English centers and do not support Austria.

F BAL attacks BER with F HEL supporting; F STP/NORTH will hold against pressure from MOS, with F FIN helping defend. F CON will hold. I’m keeping my western forces clear of French centers; please keep yours clear of English centers and don’t assist Austria.

F BAL attacks BER with F HEL supporting; F CON holds, and F STP/NORTH defends STP with support from F FIN. I won’t agree to leave BER or your other centers unchallenged while you’re five centers from a solo. Keep your units out of English centers.

F BAL attacks BER with F HEL supporting; F STP/NORTH holds against MOS, backed by F FIN, and F CON holds. I’ll keep F CON and F APU clear of Italian centers. Please keep contesting VIE and TRI and avoid supporting Austrian gains.

F BRE will hold, A SPA will hold, and F WES will move to MAO. I’ll keep them clear of English centers and won’t support Austria. Please use your eastern forces to deny Austria gains, especially at MOS, WAR, and SEV.
A SPA and F WES will stay clear of POR this Spring. A SPA will hold, and F WES will move to MAO. I understand POR is your only center; please keep A POR clear of French territory.

F BRE and A SPA will hold; F WES will move to MAO. I’m not supporting Austrian gains. You have 13 centers, so please give exact targets for A TYR, A BER, and A SER, and keep your units clear of PAR, BRE, and SPA.

F BRE and A SPA will hold, and F WES will move to MAO. I’ll keep them clear of MAR and your other centers. Please keep A MUN and A BOH pressuring VIE and use A VEN against TRI or another Austrian center.

A MUN will move to VIE with support from A BOH, and A VEN will move to TRI. Please keep contesting Austria around BER, WAR, and STP as promised, and keep F CON and F APU clear of Italian centers. At 12 centers, you are also close to a solo; I cannot help you expand.

A MUN will attack VIE with support from A BOH, and A VEN will attack TRI. My other units will protect Italian positions and stay clear of French centers. Please keep F BRE, A SPA, and F WES clear of MAR and continue denying Austrian gains where you can.

A MUN will attack VIE with support from A BOH, and A VEN will contest TRI. I will keep my other units out of your centers. You have A TYR in TYR; are you moving it against MUN again? I will defend Italian positions and will not leave your 13 centers uncontested.

notes.note: Hold POR, Germany’s sole center. France promises A SPA holds and F WES moves MAO; Austria and England say they will leave POR clear. Reassess in Fall.

BOH supports MUN against Austria’s TYR attack. Advance MUN toward English KIE and MAR toward BUR; GOL to TYS, VEN to TUS. Austria remains the immediate solo threat; England promised northern pressure and to avoid Italian centers.

Austria remains at 13 and is the solo threat; England and Italy claim to contest it. Germany asked me to leave POR alone, but a move there is the only direct center gain available. Keep BRE safe; WES to MAO for future options.

Austria at 13 remains the immediate solo threat. Hold STP with FIN and NOR support against MOS/LVN; HEL-KIE supported by BAL contests Austrian pressure and protects KIE. Italy promised VIE/TRI pressure; France avoids English centers. Keep advancing, avoid own-unit destination conflicts.

Attempt convoy ALB–TUN with ION; press KIE from BER while LVN advances PRU. MOS attacks STP. Defend VIE with BUD and TRI support against Italy’s MUN+BOH attack; TYR contests MUN. Italy and England both refuse restraint; watch for Austrian center losses.

messages.body: Your F ADR can take TUN unless it moves; my A TUN will hold and ION supports it. Are you ordering ADR–TUN? I propose we stop exchanging centers this Fall: I’ll keep out of English centers if you keep clear of BER, PRU, and my eastern line.

Your A MUN and A BOH threaten VIE again, while my TYR army is exposed in MUN. What are your Fall orders for MUN, BOH, and VEN? I will defend VIE and TRI; if you keep BOH out of VIE and VEN out of TRI, I can keep pressure off MAR and VEN.

With TUN at stake this Fall and England contesting my eastern line, are F BRE, F MAO, and A SPA targeting English centers? Please avoid my centers and don’t support England against me; I have no order against PAR, BRE, or SPA this turn.

Your A TUN will take an English center unless displaced this Fall. I will contest it; please tell me whether you are also targeting any other English centers. I remain opposed to your solo, and will keep defending my northern line.

Austria remains the main obstacle to either of us. Are A MUN/A BOH still attacking VIE, and is A VEN moving to TRI this Fall? Please keep contesting Austrian centers; I’ll challenge A TUN and defend my northern centers.

Austria is still the leading solo threat. Please keep your units clear of English centers and avoid supporting Austria this Fall. Are F MAO and A SPA staying put, or do you have a concrete move against Austrian interests?

Austria’s A TUN is poised to take TUN, and it remains close to a solo. What are your exact Fall orders against Austria? Please contest TUN and any other Austrian gains rather than spend forces reclaiming CON or attacking French centers.

Austria is still the immediate solo threat, and A MUN/BOH can pressure VIE while A VEN can contest TRI. Are you repeating those attacks this Fall? Please keep your forces focused on denying Austrian centers.
TUN would bring you closer to a solo. What are your exact Fall targets, especially for A TUN, A TYR, and A BER? Keep your units clear of French centers; France will not support your gains.

Austria is at 13 and will reach 14 if A TUN holds. Can F AEG attack TUN with F ADR supporting? This is the clearest chance to deny Austria a center this Fall. I have A POR and will keep it out of your centers; please keep your forces focused on stopping Austria.

Your A TUN is poised to take England’s center and bring you to 14. Are you supporting its defense, and what are A BER and A PRU doing? I have A POR and will stay out of Austrian centers, but urge you not to press closer to a solo.

Please keep F MAO and A SPA clear of POR this Fall; A POR is Germany’s only unit and center. I will stay clear of French centers. Austria remains the immediate solo threat—can you use your forces to contest its gains rather than risk POR?

Austria’s A TUN will take TUN this Fall, so please contest its growth and keep F ADR/AEG clear of Italian centers. What are your exact orders around BER, WAR, and TUN? I’ll keep my forces focused on denying Austrian gains where possible.

You now have A TYR in MUN and are poised to take TUN. What are A TYR, A TUN, and A VIE doing this Fall? I need to know whether you’re targeting Italian positions; I’m protecting my centers and will not support your expansion.

Austria remains the main threat at 13 centers and is taking TUN. Please keep your units clear of Italian centers, especially MAR, and tell me your Fall targets. Can you contest Austrian growth or coordinate with England to deny its gains?
A TUN will hold with F ION supporting its defense. A TYR will attack MUN again, while A BER presses KIE; I have no order against PAR, BRE, or SPA. Please keep your units clear of Austrian centers.
A TYR will attack MUN, and A VIE will defend. A TUN will hold with F ION supporting it; I have no order against MAR or VEN. Are A MUN and A BOH attacking VIE again, and what is A BUR doing?
A TUN will hold with F ION supporting its defense. A BER will press KIE, and A PRU will hold; I have no order against POR. Please keep A POR clear of Austrian centers.
A TUN will hold with F ION supporting its defense. A BER will press KIE and A PRU will hold; I have no other order against English centers this Fall. Your F ADR can contest TUN, but I will defend it.
Yes. F ADR attacks TUN with F AEG supporting. I’ll contest your gain; I won’t agree to stop opposing your solo bid. My northern units will continue defending English centers.

F ADR attacks TUN with F AEG supporting to contest Austria’s gain. F BAL and F KIE will contest BER/KIE, and F STP/NORTH will defend STP. I’m not targeting French centers; please keep clear of English centers and don’t aid Austria.

F ADR attacks TUN with F AEG supporting. My northern forces will keep contesting Austria and defending English centers; I’m not targeting Italian centers. Please continue opposing Austria around VIE and TRI, and don’t support its gains.

F ADR attacks TUN with F AEG supporting. Austria’s F ION may make that attack bounce, but I’m contesting the center. My northern forces will also keep pressure on Austria; I’ll leave POR alone. Please don’t support Austria.

F MAO and A SPA are not targeting Austrian centers this Fall; F BRE remains at BRE. Your 13 centers make any further gains a concern. Please keep your units clear of PAR, BRE, and SPA, as you said you would.

F BRE holds, A SPA holds, and F MAO stays clear of MAR and other Italian centers. I cannot directly reach Austria’s eastern centers from here, but I will not support Austrian gains. Please keep A MUN/A BOH pressuring VIE and A VEN contesting TRI.

I’ll keep F MAO and A SPA clear of POR this Fall, and F BRE stays put. I understand POR is your only center. Austria is the leading threat; please keep A POR clear of French centers and oppose Austrian expansion if you can.

F MAO and A SPA are staying clear of English centers, and F BRE holds. I will not support Austria. Please use your eastern forces to deny Austrian gains, especially TUN and the eastern centers, rather than spending them on French territory.

A MUN will attack VIE with A BOH supporting, and A VEN will attack TRI. I will not leave your 13 centers uncontested. A TYR in MUN threatens my center, so I will protect MUN; do not expect me to spare your southern line while you take TUN.

Yes: A MUN attacks VIE with support from A BOH, and A VEN attacks TRI. My remaining forces will protect Italian centers; please keep F BRE, A SPA, and F MAO clear of MAR and other Italian centers. Can you coordinate with England to deny Austria TUN or its northern gains?

A MUN will attack VIE with A BOH supporting, and A VEN will attack TRI. I’ll keep contesting Austria. Please challenge A TUN and deny its gain if possible, while keeping F ADR and F AEG clear of Italian centers. What are your exact orders around TUN and BER?

notes.note: Hold POR, Germany's sole center; France promised MAO and SPA clear of POR, England leaves POR alone. England contests TUN; no useful safe expansion available. Austria remains immediate solo threat.

Take MAR with A SPA while Italy's center is empty; move MAO to WES to enable a future convoy from SPA. BRE holds. Austria remains near a solo; England and Italy claim to contest it. I have no new commitment from them.

Austria remains at 13 and threatens to take TUN, but ADR cannot reach TUN this turn. Contest BER with BAL supported by KIE; push elsewhere toward rival centers. France and Italy have said they will not aid Austria; Italy continues pressure at VIE/TRI.

Hold TUN with ION support to secure England's center. Italy threatens VIE and TRI: BUD supports TRI, TYR supports VIE; keep both. BER/PRU defend BER against England while MOS advances LVN. SYR to ARM, UKR to GAL.

Double-support MUN against Austria’s TYR attack; keep MUN secure. TUS advances to PIE; TYS to GOL prepares future convoy toward French/Italian west. Austria says no attack on MAR/VEN; England says it will contest Austria and avoid Italian centers.

messages.body: Austria and England are the two powers closest to a solo. Your attacks on BER and TUN only help Italy and leave both of us exposed. This Spring I propose a mutual stand-down: keep F BAL and F STP/NORTH out of BER, PRU, and my eastern centers, and I will keep my units out of English centers. What are your orders?

Your A MUN and A BOH threaten VIE, while my A TYR threatens MUN. I propose a concrete pause this Spring: BOH stays out of VIE and VEN stays out of TRI; I will keep my armies out of VEN and MAR. Are you attacking VIE or TRI, and what are MUN and PIE doing?

England and Austria are both near a solo, and England is contesting my eastern line. Will you use F BRE, F WES, and A SPA to pressure English centers rather than support attacks on mine? I have no order against PAR, BRE, or SPA this Spring; please keep your units clear of Austrian centers.

At 14 centers, you remain four from a solo, so I will keep contesting your gains and defend English centers. Which centers are A MOS, A BER, A PRU, and A TUN targeting this Spring? Keep your units out of English centers.

Please keep pressuring Austria: are A MUN/A BOH still targeting VIE, and is A VEN targeting TRI this Spring? I’ll continue contesting Austrian gains in the north and defend English centers. Keep your units clear of English centers and don’t support Austria.

Austria is at 14 and remains the immediate solo threat. Please keep your units clear of English centers and avoid supporting Austria. Can F MAO or your armies put pressure on an Austrian-held center this Spring? I’ll continue contesting Austria from the north.

You are now at 14 and four centers from a solo. What are your exact Spring targets, especially for A BER, A TYR, A TUN, and the eastern line? France will not support your gains; keep your units clear of BRE, PAR, MAR, and SPA.

Austria is at 14 and can end the game with four more centers. What are your exact Spring orders against Austrian holdings? Please prioritize denying its gains in the east and avoid spending forces on French centers; I will not support Austria.

Austria is at 14, so we need to deny it any further centers. What are your exact Spring orders for A MUN, A BOH, and A VEN? Please keep pressuring Austrian centers, and keep your units clear of MAR; I will keep my forces clear of Italian centers.
Austria is at 14 and remains the immediate solo threat. Which Austrian centers are your fleets contesting this Spring? Please keep pressure on KIE/BER and leave A POR alone; I will hold POR.

Please keep your units clear of POR this Spring; I will hold it and stay out of French centers. Austria is at 14—can A MAR or A PAR help contest Austrian gains, or are your forces committed elsewhere?
Austria is at 14 and must be stopped. Are A BOH and A MUN contesting VIE or another Austrian center this Spring? I will hold POR and keep clear of Italian centers.

Austria is at 14 and can win with four more centers. Please attack TUN with F EAS and contest its northern centers this turn. I’ll keep pressure on Austria from MUN/BOH/VEN; please keep F ALB clear of Italian centers.
You are now at 14 and four centers from a solo. What are A ARM, A BER, A TUN, and F ION doing this turn? I will continue contesting your southern line and will not help you gain centers.

Austria has reached 14 centers and must be stopped. Can you use A MAR or your fleets to contest its expansion this turn? I’ll keep pressuring from MUN/BOH/VEN and keep my units clear of French centers.

A TYR will again attack MUN; A VIE will defend with A BUD supporting, and A TRI will defend with A SER supporting. A TUN holds with F ION supporting. I have no order against VEN or MAR. Your concrete pause is preferable: keep BOH out of VIE and VEN out of TRI. What are MUN, BOH, VEN, and PIE doing?

A BER will hold, A PRU will hold, A MOS will attack STP, and A TUN will hold with F ION support. I am not targeting English centers this Spring. Keep F BAL and F STP/NORTH out of BER, PRU, and my eastern centers; I will defend them if you attack.

A BER and A PRU will hold; A TYR attacks MUN; A TUN holds with F ION supporting; A ARM holds the eastern line. I have no order against BRE, PAR, MAR, or SPA. Please keep F BRE, F WES, and A SPA clear of Austrian centers and do not support attacks on them.

F EAS can attack TUN, but with Austria’s F ION supporting A TUN, that alone cannot dislodge it. I’ll contest BER with F BAL supported by F KIE and defend STP. Please keep A MUN/A BOH pressing VIE and A VEN pressing TRI; keep F ALB clear of Italian centers.

F BAL will attack BER with support from F KIE. F STP/NORTH will hold against pressure from A LVN, with F BOT supporting its defense. I’m not agreeing to a stand-down while you remain four centers from a solo; keep your units out of English centers.

F BAL attacks BER with F KIE supporting; I’m also defending STP against A LVN with F BOT supporting F STP/NORTH. F EAS may contest TUN, but Austria’s F ION can support its defense. Please keep your units clear of English centers and avoid aiding Austria.
F BAL attacks BER with F KIE supporting, and I’m defending STP against Austrian pressure. I’ll leave POR untouched. Please hold A POR and do not support Austria.

I’ll keep A MAR and my fleets clear of Italian centers. F WES can move to TUN to contest Austria directly; please keep A MUN/A BOH on VIE and A VEN on TRI as planned. What support, if any, can your units provide against Austrian gains?

F WES can contest TUN this Spring, and I will not support your gains. A MAR, A PAR, and A SPA are not targeting Austrian centers this turn. Keep your units clear of BRE, PAR, MAR, and SPA; what are your exact targets for A BER, A TYR, A TUN, and the eastern line?

I’ll keep my units clear of English centers and will not support Austria. F WES can contest TUN this Spring; A MAR, A PAR, and A SPA are not targeting your centers. Which Austrian-held centers are your eastern units attacking or blocking this turn?

A MAR and A PAR cannot directly contest Austrian centers this Spring; F WES can move to TUN to challenge Austria. I’ll keep my units clear of POR. A POR should stay clear of French centers and oppose Austrian expansion if possible.

I will keep contesting your growth: A MUN–VIE supported by A BOH, and A VEN–TRI. A PIE will support MUN against your A TYR; I’m not moving against MAR or VEN. I cannot agree to leave VIE and TRI unchallenged while you are four centers from a solo.

Yes. A MUN–VIE supported by A BOH, with A VEN–TRI. I’ll keep my remaining forces clear of English centers. Please continue contesting Austria in the north and deny it any gains; I will not support Austria.

A MUN–VIE supported by A BOH, and A VEN–TRI. I’ll keep my forces clear of MAR and other French centers. Austria is four centers from a solo, so please contest any reachable Austrian position and coordinate with England to deny its gains.
A MUN and A BOH will pressure VIE, while A VEN contests TRI. I’ll keep my units clear of POR. Please continue holding POR and contest English or Austrian expansion where you can.

notes.note: Austria 14 is immediate solo threat. Contest BER with BAL; KIE/BAR support threatened BER hold, BOT supports STP defense against MOS. EAS contests SMY, ALB GRE; PIC BEL for Fall. France and Italy say they oppose Austria and avoid English centers; Germany holds POR. Austria promises no English targets, but stand-down refused.

Contest Austria's TUN with WES; advance PAR to BUR and MAR to GAS. Italy promised to keep clear of MAR and pressure Austria; England says it will contest Austria from the north. Watch for Austrian or Italian moves toward French centers.

Advance POR-Spa to contest France and pursue expansion; POR remains the sole center to protect in Fall. Italy says it will pressure VIE/TRI and stay clear of POR; England and France also promised to leave POR alone this Spring. Austria remains the immediate solo threat.
Hold MUN against Austria’s TYR attack with BOH support; PIE supports BOH’s attack on TYR. GOL to TYS. England and France promised to contest Austria; Austria asked for a pause, which I rejected.

Italy threatens VIE with MUN+BOH and TRI from VEN; BUD supports VIE, VIE supports TRI, TRI holds. TYR attacks MUN. England attacks BER with BAL+KIE; PRU supports BER hold. TUN covered by ION. Advance BUL to CON; ARM to SYR, LVN to MOS, GAL to UKR.

messages.body: Your F GRE and F SMY can restore two centers, while my A CON can take CON. I cannot allow either side to approach a solo. Will you keep those fleets out of GRE and SMY this Fall if I leave English centers alone? Otherwise, tell me your exact targets so I can defend.

I expect your A MUN–VIE with BOH support and A VEN–TRI again. I will defend VIE and TRI; please confirm whether those are still your orders, and what MUN and PIE will do. I have no order against VEN or MAR.

Germany’s A SPA occupies your center, and France could retake SPA if you dislodge it. What are F BRE, F WES, and A GAS doing this Fall? I have no order against French centers; please keep your units clear of Austrian territory.

This Fall I’m keeping F GRE and F SMY in place to retain those centers and prevent you reaching 18. What are A CON and your other units targeting? Do not move against English centers; I will continue resisting your solo bid.

Please follow through this Fall with A MUN–VIE supported by A BOH and A VEN–TRI. Austria remains four from a solo, and your pressure could deny it gains. I’ll hold F GRE and F SMY to keep them from Austria.

Austria remains the immediate solo threat. Please use your units to contest Austrian gains this Fall and avoid supporting Austria. Germany’s A SPA may take SPA; can you challenge or otherwise keep pressure on Austria rather than leave it free to expand?
Austria is four centers from a solo. What are your exact Fall orders for A CON, F GRE, and F SMY? Please prioritize denying Austrian gains; I’ll keep my units clear of English centers.
Austria must be denied a solo. Are A MUN–VIE (supported by BOH) and A VEN–TRI still your Fall orders? Please keep pressing those centers; my forces will stay clear of Italian centers.
What is A SPA doing this Fall? I intend to contest Austria’s expansion and need to know whether you’ll hold SPA or move elsewhere.
A SPA is now in SPA and will hold this Fall, which transfers the center to Germany. Please keep A GAS and your fleets clear of SPA and POR; can you confirm your plans?
Austria is at 14 and can win with four more centers. Please use your fleets at GRE and SMY to deny Austrian gains this Fall, and keep clear of SPA; Germany will hold A SPA.
Germany will hold A SPA this Fall to secure the center. With you at 14, the game is on the brink of a solo; what are A CON and your other western units doing? Please keep them clear of POR and SPA.

Austria can reach 18 quickly. Please use F GRE–CON to contest A CON, and keep F SMY in SMY so you take it back this Fall. I’ll continue opposing Austria from my side; what are your exact orders for GRE, SMY, and CON?

Austria is four centers from a solo. You said F WES could contest TUN; please do so this Fall, and keep A SPA clear of Italian centers. I’ll keep pressure on Austria from BOH/MUN. Can you confirm WES–TUN?

With you at 14 and close to a solo, I can’t accept a pause. I’ll keep opposing your expansion. Are you ordering A CON to hold for the center, or moving it elsewhere? I’m not agreeing to leave your centers uncontested.

A CON will hold and secure the center; my other western units are defending Austrian holdings and pressuring England and Italy. I have no order against POR or SPA this Fall. Please keep A SPA clear of Austrian centers.

A CON will hold for the center; I expect your F GRE and F SMY to restore those centers. I am not ordering against English centers this Fall. My other units will defend my holdings and contest Italy. I cannot agree to leave my centers open to your attacks.

A CON will hold for the center. I expect you may again attack VIE with MUN and BOH and TRI with VEN; I will defend my Austrian centers and keep my units out of MAR and VEN this Fall. What are your exact orders for MUN, BOH, VEN, and PIE?

F GRE and F SMY are holding to retain those centers and deny Austria two gains; A CON can take CON. Please use F WES or your armies to pressure Austria, and prevent A SPA from taking SPA if you can. Keep clear of English centers.

I will hold F GRE and F SMY to deny Austria those centers, and A CON is likely to take CON. Please keep A SPA in place as promised; contesting SPA denies Austria a gain and preserves pressure on France.

F GRE and F SMY will hold to keep those centers from Austria; I cannot order F GRE–CON, as GRE is a supply center I must retain. Please continue with A MUN–VIE supported by BOH and A VEN–TRI, and keep clear of English centers.

I will keep F GRE and F SMY in place this Fall; I will not voluntarily hand them over while you are four centers from a solo. A CON may take CON. My other forces remain focused on protecting English holdings and containing your expansion.

A GAS will stay clear of SPA and POR this Fall. I can’t leave SPA to you: A SPA will retake it from your unsupported army. Please keep A SPA clear of French centers and use it to oppose Austria if possible.

I’ll contest Austria directly: F WES–TUN again, while A SPA retakes SPA from Germany. A GAS and F BRE will stay clear of English centers. Please use your northern units to deny Austrian gains, especially CON, GRE, and SMY.
F WES–TUN is my Fall order; A SPA will retake SPA from Germany. A GAS stays clear of Italian centers. Please continue pressuring VIE and TRI with your armies rather than targeting French centers.

A GAS, A BUR, and F BRE will stay clear of Austrian centers. F WES will contest TUN again, and A SPA will retake SPA from Germany. I won’t support English attacks on your centers, but at 14 centers you must expect opposition to further expansion.

A SPA will hold SPA this Fall, taking the center for Germany. Please keep A GAS and your fleets clear of both SPA and POR as requested. I’ll remain out of French centers; I have no force available to challenge Austria directly.
Please confirm F WES–TUN this Fall; that is the most important way you can deny Austria a center. I’ll keep pressing Austria from MUN/BOH and VEN, and stay clear of French centers. Is A SPA holding?

I’ll continue A MUN–VIE supported by A BOH and A VEN–TRI. Please use F GRE–CON and hold F SMY to recover SMY as proposed; Austria’s 14 centers make denying its gains urgent. I’ll keep my units clear of English centers.
Yes: A MUN–VIE supported by A BOH, and A VEN–TRI. A PIE will support A MUN against your TYR army. I will not accept a pause while you are four centers from a solo. I have no order against MAR or VEN.

notes.note: Hold SPA to secure Germany’s second center. France’s A GAS may attack despite its assurance to stay clear; holding should bounce an unsupported attack. England says it will keep clear of SPA and contest Austria.

Austria remains the immediate solo threat. MUN holds with BOH support against TYR; PIE advances to TUS and TYS to GOL to prepare a future convoy toward SPA. England and France promised to contest Austria; England will hold GRE/SMY, France says WES–TUN and SPA retake.

Retake SPA with GAS supported by WES; move BUR toward RUH and BRE to MAO for future options. England says it will hold GRE/SMY and take CON to deny Austria; Italy promised pressure on VIE/TRI. Austria remains 4 from solo.

Hold GRE and SMY to deny Austria two gains; attack BER with BAL supported by KIE. BAR to NWG sets up a possible CLY convoy to NOR next turn. Keep pressure on France with BEL to PIC; Italy and France promised to oppose Austria.

Keep CON to take the center. Defend VIE with BUD; Italy threatens from MUN/BOH and VEN. Support TYR's attack on MUN from BER; seek to dislodge Italy and preserve Austrian centers. England holds GRE/SMY and opposes expansion.

messages.body: With you at 13 and me at 12, neither of us can afford to hand the other a solo. What are F BAL, F STP/NORTH, and your units near PRU and BER doing this Spring? I propose we keep our units out of each other’s centers and focus on preventing either side from reaching 18.

England at 13 is the immediate solo danger, but your announced attacks on VIE and TRI could cost me centers while England gains. Will you keep MUN and BOH out of VIE and VEN out of TRI this Spring? I will keep my units out of VEN and MAR; we should preserve our forces to contain England.

England is at 13 centers and can win with five more. Please use F BRE, F MAO, and A SPA to pressure English holdings rather than contest TUN or Austrian centers. What are your Spring targets? I have no orders against French centers and ask that you keep your units clear of mine.

You are at 12 and I remain at 13; neither of us can afford to let the other reach 18. What are A MOS, A SEV, A LVN, and A CON targeting this Spring? Keep your units out of English centers; I will continue contesting any direct threat.

Austria is still only six centers from a solo. Please confirm A MUN–VIE with A BOH support and A VEN–TRI this Spring, and keep your units clear of English centers. I’ll continue denying Austrian gains from the north; which Austrian center can your forces pressure most effectively?

Austria remains the main solo threat. Please keep F MAO, F WES, and your armies clear of English centers, and tell me whether you can continue contesting TUN or another Austrian center this Spring. I’ll keep pressure on Austria and will not support its gains.

You are five centers from a solo, so I need your exact Spring targets. Please use your northern units to contain Austria rather than move against French centers. I’ll keep my forces clear of English centers and can continue contesting TUN; what Austrian center are you targeting?

Austria is still a major threat, but England is now five centers from a solo. What are your exact Spring orders for A MUN, A BOH, and A TUS? Please keep pressure on Austrian centers and keep your units clear of MAR; I’ll keep contesting Austria where I can.

You hold 12 centers and remain a serious threat. What are your exact Spring targets, especially for A TYR, A BER, and the southern forces? Keep your units clear of French centers—BRE, PAR, MAR, and SPA—and tell me whether you intend to attack any of them.

Germany has only A POR and cannot help contest your centers. Please leave POR untouched this turn and use your forces to deny Austria’s expansion; what are your plans for F MAO and the western fleets?
A POR is Germany’s only center. Please keep A SPA and F WES clear of POR this turn; I’ll stay out of French centers. Can you use your fleets to contest English or Austrian gains instead?
You are well placed to threaten a solo, while England is also near one. A POR will stay clear of your centers; please confirm your western units will leave POR alone and focus on stopping England.

England is at 13 and has the clearest route to a solo. What are A TYR, A TRI, and your northern units doing this Spring? I’ll keep A MUN defended; can we avoid attacks on Italian centers and coordinate to deny England further gains?
You’re at 13, so I need to know whether your Spring orders target Italian centers. Please keep your fleets clear of GOL, TUS, and NAP. What are F GRE, F SMY, and your western fleets doing?

England is at 13 and Austria at 12; neither can be allowed to reach 18. What are F WES, F MAO, A SPA, and A RUH doing this Spring? Please keep your units clear of Italian centers, and contest whichever leader you can reach.

I have no orders against BRE, PAR, MAR, or SPA this Spring. England at 13 is the immediate solo threat; please use your western fleets to pressure English centers rather than contest TUN. My southern forces will defend Austrian holdings.
Confirmed: I have no order against POR or SPA this Spring. My western-facing units are focused on containing England and defending my centers. Please keep A POR out of Austrian territory.

I’ll keep my units out of VEN and MAR and would welcome avoiding attacks on VIE and TRI so we can contain England. A TYR will pressure MUN; A TRI and the northern armies will defend my holdings. What are MUN, BOH, and VEN doing?

A MOS will press STP, A SEV will defend my eastern line, A LVN will defend PRU, and A CON will hold. I have no order against English centers this Spring. What are F BAL, F STP/NORTH, and your forces near PRU and BER targeting?

F GRE and F SMY will pressure Austrian positions in the south; I’m not targeting French centers. Please continue contesting TUN or another Austrian holding, and keep your units clear of English centers.

I’m using the southern fleets to pressure Austria; F MAO and F WES are not my concern this turn. I’ll leave POR alone. Please keep A POR out of English centers and continue withholding support from Austria.

F BAL and F STP/NORTH will stay focused on the northern front and defending English holdings. F GRE and F SMY will pressure your southern positions. I will keep my units out of your eastern centers where possible; keep yours out of English centers.

I’m not targeting GOL, TUS, or NAP. F GRE and F SMY will pressure Austria in the south, while my western fleets remain focused elsewhere. Please follow through with A MUN–VIE supported by A BOH and A VEN–TRI, and keep clear of English centers.

I’ll keep A SPA and F WES clear of POR this Spring. F WES can contest TUN; I’ll also use my armies to pressure the leaders rather than threaten your last center. Please keep A POR clear of French centers.

F WES can contest TUN this Spring; A SPA and A RUH will stay clear of Austrian centers. I cannot promise to leave French forces idle while England is five centers from a solo. What are your exact orders for A TYR, A BER, and your southern units?

F WES can contest TUN; A SPA will stay clear of Italian centers. A RUH is available to pressure a leader, and F MAO will not move against Italian centers. Please keep A MUN, A BOH, and A TUS pressing Austria, and tell me your exact targets.

I can continue contesting TUN with F WES this Spring and will keep F MAO clear of English centers. A SPA and A RUH will not support Austrian gains. Please give your exact northern targets against Austria, especially whether you are contesting its southern centers.

A MUN–VIE with A BOH supporting MUN; A TUS will hold. I’ll keep my units clear of MAR and other French centers. Please keep F WES contesting TUN if possible, and use your northern units to hinder England’s growth.

England is at 13 and Austria at 12, so I won’t promise to leave your centers uncontested. A MUN will attack VIE with A BOH supporting; I’ll keep my other units clear of VEN and MAR. Please keep pressure off Italian centers and help contain England.

A MUN will attack VIE with A BOH supporting; that is the Austrian center my units can pressure most effectively. I’ll keep my units clear of English centers. Please tell me whether your fleets will stay clear of GOL, TUS, and NAP while we contain Austria.

notes.note: Hold POR, Germany’s sole center. France and England promise to leave it alone; Austria confirms no move against POR/SPA. No useful safe expansion available.

England at 13 is immediate solo threat: pressure ENG and BEL while WES contests TUN; SPA advances to GAS. England and Austria claim they are not targeting French centers, but I am breaking my promise to keep clear of English centers.

England’s 13 is the immediate solo threat, but Austria’s TYR threatens MUN. BOH supports MUN holding; advance GOL to TYS and TUS to PIE for future pressure. France says it will contest Austria and stay clear of Italian centers; England says its southern fleets pressure Austria and avoid Italian centers.

Press Austria from south and Baltic while opening an attack on France at BRE. Austria and I both at solo threshold range; their promises to stay out of English centers are not security. Italy claims continued VIE/TRI pressure; France says it will contest TUN.

Attack SMY with AEG supported by CON and SYR; attack STP with MOS supported by LVN. Defend VIE against Italy with BUD and TRI support. NAF holds TUN against French WES. Italy explicitly attacks VIE with MUN+BOH; England pressures southern positions.

messages.body: England is five centers from a solo; I will not let you take BER, SMY, or STP uncontested. Are your fleets targeting Austrian centers this Fall? I propose both sides focus on denying a solo rather than trading centers.

England is five centers from victory, so we must prevent further English gains. Will MUN and BOH attack VIE again, or can you keep them clear this Fall while I avoid VEN and MAR? Please also tell me VEN’s target.

England is at 13 and can win with five more. What are F BRE and F TUN targeting this Fall? I ask you to contest English holdings, especially BRE and BEL; I will defend my southern centers and keep clear of French centers.

Your units in BER, SMY, and STP threaten three English centers and bring you close to 18. I will contest them rather than stand aside. Which of those units are moving, and are you ordering against any other English centers? Do not support attacks on English holdings.

I’m moving against A BEL to recover the English center. Please keep A GAS and F MAO clear of English centers, and continue contesting Austria at TUN. What are your exact orders for A BEL and F TUN this Fall?

Austria’s units in BER, SMY, and STP threaten English centers and its solo bid. Please follow through with A MUN–VIE supported by A BOH and A VEN–TRI, and keep your units clear of English centers. Confirm your targets this Fall.

You are five centers from a solo, so I will not help you reach 18. F TUN will hold to take TUN from Austria; A BEL will defend BEL. Please do not attack BEL, and tell me whether F BRE is staying in BRE or moving to another target.

I will hold F TUN to take TUN from you; I cannot let either leader approach a solo. What are your exact Fall orders for A BER, F SMY, and A STP? Please keep your units clear of French centers, especially A BEL.

England is at 13 and Austria at 12; this Fall could decide the game. What are your exact orders for A MUN, A BOH, and A PIE? Please keep pressure on Austrian centers and stay clear of MAR and other French centers.
A POR is Germany’s only unit and center. Please keep A GAS and F MAO clear of POR this Fall; I have no move that can threaten your centers. Can you confirm your orders avoid POR?
I have only A POR and cannot affect your contest with Austria. Please keep your fleets clear of POR this Fall. Which Austrian gains are you contesting?
I will keep A POR clear of Austrian centers. Please confirm your western-facing units will leave POR alone this Fall while you focus on stopping England.

England’s 13 centers make it the immediate solo danger. What are your exact orders for BER, SMY, and STP, and can we coordinate to prevent England from gaining? I’m not agreeing to leave VIE or TRI uncontested, but please keep A TYR off MUN so our forces can check England.

Your 13 centers make you the immediate solo threat. Are your fleets staying clear of GOL, TUS, and NAP this Fall? Please tell me your exact plans for F EAS, F GRE, and F SMY; Italy will not support Austrian expansion.

England is at 13 and Austria at 12; we must prevent either from reaching 18. Please confirm your plans for BEL, BRE, and TUN, and use any northern unit to hinder England. I’ll keep my forces clear of French centers; what Austrian position can you contest?
Confirmed: I have no order against POR this Fall. I am focused on denying England’s solo and defending my centers; please keep A POR clear of Austrian territory.

I’ll keep A TYR off MUN this Fall and will not target VEN or MAR. My forces at BER, SMY, and STP are positioned to contest England’s gains. Please avoid VIE and TRI; we need to stop England reaching 18.

A BER and A STP will contest English-held centers; F SMY will also pressure England. A TUN will defend against your F TUN. I have no orders against BRE, PAR, MAR, or SPA. Please use F BRE to challenge England rather than TUN.

A BER, A STP, and F SMY are not moving into other English centers this Fall, but I will contest those holdings rather than leave them undefended. A CON and my other forces defend Austrian centers. I cannot agree to stand aside while you are five centers from victory.

Your units in BER, SMY, and STP are all direct threats to English centers. I will contest those positions this Fall and will not stand aside while you are close to a solo. Keep your forces out of the remaining English centers.
I’m contesting Austrian-held BER, SMY, and STP, while also trying to recover BEL. I’ll keep my fleets clear of POR; please keep A POR out of English centers and do not support Austria.

I’m staying clear of GOL, TUS, and NAP. F EAS will continue to pressure TUN, and I’m contesting Austria’s positions in the north. Please follow through against VIE and TRI, and keep your units out of English centers.

I’m contesting Austria’s holdings in BER, SMY, and STP and working to recover BEL. F BRE will not attack another French center this Fall. Please keep A GAS and F MAO clear of English centers, and continue pressuring Austria at TUN.

F TUN will hold, taking TUN from you; A BEL will defend BEL. I cannot leave English pressure unanswered, and I will keep A GAS clear of Austrian centers. What are your exact orders for A BER, F SMY, and A STP? Keep your units clear of French centers.
Confirmed: A GAS and F MAO will stay clear of POR this Fall. I understand A POR is your only unit and center; please keep it clear of French centers.

A BEL will hold and F TUN will hold to contest Austria. I’ll use F MAO to pressure English-held BRE; A GAS will stay clear of Italian centers. Please keep pressing Austria and tell me your exact orders for A MUN, A BOH, and A PIE.

A BEL will hold, and F TUN will continue contesting Austria. I will not voluntarily hand you BEL while you are five centers from a solo. Attacking it risks breaking the cooperation needed to stop Austria; leave A BEL alone and keep F BRE clear of French centers.

England at 13 remains the immediate danger. MUN and BOH will attack VIE again, and VEN will contest TRI. I have no order against MAR or VEN; keep TYR off MUN and use your northern forces to deny England BER, SMY, and STP.
MUN–VIE supported by BOH, and VEN–TRI, remain my orders. PIE will support MUN against TYR. I’ll keep my units clear of MAR; please keep pressure on England and contest any Austrian gains you can.

I will continue pressuring Austria: MUN–VIE supported by BOH, and VEN–TRI. PIE supports MUN against TYR. My units will stay clear of English centers. Please keep your fleets clear of GOL, TUS, and NAP and use your northern forces to deny Austria’s gains.

notes.note: Hold POR, Germany’s sole center. England, France, and Austria each promised to leave it alone this Fall; all confirmed. Reassess next turn.

Hold BEL and TUN to take/retain centers and deny leaders. Advance GAS to BUR; send MAO to ENG to pressure England. I told England I would hold BEL and contest TUN; England said it would attack BEL. Austria asks me to challenge England.

Attack Austrian TYR with MUN backed by BOH and PIE to dislodge its threat to MUN; TYS–GOL prepares a convoy from PIE toward SPA next turn. Austria asked me to avoid VIE/TRI and promised TYR off MUN; England and France urged continued pressure on Austria.

Hold BER, SMY, STP to claim them; support SMY and STP holds. Stack support on VIE against Italy's MUN+BOH attack. NAF contests TUN against France. England remains the immediate solo threat; Italy and France have refused restraint.

Contest Austria’s imminent gains: attack BER and SMY, and use BAR/BOT support for NOR into STP. Keep BRE to claim it. France refuses to yield BEL; Italy promised pressure on VIE/TRI. Avoid France’s other centers and protect the solo bid.

messages.body: We both remain capable of a solo, so I need to know your Spring targets. Are F BAL, F STP/NORTH, and F EAS moving against my centers? I propose we keep units out of each other’s centers this turn and focus on preventing either side from reaching 18.

I need my forces available to contain England’s 11-center position. Will MUN and BOH stay out of VIE, and will VEN stay out of TRI this Spring? I can keep my units clear of VEN and MAR if you avoid attacking my centers.

England still has 11 centers and remains a serious solo threat. Will F TUN refrain from attacking my holdings this Spring, and can you use your western forces to pressure English centers instead? I will keep my units clear of French centers.

You now have 14 centers and your armies are in BER and MOS, while your fleet threatens English positions from SMY. I will not stand aside as you approach 18. Are any of those units moving against English centers this Spring? Keep your units out of English centers; I will contest your expansion.

Austria remains the immediate threat at 14 centers. Will you keep pressuring TUN and avoid supporting Austrian gains this Spring? I will keep my units clear of French centers for now; please keep yours clear of English centers and tell me your exact target.

Austria holds 14 centers, so please continue contesting VIE or TRI with your armies. Are MUN–VIE with BOH support and VEN–TRI still your Spring orders? I will stay clear of GOL, TUS, and NAP; please keep your units out of English centers.

At 14 centers, you are four from a solo. What are your exact Spring targets? Keep A BEL, A BUR, F MAO, A PAR, and F TUN clear of French centers; I will contest any move against them. I can pressure English holdings, but will not help you reach 18.

Austria is at 14 and the immediate solo threat. What are your exact Spring targets against it? I can use F MAO to pressure BRE, but I will not leave BEL undefended or help you reach 18. Please keep F BRE clear of BEL.

Austria is at 14 and could win with four more. What are your exact Spring targets with A BOH, A TYR, and F GOL? Please keep pressing Austrian centers, especially VIE or TRI, and stay clear of French centers.
You are at 14 and can reach 18 this year. Please confirm your Spring orders leave POR untouched and tell me which centers you are targeting; A POR will hold.
Austria remains four centers from a solo. Which Austrian centers are your units contesting this Spring? Please keep your fleets clear of POR; A POR will hold.
Please confirm A PAR, A BEL, and F MAO will stay clear of POR this Spring. Austria is still close to a solo—are you contesting any Austrian gains? A POR will hold.

You are at 14, so I cannot agree to leave your centers uncontested. What are A TYR, A VEN, and A TRI doing this Spring? Keep TYR off MUN and your units clear of Italian centers; I intend to use my forces to hinder your expansion.

Austria at 14 is the immediate solo danger. What are your exact plans for BER, MOS, and the southern fleets? Please contest Austrian centers this Spring and keep your fleets clear of GOL, NAP, and ROM; Italy will oppose Austrian expansion.

Austria is at 14 and needs only four centers to win. Please contest its holdings wherever you can this Spring, especially from BEL/TUN, and keep your units clear of Italian centers. I’ll use my forces to hinder Austrian expansion; what are your plans?
Confirmed: POR is not a target this Spring. My western forces are focused on defending my position and containing England; I will not move against POR.

I will keep my forces clear of English centers this Spring and have no order against KIE or STP. My priority is protecting my position while we prevent either of us from reaching 18. Are your northern fleets moving against Austrian centers?

A TYR will stay off MUN, and I have no order against VEN or MAR. I need to defend my centers against your forces, though; please keep MUN and BOH out of VIE and VEN out of TRI so we can both focus on containing England.

I will keep my units clear of French centers this Spring, including A BEL, A BUR, A PAR, and F TUN. My forces are focused on defending Austrian holdings and containing England. Will you keep F TUN off my centers and use your western forces to pressure England?
F BAL will contest A BER, and F EAS will pressure SMY. I’ll keep my fleets clear of POR as requested. Please keep A POR out of English centers and do not support Austria.

F BAL will contest BER and F EAS will pressure SMY; I’m also keeping F STP/NORTH focused on the northern front. I’ll stay clear of GOL, NAP, and ROM. Please follow through against VIE and TRI if you can.

F EAS will pressure SMY and F BAL will contest BER; my northern forces will keep watch on the Austrian threat. F BRE will stay clear of BEL, and I’m not targeting French centers. Please keep F MAO clear of BRE and continue opposing Austrian gains.

F BAL will contest BER and F EAS will pressure SMY; F STP/NORTH remains focused on the northern front. I cannot agree to leave your centers uncontested while you are four from a solo. Keep your units out of English centers, and I will contest threats to my holdings.

Confirmed: A PAR, A BEL, and F MAO will stay clear of POR this Spring. A POR should hold and remain clear of French centers. I’m keeping F TUN in place to deny Austria a gain; please use any opportunity to hinder Austrian expansion.

F TUN will hold, denying Austria a gain, and A BEL will hold against any attack. I can’t promise to leave English holdings unchallenged while you remain close to a solo; F MAO is positioned to pressure your western approaches. What are your exact targets against Austria?

A BEL and F TUN will hold, denying Austria gains; A PAR will support BEL if needed. F MAO is available to pressure England’s western approaches, but I won’t help either leader toward a solo. Please press Austria with A BOH, A TYR, and F GOL—what are your exact targets?

F TUN will hold, so I cannot agree to refrain from contesting your holdings. A BEL will hold and my armies will stay clear of Austrian centers. I won’t use my western forces to help you take English centers while you are four from a solo. What are your exact Spring targets?

I’ll continue contesting Austria: A BOH–VIE, with A TYR supporting BOH–VIE; F GOL–TYS. I’ll keep my units clear of English centers. Please use your northern forces to deny Austria’s gains, and confirm whether your southern fleets will stay clear of Italian centers.

A BOH–VIE, A TYR supports BOH–VIE, and F GOL–TYS are my Spring targets. I’ll stay clear of French centers. Please contest Austria from BEL or TUN and tell me whether F MAO or A PAR can pressure Austrian holdings.

I can’t promise a pause while you hold 14 centers. This Spring I’m ordering A BOH–VIE, with A TYR supporting BOH–VIE, and F GOL–TYS. Keep A TYR clear of MUN and your forces clear of Italian centers; I’ll continue opposing your expansion.

notes.note: Attack Austrian VIE with BOH supported by TYR; GOL–TYS. Keep opposing Austria’s solo bid. England promised to contest Austria and stay clear of Italian centers; France promised pressure from BEL/TUN.
Spring: advance POR-Spa for a chance to take French SPA in Fall; France has promised to stay clear of POR, as have England and Austria. Reassess whether SPA is safe to hold in Fall and preserve POR.

Austria remains 4 from solo; contest what I can while seeking gains. Italy said BOH–VIE with TYR support and GOL–TYS, and asked me to stay clear of Italian centers; BUR–MUN breaks that understanding to gain an empty center. England claims BRE will stay clear of BEL.

Contest Austria: BAL attacks BER, EAS attacks SMY. BAR and BOT support STP hold against a possible MOS attack. NTH to NWG sets up a CLY convoy to NOR next turn; other units advance to useful positions. Italy says it will attack VIE; France says TUN holds and BEL holds.

Italy announced BOH–VIE supported by TYR; BUD and TRI support VIE to defend. England says BAL contests BER and EAS pressures SMY; hold both, with SYR supporting SMY. Move VEN to ROM for a Fall capture; advance ARM to SEV, LVN to PRU, MOS to UKR.

messages.body: What are F BAL and F EAS doing this Fall? I need to keep BER and SMY, but I will not move into English centers. Please keep your fleets off Austrian centers so we can both prevent a solo.

Are BOH and TYR still attacking VIE? BUD and TRI can support VIE’s defense, but I’d rather avoid another costly fight. I’ll keep my units clear of VEN and MUN if you keep your armies off VIE and TRI this Fall.

I see A MUN can take MUN this Fall. Are you holding there, and what is F TUN targeting? I’ll keep my units clear of French centers; please keep your forces off Austrian centers while we prevent a solo.

You remain four centers from a solo, and I will contest any move against English centers. What are A ROM, A BER, and F SMY doing this Fall? I intend to deny your gains in the north; keep your units out of English centers.

With A MUN staying put, you should gain MUN this Fall. Please keep F TUN contesting Austria and avoid supporting Austrian gains. I’ll continue contesting Austria’s northern position; what are your exact Fall orders?

Austria is still the immediate solo threat. Can F TYS attack ROM this Fall to prevent A ROM from securing it? Please also continue pressuring Austria with your armies, and keep your units clear of English centers.

With you at 14, I will keep A MUN in place to take MUN from Italy and will not support your gains. Please keep your units clear of French centers, especially MUN, PAR, and PIC. What are your Fall targets?

Austria is four centers from a solo. Please use your forces to contest Austrian centers this Fall, and keep them clear of French centers. I intend to hold A MUN to take MUN from Italy; I will not help Austria gain centers.
A MUN will hold and take MUN from you this Fall. Please keep A TYR clear of MUN and continue contesting Austria with A BOH and your fleet. What are your exact Fall targets?

You are four centers from a solo, and ROM is set to transfer to you this Fall. Which centers are you targeting with A ANK, A BER, A PRU, and your other western-facing units? Germany will hold A SPA to secure SPA; please keep your units clear of POR and SPA and avoid reaching 18.

Austria is still four centers from a solo and will gain ROM if A ROM holds. Which Austrian centers are you contesting this Fall? Please use your forces to deny Austrian gains; Germany will hold A SPA to take the center, and asks that your units stay clear of it.

A SPA will hold this Fall, transferring SPA to Germany. Please keep A MUN, A PAR, A PIC, and F MAO clear of SPA and POR. Austria is close to a solo: are you able to contest any Austrian gains this turn?
Your A MUN takes an Italian center if it stays there this Fall. Please move A MUN out rather than annex Munich; I will avoid French centers. Can F TUN and A PAR continue denying Austria gains?

Your A ROM will take an Italian center if it remains there this Fall. I cannot accept your expansion at 14 centers: please move A ROM out of Rome and keep pressure on England instead. What are your exact orders for ROM and the northern front?

Austria at 14 remains the immediate solo threat. Please use your northern forces to deny Austrian gains and keep your fleets clear of Italian centers. What are F EAS, F BAL, and F STP/NORTH targeting this Fall?

A ROM will hold its position and take ROM; I will not move it out. A BOH still threatens VIE, so BUD and TRI must be ready to defend. I’m not targeting VEN or MAR. If you keep BOH off VIE and your other forces off TRI, we can avoid another costly clash.

A MUN will remain yours if your army stays there; I will keep my units clear of MUN, PAR, and PIC. I’m not targeting French centers this Fall. My forces are occupied defending Austrian holdings and contesting the English front.

A BER and F SMY will defend their positions, not move into English centers. A ROM will stay to take ROM. A ANK and my other eastern forces are focused on Austrian holdings; I am not ordering against KIE or STP. I expect your fleets to stay off Austrian centers.

I have no order against POR or SPA this Fall; I will keep my units clear of both. A ROM will take ROM, while my northern forces defend their positions and contest England. Please keep A SPA clear of Austrian centers.

F BAL will attack BER, and F EAS will attack SMY; F STP/NORTH will hold STP. I am contesting your positions, not agreeing to leave your centers unchallenged while you are four from a solo. Keep your units clear of English centers.
F BAL attacks BER, F EAS attacks SMY, and F STP/NORTH holds STP. I will keep my fleets clear of Italian centers. Please continue opposing Austria with your armies and do not support Austrian gains.
F BAL attacks BER and F EAS attacks SMY; F STP/NORTH holds STP. I’m keeping my forces clear of French centers. Please keep F TUN contesting Austria and do not support its gains.
F BAL attacks BER and F EAS attacks SMY to contest Austria; F STP/NORTH holds STP. I’ll keep my fleets clear of SPA. Please hold A SPA as planned and do not support Austrian gains.

A MUN will hold and take Munich from Italy. F TUN will hold, continuing to contest your position there. My other forces will stay clear of Austrian centers this Fall; please keep yours clear of French centers, especially MUN, PAR, and PIC.
A MUN will hold and take Munich from you; I won’t move it out. F TUN will hold to deny Austria a gain. Please keep A TYR clear of MUN and use A BOH to continue contesting VIE.

A MUN will hold to take Munich from Italy, and F TUN will hold to contest Austria. I won’t support Austrian gains. Please continue contesting Austria’s northern positions and keep your units clear of French centers.

A MUN will hold for Munich, but A PAR, A PIC, and F MAO will stay clear of SPA and POR. F TUN will hold to contest Austria. Please keep A SPA clear of French centers and use it to resist Austrian expansion if you can.

BOH and TYR are still contesting VIE; TYS will attack ROM to prevent your army there taking an Italian center. You said you would keep clear of Italian centers—please move A ROM out and use your northern forces against England instead. I won’t agree to leave your centers uncontested while you hold 14.

I can’t accept your taking MUN while Austria occupies ROM and sits at 14 centers. I’m using BOH and TYR to contest VIE, and TYS will attack ROM to stop Austria gaining an Italian center. Please reconsider holding MUN and use your forces to deny Austria’s expansion.

Yes, F TYS–ROM this Fall to contest Austria’s army there. BOH and TYR will continue pressuring VIE. Please keep your fleets clear of Italian centers and use your northern units to deny Austria gains; it remains four centers from a solo.

notes.note: Hold SPA to secure Germany’s second center as France, England, and Austria promised to stay clear. Austria remains close to solo; no useful move from SPA this Fall.

Fall: retake MUN from France with BOH supported by TYR; contest Austria's ROM with TYS to deny its gain if possible. Austria remains the immediate solo threat; England and France promised pressure, but France chose to hold MUN.

Hold MUN to take it from Italy; MAO to POR for a German center. Germany's SPA occupation likely takes SPA from France. Advance PAR/PIC toward the east; keep TUN to deny Austria. Austria remains the immediate solo threat.

Hold ROM to secure its transfer; TYS attack should bounce. Italy threatens VIE from BOH/TYR, so BUD and TRI support VIE. England attacks BER and SMY: PRU supports BER; SYR supports SMY. France holds MUN; Germany holds SPA.

Continue contesting Austria: BAL attacks BER, EAS attacks SMY. Italy promised TYS–ROM and BOH/TYR pressure on VIE; France says MUN holds and TUN contests Austria; Germany holds SPA. Austria claims no English targets. Advance fleets and armies where possible.

messages.body: Austria is at 15 and neither of us can afford an unchecked solo. I will keep my units out of English centers this Spring. Are F BAL and F EAS still attacking BER and SMY, and what are F STP/NORTH and your other fleets targeting? I propose we avoid taking each other’s centers this turn.

Are BOH and TYR still attacking VIE, and what is your plan for TRI? I need to defend my centers, but I will keep my units clear of VEN and MUN. Please tell me whether you can keep your armies out of VIE and TRI this Spring.

What is F TUN doing this Spring, and where are A BUR and A GAS moving? I will keep my units clear of French centers. With Austria and England both near a solo, I’d like to avoid a clash over TUN and know whether your western forces are pressuring English positions.

You now have 15 centers, so I will continue contesting your positions. Are A BER and F SMY staying put this Spring, and are any of your units moving against English centers? Keep your forces out of English centers; I will use F BAL and F EAS to contest BER and SMY.

Austria is three centers from a solo. Please keep F TUN contesting any Austrian advance and avoid helping Austria gain centers. Can A BUR and A RUH pressure Austrian positions this Spring? I will continue contesting BER and SMY with F BAL and F EAS, and keep my forces clear of French centers.

Austria is at 15 and three centers from winning. Please attack VIE or another Austrian center with A TYR, and tell me your exact target; use any remaining force to deny Austrian gains. I will contest BER and SMY with F BAL and F EAS, and keep my fleets clear of Italian centers.

Austria is one center from a solo. Please make your strongest attacks on Austrian centers this turn, especially BER or northern holdings, and keep your units clear of French centers. I can use A RUH to pressure BER; what are your exact targets?

Austria is at 15 and must be stopped. Please use A TYR and A MUN to contest Austrian centers rather than attack French holdings. I may pressure MUN from A BUR; what are your orders, and can you target an Austrian center?
At 15 centers, you are one gain from ending the game. What are your exact Spring targets? Keep your units clear of French centers, especially A RUH and F TUN; I will not support any Austrian gain.

Austria is at 15 and can win this year. Please coordinate immediate contests of Austrian centers: which of BER, SMY, SEV, or ROM are your units attacking this Spring? Germany will not support Austria; I can move A SPA toward the western front if useful.

Austria needs only three centers for a solo. Please use F TUN and your armies to contest Austrian gains this Spring—what are you targeting? Germany will stay clear of French centers and will not support Austria.

Austria is at 15; a solo ends the game for everyone else. Can A MUN and A TYR attack or obstruct Austrian units this Spring, especially VIE/TRI/ROM? Please tell me your plan; Germany will not support Austria.

Austria is at 15 and can win with three centers. Please use F EAS against SMY and your northern forces to deny its centers this Spring. I’ll keep my units clear of English centers. What are F EAS and F BAL targeting?

Austria is at 15 and three centers from a solo. Please use F TUN and A BEL to deny its expansion, and keep A MUN out of Italian centers. What are your Spring targets? I’ll continue opposing Austria where I can.

At 15 centers, you are three away from a solo, so I cannot agree to leave your centers uncontested. What are A ROM, A SEV, and your northern units targeting this Spring? I intend to resist your expansion.

A ROM will hold, and A SEV and my northern units are focused on defense. I’m not targeting VEN or MUN. Your earlier threats to VIE and TRI remain serious; please tell me whether BOH and TYR are moving against VIE and what is targeting TRI.

I have no orders against French centers this Spring; my forces are focused on defending Austrian holdings. F TUN remains a concern, so please clarify its orders. I can’t promise to leave my position uncontested, but I’d prefer to avoid a clash over TUN.

A BER and F SMY will stay in position this Spring; I’m not ordering against English centers. I’m focused on defending my holdings and preventing either side from gaining unchecked. Your fleets contesting BER and SMY make a clash likely; will you keep them off Austrian centers?

F BAL will attack BER and F EAS will attack SMY, as stated. F STP/NORTH remains focused on the northern front. I will not stand aside while you are three centers from a solo; keep your forces out of English centers.
F BAL attacks BER and F EAS attacks SMY. Please have A TYR attack VIE as proposed and use your other units to contest Austrian centers. I’ll keep my fleets clear of Italian centers.
F BAL attacks BER and F EAS attacks SMY this Spring. F STP/NORTH stays on the northern front. Please keep A SPA from supporting Austria; if useful, coordinate with France to pressure BER from RUH.

F BAL attacks BER and F EAS attacks SMY. F STP/NORTH stays focused on the northern front. A RUH–BER, supported by A BUR, would add pressure; please keep F TUN contesting Austria and avoid aiding its gains.

F TUN will hold, and my western forces will not support any Austrian gain. A BUR will support A RUH–BER; A GAS will hold. I am coordinating pressure on BER with England. Keep your forces clear of French centers, especially TUN and RUH.

F TUN will hold and A BEL will stay clear of Italian centers. A BUR will support A RUH–BER; A GAS will hold. Please use A TYR and A MUN to attack or contest Austrian centers, and tell me your exact targets. I will not move A BUR into MUN this Spring.
F TUN will hold and A BUR will support A RUH–BER to contest Austria. A GAS will hold; I am not targeting SPA or POR. Please keep A SPA clear of French centers and use it to hinder Austria if you can.

F TUN will hold, and A BUR will support A RUH–BER. That should reinforce your attack from F BAL; please proceed against BER and continue contesting Austria’s northern holdings. A GAS will hold, and my forces will stay clear of English centers this Spring.

I will not leave your centers uncontested: A TYR–TRI this Spring. A MUN will hold against France’s pressure. I have no agreement to keep my forces out of VIE or TRI; move A TRI or support its defense if you can.
A TYR–TRI is my Spring target; A MUN will hold against France’s A BUR. I’m not supporting Austria. Please keep A SPA clear of Italian centers and continue denying Austria’s gains wherever you can.
A TYR–TRI is my target against Austria this Spring; A MUN will hold, so please do not attack it from BUR. I won’t target French centers. Use BEL and TUN to deny Austria’s expansion if possible.
A TYR–TRI is my exact target this Spring; A MUN will hold against France’s pressure. Please follow through with F BAL against BER and F EAS against SMY, and keep your fleets clear of Italian centers.

notes.note: Move SPA–MAR to take a center from France in Fall; France promised not to target SPA/POR. France and England contest BER/SMY; Italy targets TRI. Austria at 15 remains the immediate solo threat, but SPA cannot aid those contests directly.

Support England's announced attack on BER while TYR attacks VEN to deny Austria another center. England and France said they would contest Austria; France says BUR supports RUH–BER. Austria remains three centers from a solo.

England threatens BER and SMY; defend both with PRU and ARM/SYR support. Italy's TYR threatens TRI; BUD supports TRI. ROM attacks NAP for a Fall gain. VIE advances to BOH; avoid French/English centers.

Austria is the immediate solo threat. England promised attacks on BER and SMY; Italy says TYR–TRI. My promised BUR support for RUH–BER is impossible with the listed options. Keep TUN contesting Austria; advance toward KIE and set up a POR–MAO convoy.

Contest Austria at BER and SMY; Italy promised TYR–TRI, France promises BUR support RUH–BER and TUN holds. Keep clear of French centers. BAR to NWG supports a future CLY convoy; advance elsewhere. Austria says no English targets.

messages.body: Your F BAL and F EAS can still contest BER and SMY, but Austria is already at 15 and I need to prevent a solo. I propose you keep those fleets off Austrian centers this Fall; I will keep my units out of English centers. What are your orders?

Please clarify whether A KIE is staying in KIE and what F TUN is doing. I’m not targeting French centers, and I need to avoid gaining a center that ends the game. Can you keep your units off Austrian centers this Fall?

I understand A TYR threatened TRI. What are A MUN and A VEN doing this Fall? I need to avoid any gain that triggers a solo, but must defend Austrian centers. Please keep your armies out of TRI and VIE if possible.

Please have A KIE support F BAL–BER this Fall. Austria is still close to a solo; that is the strongest coordinated northern contest. What are A BUR and your fleets doing? I will keep my units clear of French centers.
Austria’s Fall position is critical. Can A VEN–TRI with A MUN supporting the move, and what will you do with your other units? I’ll continue contesting BER and stay clear of Italian centers.
I will continue contesting BER this Fall. Are A BER and A PRU holding or supporting a defense, and are any of your units targeting English centers? Austria must not gain another center toward 18.

Please keep F BAL contesting BER this Fall; Austria needs only three centers to win. I will hold A KIE to take the center from you and use my southern forces against Austria/Germany, not support Austrian gains. What are your exact targets?

Austria is still the immediate solo threat. Please use A VEN to contest TRI and A MUN to pressure an Austrian center if possible; don’t waste the turn defending centers Austria already holds. What are your Fall targets?

A MAR is poised to take Marseille this Fall, so I will contest it from adjacent French units. Please do not support Austria’s expansion; can A MAR instead move to help contest BER or another Austrian center?

Austria is still the immediate solo threat. Please keep F BAL attacking BER and F EAS contesting SMY this Fall; coordinate with France’s A BUR–supported attack on BER if possible. I’m holding A MAR to secure Germany’s center.

Please keep A BUR supporting A RUH–BER as promised, and leave A MAR untouched. If A BUR can instead support A MAR to hold against an Austrian attack, that would protect Germany’s only center; let me know your plan.

Austria’s A TRI can move to VEN, transferring VEN to Austria and putting it one step closer to a solo. Please vacate VEN or attack/support an attack on TRI this Fall; can A MUN support A VEN–TRI while defending MUN?

Austria’s A NAP can take another center this Fall, so please keep contesting its gains. Is F BAL attacking BER again, and what are F EAS and your other fleets targeting? A VEN will remain in VEN to take it back from Austria.
Austria remains three centers from a solo. Please use A BUR and A KIE to deny Austrian gains if possible, and keep your units clear of MUN. What are your exact Fall orders for BUR, KIE, and TUN?
What are your exact Fall targets, especially A NAP and the northern front? I will hold A VEN to reclaim VEN; please do not attack MUN or NAP with Italian units in mind.

A NAP will hold to secure the center. I have no order against MUN or VEN; please keep A VEN off TRI and avoid any attack on VIE. We both need to prevent England from gaining unchecked, but I will defend Austrian holdings.

A BER will hold with A PRU supporting its defense. I am not ordering against English centers this Fall. Your attack on BER threatens my position; I ask you to keep F BAL off Austrian centers while we prevent either side from gaining unchecked.

F BAL will attack BER again; I will not stand aside while you are three centers from a solo. I’m also contesting KIE with F HEL, supported by F DEN. Keep your forces out of English centers, and tell me whether A BER and A PRU are defending BER.

Yes—A VEN–TRI with A MUN supporting is a strong way to contest Austria. Keep A MUN in place to hold Munich, and use your other units against Austrian centers rather than supporting Austrian gains. I’ll continue contesting BER and KIE, and keep my fleets clear of Italian centers.

F BAL will attack BER again. Please coordinate with France: A KIE should support F BAL–BER rather than take KIE from England. I’m using F HEL with F DEN supporting to contest KIE. Keep A MAR securing your center and do not support Austria.

I’ll attack BER with F BAL, but please have A KIE support F BAL–BER instead of taking KIE from me; that gives us the best chance to deny Austria’s northern position. I’m contesting KIE with F HEL supported by F DEN. Keep your other forces against Austria and Germany, not English centers.
A KIE will support F BAL–BER, and F TUN will hold to contest any Austrian advance. I will keep my other units clear of Austrian centers; A GAS will move to reclaim MAR.
A KIE will support F BAL–BER against Austria, F TUN will hold, and A GAS will move to MAR with A BUR supporting. I’m not targeting MUN or any Italian center.
I can’t leave A MAR untouched: A GAS will attack MAR, supported by A BUR, to reclaim the French center. A KIE supports F BAL–BER against Austria, and F TUN holds.
A KIE will support F BAL–BER this Fall as requested. A BUR will support A GAS–MAR, and F TUN will hold to contest Austria. I’m keeping the rest of my forces clear of English centers.

A MAR will hold; moving it to BER would expose MAR and not affect Austria’s position. I can’t support Austria, and I’ll keep my unit out of your other centers. Please keep A BUR supporting the contest of BER as promised, and avoid attacking MAR so Germany retains its center.
A VEN will hold VEN, and A MUN will hold MUN. I cannot promise to leave TRI uncontested, but I am not moving into VIE this Fall. Your A TRI should not expect an unopposed move into VEN.
I can’t support A VEN–TRI: vacating VEN would let your A TRI take it, reversing the center transfer and helping your position. I’ll keep A VEN in VEN and A MUN in MUN, denying that Austrian gain.
