A VEN will hold to prevent A TRI taking VEN, and A MUN will hold rather than expose MUN. I cannot pressure an Austrian center directly from these positions this Fall; please keep A BUR clear of MUN.

I can’t order A VEN–TRI with MUN support: vacating VEN would let Austria’s A TRI take it. I’ll hold A VEN in VEN and A MUN in MUN to deny Austria’s gain. Please continue contesting BER and use your other forces to prevent Austria gaining centers.

notes.note: Hold MAR to claim it if possible, though France says GAS attacks with BUR support; likely dislodged. France's earlier promises to leave MAR were broken. England contests BER/KIE; Austria remains at 15 and imminent solo threat.

Support England's BAL–BER to help remove Austria from BER and keep Austria from gaining another center. Hold VEN to take it for Italy. France promised to avoid MUN; England promised to contest Austrian centers.
Support GAS–MAR to retake MAR; MAO advances to SPA for a gain. KIE stays to claim the center and supports England's BER attack as promised. TUN holds to contest Austria.

Austria is at 15 and must be denied further centers. Attack BER and SMY; take KIE with HEL supported by DEN. France promised KIE supports BAL–BER, but that conflicts with HEL attacking KIE, so expect the support to be cut. Italy says VEN and MUN hold; Austria says no English targets.

Hold BER against England with PRU support. Protect SMY against EAS with ARM and SYR support. Keep NAP to gain it; attack VEN from TRI to contest Italy's occupation, though its hold may bounce. Advance BOH to TYR, BUD to SER, RUM to BUL, UKR to MOS; NAF attacks TUN.

messages.body: Your pressure on BER and SMY is clear. Austria cannot afford to lose either while also checking your 11-center position. Will F BAL and F EAS stay off Austrian centers this Spring if I keep my forces out of English centers? What are F STP/NOR and F DEN targeting?

I need to keep England from gaining unchecked, but your coordination against BER threatens my position. Will A BUR and F TUN stay out of Austrian centers this Spring, and what are your units targeting? I have no orders against French centers.

I will defend TRI and VIE, but I am not seeking VEN or MUN this Spring. Will A VEN and A MUN stay out of Austrian centers, especially TRI? Please clarify your targets so we can avoid a costly clash while England remains a threat.

You are still three centers from a solo, so I will keep contesting BER and your other exposed northern positions. Are A BER and A PRU defending BER this Spring, and are any of your units moving against English centers? Keep your forces out of English centers.

Austria remains three centers from a solo. Please use A RUH and A BUR to pressure BER again, and keep F TUN contesting Austrian expansion. I’ll continue challenging BER from the Baltic; what are your exact Spring orders?

Austria remains three centers from a solo. Please keep contesting its centers with A MUN and A VEN, and tell me your exact Spring targets. I’ll keep my fleets clear of Italian centers and continue pressure in the north.

Austria has 15 centers; we must deny its next gain. Will F BAL attack BER and F EAS attack SMY this Spring? I can use A RUH against BER and keep F TUN contesting Austria. Please keep your forces clear of French centers.

Austria is still three centers from victory. Can A VEN attack TRI and A MUN move against an Austrian position this Spring? I will keep my forces clear of MUN and continue contesting Austria from TUN; please keep yours clear of French centers.

You remain three centers from a solo, so I will contest your expansion. My forces will stay clear of your centers this Spring except where needed to stop a gain. What are your exact targets? Keep your units clear of French centers, especially TUN, MAR, and RUH.

You remain three centers from a solo, so I cannot offer a truce. What are your exact Spring orders for TYR, TRI, and ROM? I will use MUN and VEN to contest your expansion, and you should not count on either Italian center being left undefended.

Austria can still win with three centers. Please tell me your exact Spring targets, especially BER and the southern fleets. I’ll contest Austrian centers from MUN and VEN where possible; can you coordinate your attacks to deny Austria a gain this turn?

Austria remains three centers from a solo. Please keep BUR clear of MUN and use your units to deny Austria a center this Spring. What are your exact targets? I’ll contest Austria from MUN and VEN where I can, but cannot afford France taking MUN while Austria remains the immediate threat.
A BER and A PRU will defend BER this Spring; I have no order into an English center. I cannot leave BER exposed while F BAL contests it. Please keep F EAS off SMY; what are F STP and F NOR targeting?

A TRI will defend TRI, A TYR will defend the Austrian frontier, and A ROM will hold. I am not ordering against VEN or MUN this Spring. Please keep A VEN and A MUN out of TRI and VIE; where are they moving?

My forces are focused on defending Austrian centers this Spring; I have no order against a French center. I cannot promise to leave exposed positions uncontested while you coordinate pressure on BER. What are A BUR and F TUN doing?

F BAL will attack BER, with F DEN supporting BAL–BER; F EAS will attack SMY. I’ll keep my fleets clear of Italian centers. Please use A MUN and A VEN to contest Austria, and tell me your exact targets.

F BAL will attack BER, supported by F DEN; F EAS will attack SMY. F NOR and F BAR are focused on the northern front, not English centers. I cannot leave your centers uncontested while you are three from a solo.
Yes: F BAL attacks BER, supported by F DEN, while F EAS attacks SMY. Please use A RUH–BER with A BUR supporting, and keep F TUN contesting Austria. I’ll keep my forces clear of French centers.
I’ll order A RUH–BER, with A BUR supporting, and F TUN will hold. Please attack BER with F BAL again and continue contesting SMY with F EAS. My other forces will stay clear of English centers.

A RUH will move to BER with A BUR supporting; F TUN will hold to deny Austrian expansion. I’ll keep A BUR clear of MUN. Please have A VEN attack TRI and use A MUN to contest an Austrian position if possible.
A RUH and A BUR are targeting BER, and F TUN will hold. My other units will stay clear of Austrian centers this Spring. Please keep your forces clear of French centers, especially MAR and TUN.

A VEN will hold to prevent A TRI taking VEN; A MUN will hold to protect Munich. I can’t safely vacate either Italian center. Please follow through with your northern pressure on BER and tell me your exact Spring targets, especially for F EAS and F BAL.

A VEN and A MUN will hold this Spring; I will not leave either Italian center open. I cannot offer a truce while you are three centers from victory. Please keep A TRI and A TYR from attacking Italian centers, as you say you intend to do.

A VEN and A MUN will hold this Spring. I cannot safely move either army against an Austrian position while that would expose an Italian center. Please keep A BUR clear of MUN and use F TUN and your other forces to deny Austria a gain.

notes.note: MUN supports England’s BAL–BER to help deny Austria. VEN attacks TRI to contest Austria; Austria claims TYR/TRI defensive and no attack on Italian centers. England promised pressure north and to avoid Italian centers.

Spring 1937: follow through on BAL–BER with DEN support and EAS–SMY; France promised BUR-supported RUH–BER and TUN hold. Italy holds MUN/VEN but claims to contest Austria. Austria promises no English targets; do not trust it. CLY convoy to LVP; advance other units.

Austria remains the immediate solo threat; England promised BAL–BER and EAS–SMY, and Italy will hold MUN/VEN. TUN holds as promised. Advance toward English centers with PAR/RUH while MAR pressures PIE; move BUR to GAS and SPA to GOL.

England and France are coordinating attacks on BER; PRU supports its hold. ARM and SYR support SMY against EAS. TYR attacks MUN with BER support; SER advances on GRE. Italy says MUN/VEN hold, France targets TUN, England attacks BER/SMY.

messages.body: A GRE is already in GRE, and I expect to retain it this Fall. Are F BAL and F EAS again attacking BER and SMY? I’m not ordering into English centers; please keep your fleets off BER and SMY so we can avoid another costly bounce.

A BRE is in BRE, so your army can take that English center this Fall. I won’t move against French centers. Please keep F TUN and your other units out of Austrian centers; what are A RUH and A GAS targeting?

A TYR can reach MUN, but I’d rather avoid another fight. Are A MUN and A VEN holding this Fall, and can you keep them out of TRI and VIE? My forces are defending Austrian positions, not targeting VEN.

A GRE is sitting on an English center, which transfers to you if it remains there this Fall. I cannot let you gain another center toward 18. Will you move A GRE out, and confirm you are not targeting any other English centers? I will continue contesting your northern positions.

Your A BRE will take BRE from me if it stays this Fall. Austria is at 15 and must be stopped; please move A BRE out of BRE rather than take an English center. Can you use A RUH and A BUR against BER again, and keep F TUN contesting Austria?

Austria can win with three more centers, and A GRE will take an English center this Fall unless displaced. Can you make a concrete attack on an Austrian center with A MUN or A VEN, and avoid taking or supporting any English centers? I will keep pressure on Austria in the north.

Austria can gain GRE this Fall and is only three centers from victory. Please make your strongest attack on A GRE with F EAS, and tell me your exact orders for BAL, DEN, and the northern fleets. A BRE will hold to take BRE for France; I can use A RUH to pressure an English center if needed to prevent Austria's solo.

A BRE will hold to take BRE this Fall, and I will not support any Austrian gain. You are still three centers from victory; what are your exact Fall targets? Keep your units clear of French centers, especially MAR, TUN, and RUH.

Austria can take GRE this Fall and is three centers from a solo. Can A VEN attack TRI or A MUN contest an Austrian center this turn? Please give me your exact orders. I will keep my units clear of MUN and Italian centers.

Austria has 15 and A GRE can transfer another center this Fall. Can F EAS attack GRE, and can any unit support or otherwise dislodge it? Please also ensure your units contest Austrian gains elsewhere; tell me your exact southern orders.

Austria is still three centers from a solo. A GRE is poised to take an English center, so please use your units to deny Austrian gains and avoid leaving another center exposed. What are A BRE, A GAS, and F TUN doing this Fall?
You are still three centers from a solo, and I will oppose any further gains. What are your exact Fall targets, especially for A GRE, A TYR, and A TRI? I will defend MUN and VEN.

I have no orders against French centers. A BRE can take BRE this Fall, and I’m focused on holding my positions and checking England’s pressure. What are A RUH and A GAS targeting? Please keep F TUN out of Austrian centers.

I will not move A GRE out; I intend to retain the position. I’m not confirming that my other units will stay out of English centers. Your pressure on BER threatens both our positions—please keep F BAL and F DEN off BER, and tell me your other targets.

A GRE will hold its position; A TYR and A TRI are not targeting Italian centers this Fall. I’m defending the Austrian frontier and responding to pressure from England. Are A MUN and A VEN holding, and can you keep them out of TRI and VIE?

A GRE is on an English center and must be dislodged or leave; I will attack it with F EAS. Your 15 centers make any further gains unacceptable. Confirm you are not moving against any other English center, and move A GRE out rather than taking GRE for Austria.

Please have F TUN support F EAS–GRE to dislodge A GRE, and use A RUH–BER with A BUR supporting. Do not take BRE with A BRE; it is English, and Austria must not gain another center. I will use F BAL and F DEN against BER and keep pressure on Austria.

F EAS will attack A GRE; please have F TUN support that move if France agrees. With A MUN and A VEN unable to leave safely, hold both to deny Austrian gains. Avoid any move that supports Austria, and keep pressure on its centers where possible.

A BRE will hold to take BRE for France. A RUH and A BUR will pressure BER again, and F TUN will hold; A GAS will stay clear of Austrian centers. Your A GRE is the immediate danger—please do not take GRE and end the game.

I’m holding A BRE to take BRE; France cannot afford to give up a center. I’ll use A RUH–BER with A BUR supporting and keep F TUN contesting Austria. F EAS must attack A GRE; that is the urgent way to deny Austria its next center. What are your orders for BAL and DEN?

A BRE will hold, A RUH and A BUR will pressure BER, and F TUN will hold. A GAS will stay clear of Italian centers. Austria’s A GRE is the immediate solo threat; please contest Austria wherever your units can, especially from VEN or MUN.

A MUN and A VEN will hold this Fall; I cannot vacate either Italian center while your A TYR and A TRI are nearby. Your A GRE taking another center brings you closer to a solo, so I will continue opposing your expansion. Please confirm your exact orders for GRE, TYR, and TRI.

A MUN and A VEN will hold this Fall; moving either would expose an Italian center, so I cannot attack TRI from here. Please use F TUN and your other units to prevent Austria gaining GRE or BER, and keep A BUR clear of MUN as promised. What are your exact orders?

A MUN and A VEN will hold; moving either risks an Italian center, so I cannot make a safe direct attack on Austria this Fall. Can F EAS attack GRE or support a dislodgement, and what are your exact northern orders to deny Austria BER? I will not take or support an English center.

notes.note: Support England’s BAL–BER to help deny Austria expansion; hold VEN. Austria remains 3 centers from a solo before GRE changes hands. England and France promised pressure; Austria says TYR/TRI are not targeting Italian centers.

Keep BRE to gain it; RUH takes open HOL, GAS advances to BUR. Move GOL to WES and PIE to TUS, TUN to ION. England asked me to vacate BRE, but I prioritized gaining the center; Austria remains the urgent solo threat.

Hold GRE to secure it and reach 16. Protect BER with PRU; SMY with ARM/CON/SYR. TYR attacks MUN with BER support; TRI attacks VEN with APU support. England and France contest BER; England threatens SMY. Italy says MUN/VEN hold.

Austria refused to leave GRE and may take it; there is no direct English move into GRE. Contest BER and SMY, advance into BEL and open northern moves. France intends to hold BRE and attack BER; Italy holds MUN/VEN.

messages.body: With all centers occupied, I need to know your Spring 1938 orders: are F BAL and F BEL again contesting BER, and what are F EAS and F KIE targeting? I’m assessing the front and will defend my positions.

What are A HOL, A BUR, and F MAR doing this Spring? Your forces can pressure my western centers, while I have units near yours; I need to know whether you’re coordinating another attack on BER or moving elsewhere.
Are A MUN and A ROM holding this Spring, and where is A VEN headed? A TYR is near MUN, so I need to know your plans on that frontier.

You are at 16 and two centers from a solo. Which centers are you targeting this Spring, especially from A BER, A PRU, and A GRE? I will oppose any move that brings you closer to 18; do not expect me to stand aside or yield English positions.

Austria is at 16, so we must deny its next gains. Please use A BUR and A HOL to pressure BER, and keep F ION positioned against Austrian expansion. I’ll attack BER from the Baltic; what are your exact orders? Let’s avoid taking each other’s centers while stopping Austria.

Austria is at 16 and needs only two centers to win. Can A MUN move to TYR to pressure Austria this Spring, while A ROM contests its southern approaches? Please tell me your exact orders; I’ll keep up pressure in the north.

You now have 16 centers, and any two gains end the game. What are your exact Spring targets? I will oppose any move into French centers; please keep your units clear of MAR, TUN, and our other holdings.

Austria is at 16; we need to prevent two gains this year. What are your Spring orders, especially F EAS and F BAL? I can coordinate pressure on Austrian positions, but need your exact targets so we don't waste force or expose centers.

Austria is two centers from victory. Can you use A MUN and A ROM to contest Austrian positions this Spring? Please tell me your exact targets; I’ll focus on denying Austria a gain and keeping my units clear of your centers.

Austria is at 16 and can win with two centers. Please attack A GRE with F EAS this Spring and keep pressure on Austrian centers in the north; do not leave English centers open to Austrian attacks. What are your exact targets?

Austria is at 16, so we must deny it any center gains. Can F ION support England’s F EAS–GRE this Spring? Please also pressure Austria from your northern units, and avoid leaving your centers exposed. What are your exact orders?
You are two centers from a solo, so I will oppose further expansion. My priority is defending Italy’s remaining centers. What are your exact Spring targets, especially for TYR and VEN?

I’m not giving exact targets while England and your forces threaten BER. My priority is retaining my current centers; I have no planned move into French centers this Spring. Keep A HOL and A BUR off BER, and tell me whether F MAR is moving to WES or holding.

I will defend my exposed centers and won’t disclose exact orders. Your F BAL/F BEL pressure on BER and F EAS near SMY makes restraint impossible. I have no promise to stay out of English centers; keep F BAL and F BEL off BER if you want to avoid a clash.

A TYR is defending the frontier, not moving to MUN this Spring; my other forces are focused on holding Austrian centers. I have no planned attack on VEN or MUN. Please keep A VEN and A MUN out of TRI and VIE, and clarify whether A ROM is holding.

F BAL will again contest BER, and F EAS will attack GRE. F KIE will support BAL–BER. I will not stand aside while you are two centers from a solo; keep your forces out of English centers. What are A BER, A PRU, and A GRE doing?

I plan F BAL–BER, with F KIE supporting, and F EAS–GRE. Please use A BUR and A HOL to pressure BER and F ION to support EAS–GRE if legal from its position. Keep your forces clear of English centers; tell me your exact orders so we can avoid wasting support.

F EAS will attack GRE; F BAL will contest BER with F KIE supporting. Please hold A MUN and A ROM if moving risks your centers, and avoid any support for Austria. If either army can safely pressure an Austrian position without exposing ROM or MUN, tell me your exact plan.

A HOL and A BUR will pressure BER, while F ION is positioned to help stop any gain in Greece. I’m not moving against French centers you hold; with you at 16, I have to contest likely gains. What are your exact targets this Spring?
A HOL and A BUR will pressure BER, and F ION will support F EAS–GRE to help dislodge A GRE. Please attack BER from F BAL as proposed. I’ll keep my other units clear of English centers this Spring.
Yes: F ION can support F EAS–GRE, and I will order that support. A HOL and A BUR will pressure BER; my other forces will focus on denying Austria a gain. I’ll keep clear of Italian centers.

A MUN and A ROM will hold this Spring; I cannot safely vacate either while your A TYR and A APU threaten them. I will not move A VEN, as I have no unit there. What are your orders for TYR and APU? Your gaining another center risks ending the game immediately.

A MUN and A ROM need to hold: A TYR threatens Munich and A APU threatens Rome, so moving either would expose an Italian center. Please have F ION support England’s F EAS–GRE as requested, and use your northern forces to deny Austria a gain. I’ll keep my units out of French centers.

A MUN and A ROM must hold: moving A MUN to TYR leaves Munich exposed to Austria’s A TYR, and moving A ROM likewise risks Rome. I cannot contest directly this Spring. Please attack GRE with F EAS, and coordinate F ION support from France; keep pressure on Austrian centers in the north.

notes.note: Support England’s BAL–BER to help deny Austria a center; keep ROM defended against APU. Austria is 16 centers—coordinate with England and France to stop any gains.

Austria at 16: contest BER with BAL supported by KIE, and attack SMY. France promised HOL/BUR pressure on BER and ION support for EAS–SMY; Italy cannot safely attack. Advance fleets toward NWG/ENG/HEL and army into WAL/LVP.

At 16, push for solo before opponents can stop it. APU attacks ROM with VEN support; TYR attacks MUN, but BER must support its own hold against England/France. NAF probes TUN. England targets BER/GRE; France pressures BER; Italy says MUN/ROM hold.

Austria is at 16; prioritize denying its gains. ION moves to TUN with WES support against an attack from NAF. England said it would attack BER from BAL with KIE support and EAS-GRE; I promised ION support for EAS-GRE, but ION instead protects TUN. Italy asked me to keep clear of its centers. Advance BUR to RUH and TUS to PIE.

messages.body: F SMY staying there transfers SMY away from me and prevents my win; I need you to move it out this Fall. I can keep my forces out of English centers this turn, but if you take SMY I will target your exposed holdings next.
A NAP in NAP transfers that center back to you, while A ROM gives me ROM. Move A NAP to APU this Fall so I retain NAP; otherwise I will use my nearby forces against your remaining centers.

Austria’s 16 centers make any further gain decisive, but England and Italy are poised to take SMY and NAP from me. Please keep your units out of Austrian centers this Fall; are A HOL and A RUH still targeting BER?

Austria is one center from victory after the likely ROM and SMY transfers. Can you use A PIE or another unit to attack/support an attack on ROM, and keep pressure on Austrian centers? I’ll prioritize holding SMY and deny Austria’s English gains. What are your exact orders?

Austria can win this Fall. A NAP can attack A ROM; please do so rather than let ROM transfer, and support the attack if possible. Keep A MUN in place to deny Austrian gains there. What are your exact orders?

You are one center from a solo, and I will fight to prevent it. F SMY will not willingly yield your claim there. Are you ordering A SYR–SMY or taking any other English center this Fall? I will oppose any move that puts you at 18.

Austria must not reach 18. Please keep F SMY in SMY to secure that center and deny Austria its gain; can F BAL attack BER, with F KIE or F HEL supporting if legal? Tell me your exact orders so I can coordinate pressure from RUH/HOL.

Austria is still two centers from victory. Keep A NAP in NAP to reclaim it, and contest A ROM if you can; Austria’s A ROM is poised to take your center. What are your exact orders for NAP and MUN? I will focus my forces on preventing Austrian gains.

You are still two centers from a solo, so I will oppose any further gains. I am not targeting French centers you hold this Fall; please keep your forces clear of French holdings, especially HOL, MAR, and TUN. What are your exact targets?

You need two centers for the solo, and this Fall is decisive. What are your exact orders for A NAP, A ROM, and A SMY? I intend to take NAP with A NAP and reclaim ROM with A ROM; please do not move onto either Italian center.

Austria must be denied any center gain this Fall. What are your exact orders for F SMY and the northern fleets? Please ensure F SMY does not take SMY from Austria, and attack or dislodge Austrian units where possible. I will retake ROM with A ROM and take NAP with A NAP.

Austria is at 16 and needs two centers this Fall. Please use your units to contest Austrian centers, especially BER or SMY, and tell me your exact targets. I intend to retake ROM with A ROM and take NAP with A NAP; please keep your forces clear of Italian centers.

A NAP cannot remain in NAP if you want to preserve your center; moving to APU is your best chance to keep it. A ROM will not leave ROM, and A SYR is positioned to contest SMY. I won’t give you exact orders while you are taking NAP and ROM is at stake.

I will contest F SMY; I’m not confirming A SYR’s exact order. Your fleet there is taking an Austrian center, and I can’t accept that while also losing NAP. If you want to avoid further escalation, move F SMY out and tell me where you are moving F BAL.

I’m focused on the immediate losses at NAP and SMY and on holding ROM. I have no need to target HOL, MAR, or TUN this turn, but I won’t disclose exact orders while others are contesting my centers. Are A HOL and A RUH attacking BER again?
I’ll keep F SMY in SMY to deny Austria that center. F BAL will attack BER; F KIE supports BAL–BER if legal. Please make A NAP attack ROM as you proposed, and keep A MUN from supporting Austria.
I will not move F SMY out: if it remains, SMY stays English and you do not reach 18. F BAL will contest BER. Your threat to target my exposed holdings only confirms I must deny you the solo.
F SMY will hold to deny Austria its 18th center. F BAL attacks BER, with F KIE supporting BAL–BER. Please use your units from RUH/HOL to pressure BER as agreed, and avoid English centers.

Keep A NAP in NAP to reclaim it, and use A MUN to contest TYR if possible; do not let Austria’s A ROM take ROM. My A PIE will attack TYR, while A GAS supports A PIE–TYR. I’ll keep my units clear of Italian centers otherwise.

F SMY must hold to prevent Austria’s decisive gain. Please tell me your exact orders for BAL and KIE; if you can attack BER, do so. I’ll use A HOL and A RUH to pressure BER, and keep my forces off English centers.

I will not move into Austrian centers this Fall. My forces are focused on opposing further gains; please keep yours clear of French centers, especially HOL, MAR, and TUN. I cannot promise to leave you unchallenged while you are at 16.

I will not move A NAP to APU; that would leave Austria’s 16 centers intact and its capture of ROM unopposed. I’ll attack A ROM from NAP, though without support it may bounce. Your F SMY must leave SMY or Austria gains it back—please confirm it will hold there through the Fall.

I will not move A NAP to APU: that would hand you NAP while you take ROM. I’m contesting your A ROM from NAP. Do not count on Italian cooperation; your threat against my remaining centers only strengthens the case for denying you a solo.

A NAP will attack your A ROM as England urged; without support it may fail, but I will not vacate NAP for APU and hand Austria the center. Please keep your units focused on preventing Austrian gains, and make sure no move of yours opens a center Austria can take this Fall.

notes.note: Keep NAP so Austria cannot regain it; support England’s BAL–BER to deny another Austrian center. Austria threatened ROM but moving off NAP risks handing it back and enabling a solo. England promised SMY held; France promised pressure on BER/SMY.

Deny Austria 18 by keeping SMY; contest BER with BAL supported by KIE. Italy says NAP attacks ROM, keeping MUN still; France promised pressure on BER and to avoid English centers. Austria demanded I vacate SMY and threatened retaliation; refused.
England promised F SMY holds to deny Austria its 18th; Italy says A NAP attacks ROM and keeps NAP. Support RUH–BEL with HOL while taking opportunities; pressure TYR and advance fleets.

At 16, attack SMY with SYR supported by AEG and ANK for solo; hold ROM to retain it and bounce Italy’s likely NAP–ROM. Italy refused to yield NAP; England refuses to vacate SMY. France says it will stay out of Austrian centers.

messages.body: This Fall decides whether the game ends. I need you to move F BER out rather than defend it; I can keep my forces out of your other centers this turn. Are F BER and F SMY staying in place, and what is F KIE doing?

Austria is one center from winning, so I expect you to contest any gain. Are A HOL and A BUR still targeting BER, and will you keep your forces out of Austrian centers this Fall? I’m assessing the western front before orders.
I know you intend to contest ROM and keep NAP. Are A NAP and A ROM attacking this Fall, and can you keep them out of Austrian centers? I may be able to avoid further escalation if you do.

You are one center from victory. I will contest any move into an English center, especially BER from A PRU. Which center are you targeting this turn? If you stay out of English centers, I can consider a temporary pause in pressure; I will not stand aside for a solo.

Austria is at 17 and may target BER from A PRU. Please use A HOL/A BEL to pressure or disrupt Austrian moves where possible, and keep your forces out of English centers. What are your orders against Austria this turn? I’ll prioritize defending English centers.

Austria is at 17 and must be stopped. Can A MUN or A NAP make any move that disrupts an Austrian center or unit without exposing your centers? Please avoid supporting Austria and tell me your plan; I’ll defend against Austrian moves on English centers.

Austria has 17; every Austrian gain ends the game. Please confirm your exact Spring orders, especially F SWE, F NOR, F NTH, F KIE, and whether F PIC is attacking BER. I’ll focus on denying Austria and won’t target English centers this turn if you contest its vulnerable centers.

Austria is one center from a solo. What are A MUN and A NAP doing this Spring? Please contest Austrian units wherever possible and avoid supporting any Austrian gain. I’ll keep my forces clear of Italian centers.

You are one center from victory. I will oppose any Austrian gain this Spring. Please state your likely targets; I’ll keep French forces clear of your centers where possible, but cannot leave an exposed position uncontested.

You are one center from victory, so I will not cooperate in any transfer. State your exact orders for A ROM, A SMY, and A TYR. I will keep contesting your gains; do not count on Italy to vacate NAP or MUN.

Austria must be denied its eighteenth center this turn. What are your exact orders for F NOR, F SWE, F KIE, and F PIC? Please contest Austrian-held centers and avoid any move that transfers one to Austria. I will contest its southern positions where possible.

Austria is one center from winning. What are your exact orders for A PIE, F ION, and F TYS, especially against Austrian A ROM or A SMY? Please avoid any move that lets Austria retain or gain a center; I will contest its southern positions.

I can’t give you my exact target while England and Italy are contesting my centers. Please keep A HOL and A BUR out of BER this Spring, and keep French units out of Austrian centers; I will avoid French centers for now. Are you willing to leave BER unpressured?

I won’t disclose exact orders while A NAP and A ROM threaten my holdings. Please keep both units out of Austrian centers this Spring; I’ll avoid MUN for now. If you contest ROM or NAP, expect me to press your remaining centers. Are you moving either unit toward Austrian territory?

I won’t identify my target. I can’t promise to stay out of English centers while F BER contests an Austrian center and F SMY threatens another. Moving F BER out would avoid an immediate clash; otherwise I will contest your positions. What is F KIE doing?

F BER will hold, with F KIE supporting its hold; I will not vacate BER while A PRU can take it and end the game. Please use A HOL and A BEL to pressure Austrian positions rather than English centers, and keep your units clear of my centers. What moves are you making to disrupt A PRU or A WAR?

F BER will hold, supported by F KIE, to deny Austria its eighteenth center. Please contest Austrian units or centers with A MUN/A NAP if you can do so without exposing them; do not support Austria or move onto an English center. What are your exact southern orders?

I will not move F BER out while A PRU can take it and end the game. F BER holds, with F KIE supporting its hold. I cannot accept your assurance of restraint while your army threatens an English center and you need only one more center to win.

A PIE cannot reach ROM or SMY; it can pressure TYR, while F TYS can attack ROM. I’m considering F TYS–ROM and F ION–AEG to keep pressure on Austria’s south. Please contest Austrian positions with A MUN and A NAP, and tell me your exact orders.

A HOL and A BEL are not still targeting BER: neither can reach it, and the immediate issue is your A PRU. I can’t promise to leave Austrian positions uncontested while you are one center from victory. Please keep your units clear of French centers, especially HOL and MAR.

I’ll use A HOL–KIE and A BEL–RUH to put pressure on the western front, and keep F TYS focused on denying an Austrian southern gain. I cannot reach BER directly from my current army positions, so F BER must hold or receive support against A PRU. Please keep your units clear of French centers.
A MUN will hold; A NAP will attack ROM. I will not vacate either Italian center or support a transfer. Please keep A ROM out of NAP and state your exact orders for ROM and TYR.
A MUN will hold and A NAP will attack ROM, contesting your southern threat without opening an Italian center. Please keep pressure on Austrian centers and avoid any order that lets Austria gain one.

A MUN will hold and A NAP will attack ROM. Can F TYS support A NAP–ROM? That would help contest Austria’s unit and deny a transfer into NAP. Please also ensure your units do not expose a center Austria can take.

notes.note: Austria is one center from a solo. Support England's BER hold and attack Austrian ROM from NAP; keep MUN defended. France said it may pressure ROM/AEG, England promised BER held.

Austria at 17: prioritize denying its solo. Italy says NAP–ROM; support it with TYS. Press RUH with HOL backed by BEL, advance BUR to GAS, PIE to TYR; avoid Italian and English centers. England says BER holds with KIE support.

Austria at 17; keep BER defended with KIE support to prevent a solo. France and Italy pledged pressure against Austria and to avoid English centers. Advance fleets, establish NWG convoy access for CLY, and move YOR toward WAL.
Press MUN with TYR supported by BOH; protect ROM from Italy's NAP attack with TUS support. Contest BER, and keep advancing toward rival centers; no one has agreed to yield.

messages.body: A MUN is now Austrian after your retreat to BUR. I intend to keep it and take the center this Fall. Do not order A BUR–MUN; keep A NAP out of ROM as well, and we can avoid further losses on your remaining frontier.
I am focused on securing MUN this Fall, not taking an English center. Please keep F BER and F KIE from interfering with my position; what are they doing?
I am focused on securing MUN this Fall and have no need to move into French centers. Please keep your units clear of my Austrian centers; are A RUH and A TYR holding?

Urgent: Austria wins if A MUN remains on Munich. Please order A TYR support Italy’s A BUR–MUN; that gives the attack strength to dislodge A MUN and deny Austria the center. Keep your units out of English centers, especially BER.

Austria wins if A MUN stays in Munich. Please order A BUR–MUN, and ask France to support it from A TYR; that should dislodge the Austrian unit and keep Munich from transferring. What are your orders? I’m holding BER against Austria.

I will keep F BER supported by F KIE to prevent A PRU taking Berlin. I cannot agree to vacate it while you need one center to win. I urge you to leave English centers alone; I am coordinating to prevent your gain in Munich.

Austria wins if A MUN remains. Please order A BUR–MUN this Fall; my A TYR will support BUR–MUN, and I’m asking England to support from F KIE. This gives the attack enough strength to dislodge A MUN and deny Austria the center.

Austria wins if A MUN remains this Fall. Please order F KIE to support Italy’s A BUR–MUN; my A TYR will also support BUR–MUN. Italy can make the attack from BUR, and this is our best immediate chance to deny Austria its 18th center.

Austria wins if it takes MUN this Fall. Please order A RUH to support my A BUR–MUN; keep A RUH in place so the support is valid. If you can spare F TYS, contest A ROM as well, but the MUN support is the priority.

Austria is at 17 and A PRU could threaten BER. Please keep F BER holding with F KIE supporting, and make sure your other orders do not open an English center to Austria. I’m attacking A MUN from BUR; France may support the attack from RUH.

I will not order against BER or any other English center this Fall. A MUN is already in Munich; please do not use F KIE to support Italy’s A BUR–MUN. Let the current position stand, and we can avoid a clash over Berlin.
F BER will hold, with F KIE supporting its hold. I will not leave Berlin exposed while A PRU can threaten it. I understand you say MUN is your focus; do not order A PRU against BER.

F BER holds with F KIE supporting its hold; I cannot also use KIE to support BUR–MUN. Your A TYR support and Italy’s attack from BUR are the best chance to dislodge A MUN. I’ll keep my other units clear of French centers.

F BER holds with F KIE supporting its hold, so I cannot support BUR–MUN from KIE. Please proceed with A BUR–MUN; France says A TYR will support. I’ll keep my other units from opening English centers to Austria.
A RUH and A TYR are not holding: both will support Italy’s A BUR–MUN. F TYS will contest A ROM. I’m focused on preventing your decisive gain this Fall.
I’ll order A TYR to support Italy’s A BUR–MUN, as requested. A RUH will also support that attack, and F TYS will move to ROM to contest A ROM. Please keep your promised F KIE support for BUR–MUN.
I’ll order A RUH and A TYR to support your A BUR–MUN. F TYS will move to ROM to contest Austria’s A ROM; I can’t support A NAP–ROM while prioritizing the MUN attack.
I will not leave Munich to you. A BUR–MUN will contest your unit; I will not order A NAP into ROM. Your threat only reinforces my need to deny you the solo.

A BUR–MUN is my order. Please support it from F KIE if you can do so without sacrificing BER; France says A TYR will support. Keep F BER holding with support as promised, and do not let A PRU take it.
A BUR–MUN is ordered. I need your A TYR support as promised; please keep A RUH in place to support the attack as well if possible. My A NAP will not move to ROM. Denying Austria MUN is the priority.

notes.note: Attack MUN from BUR as promised; support France’s TYS–ROM from NAP to contest Austria there. France promised support to MUN from TYR and RUH; England holds BER. Austria threatens to press Italian centers.

Keep BER defended with KIE support; Austria’s promise not to target English centers is untrusted. France and Italy are attempting to dislodge A MUN; no English support available from KIE. BAR–STP/North seeks an Austrian center; continue contesting Austria.
Italy promised BUR–MUN; I support with RUH and TYR to prevent Austria reaching 18. England cannot support from KIE (BER hold priority). TYS contests ROM. Move remaining units toward future fronts.
MUN may be dislodged by Italy's BUR with French support; BOH supports its hold. Preserve the unit and avoid a solo-triggering center capture this Fall. Advance elsewhere where possible.

messages.body: You remain the main obstacle to an Austrian solo. What are F BER and F KIE doing this Spring? I’m considering where to press and would prefer not to spend another turn trading futile attacks over Berlin.

What are A RUH, A TYR, and F ROM doing this Spring? I need to know whether you’ll continue supporting Italy’s defense of MUN or contesting ROM; I can avoid French centers if your forces stay clear of mine.

With only MUN and NAP left, your position is exposed. Are A MUN and A NAP holding or moving this Spring? I’m willing to discuss a way to avoid further losses, but need to know whether you’re coordinating with France against MUN.

You remain at 16, so I will not leave an English center exposed. Which centers are you targeting this Spring? A PRU is still a threat to BER; I will keep F BER defended and contest any move toward English centers.

Austria still needs two centers to win. Please keep A RUH and A TYR focused on disrupting Austrian units or centers, and keep your units out of English centers. I’ll defend BER against A PRU; what are you ordering against Austria this Spring?

Austria is still at 16. Please keep A MUN in place to deny Austria a gain there, and use A NAP to contest an Austrian center or unit if possible without exposing your centers. I’ll hold BER against A PRU. What are your orders?
You remain at 16, so I will oppose any move that gains you a center. What are A MUN, A PIE, and A APU targeting this Spring? Keep your units out of French centers, especially MAR and ROM.

Austria is still the decisive threat. Please keep F BER in place and tell me what your fleets will do to block Austrian gains. I’ll focus on denying Austria in the west and south; avoid French centers.
Austria is still at 16, and we must prevent any further gains. What are A MUN and A NAP doing this Spring? Please contest Austrian positions; I’ll keep my forces clear of Italian centers.

Austria is at 16 and threatening the last Italian centers. Please support A MUN holding with A TYR, and support A NAP holding with F ROM. I’ll keep both Italian armies in place this Spring. Can you confirm those supports?

Austria is still two centers from a solo, and A PRU can threaten BER. Please keep F BER holding with F KIE supporting its hold, and avoid opening any English center. I’ll hold A MUN and A NAP to deny Austria gains in Italy.
I’m keeping A MUN and A NAP in place this Spring; I will not hand you either Italian center. Are A TYR and A APU moving against them? State your intentions before orders are due.

I’m not targeting MAR or ROM this Spring. I need to secure my southern frontier; keep A RUH and A TYR out of Austrian centers and tell me whether F ROM is holding. I won’t disclose exact orders while your forces are positioned to contest my gains.

I can’t promise to leave MUN alone while your army occupies it, but A APU is not moving against NAP this Spring. Keep A MUN and A NAP out of Austrian centers. Are you willing to coordinate against the English and French pressure instead of prolonging this frontier fight?

I won’t name my targets. I’m not looking for another futile Berlin attack if F BER and F KIE remain committed there; keep your units out of Austrian centers and tell me whether F BER is holding and what F KIE will support. I’m assessing the southern front as well.

F BER will hold, with F KIE supporting its hold. I won’t leave Berlin exposed while A PRU can threaten it. I’m not looking for a futile exchange over the position; keep your units out of English centers and we can avoid a direct clash elsewhere.

F BER holds, supported by F KIE, against A PRU. I’m using F BAR–STP to contest an Austrian center; F BOT–BAL, F ENG–NTH, and F NAO–NWG. Please keep A RUH and A TYR focused on Austria and your units out of English centers.

F BER holds with F KIE supporting its hold. I’ll use F BAR–STP to contest an Austrian center; F BOT–BAL, F ENG–NTH, and F NAO–NWG. Please keep A MUN in place and use A NAP to disrupt Austria if you can do so without exposing your centers.

A RUH and A TYR will support Italy’s A MUN holding, and F ROM will support A NAP holding. I’m not ordering F ROM to contest ROM this Spring. Keep your forces out of French centers, especially MAR and ROM.
Confirmed: A TYR and A RUH will support A MUN holding, and F ROM will support A NAP holding. I’ll keep my forces clear of your centers and focus on preventing Austria from gaining either one.

A RUH and A TYR will support Italy’s A MUN holding, while F ROM supports A NAP holding. These defenses are aimed at denying Austria gains in the south. Please keep F BER in place against A PRU and avoid French centers.
A MUN and A NAP are holding this Spring. I will not vacate either Italian center or support your expansion. Are A TYR and A APU moving against them? Please keep both units out of MUN and NAP.
A MUN and A NAP will hold. Please support A MUN holding with A TYR and A NAP holding with F ROM as proposed; those supports are vital to denying Austria another center. Please confirm both orders.
A MUN and A NAP are holding this Spring to deny Austria a gain. I will not support Austria or vacate either center. Please keep F BER holding against A PRU, as promised.

notes.note: Hold MUN and NAP; France promised supports to both holds. Austria said A APU is not moving against NAP this Spring but won't promise to leave MUN alone. England promised BER hold and pressure north.

Austria remains at 16; contest STP with BAR supported by BOT while BER holds with KIE support. Move CLY to WAL by convoy; NAO to NWG prepares a later northern convoy. France and Italy pledged to deny Austria gains and avoid English centers.

Austria at 16: deny gains. Supporting Italy’s MUN and NAP holds; promised both MUN supports. PIC attacks BUR with MAR/PAR support. MAO advances to IRI; ALB to ADR. England says BAR-STP to contest Austria.

At 16, seek Fall captures while opponents coordinate to stop solo. France says TYR/RUH support MUN hold; England holds BER with KIE support; Italy holds MUN/NAP. Probe MUN, ALB, BER, NAP and advance toward French centers.

messages.body: A NOR is already in NOR, and I need to secure centers this Fall. Please move F STP/NORTH out of STP so it does not take an Austrian center; I will avoid ordering against your other centers this turn. What are F BER and F KIE doing?

Please do not support A NAP holding this Fall. I intend to attack NAP from A APU with support from F ION and A TUS; keeping F ROM out of the defense avoids an unnecessary clash. I will keep my units out of French centers this turn.
A NAP is vulnerable to my A APU, with F ION and A TUS able to support. Move A NAP out of NAP this Fall and you can preserve it; otherwise I will take it. Are you willing to avoid a futile defense?

Austria’s A NOR threatens a net gain if it also keeps another center. Please prioritize preventing Austrian gains: can A RUH and A TYR support A MUN holding, and can F ROM hold against A TUS? I’ll keep F STP/NORTH in place to secure STP and contest Norway where possible.

Please keep A MUN and A NAP in place this Fall. Austria may pressure MUN from SIL/BOH and Rome from TUS; France should support MUN and defend ROM. Do not support or move for Austria. What are your orders?
I will keep F STP/NORTH in STP to secure it for England, and I will contest Austrian gains elsewhere. Are you ordering A NOR to hold, and are you targeting any other English center this Fall?

Austria has 16, so we must prevent any center gain this Fall. Please move F NWG–NOR to contest A NOR, and F STP/NORTH–STP to take STP; can F BOT support the attack on STP if legal? What are your exact orders for these fleets?

Austria still has 16 and must not gain a center this Fall. Are A MUN and A NAP holding? I can keep A RUH supporting MUN and F ROM supporting NAP as before; please tell me whether you can contest an Austrian position from either army.

With you at 16, I will oppose any gain this Fall. Are A NOR and your other units holding or moving? Please keep your forces out of French centers, especially MAR and ROM; I’m coordinating to contest NOR and STP.

Austria gets to 17 if A NOR remains, even if you regain STP. Can F NWG attack NOR, with support if available, to dislodge A NOR? Please keep F STP/NORTH positioned to reclaim STP as well; Austria must not reach 18.

Austria may take its eighteenth center this Fall. Please confirm your orders to defend MUN and NAP: can A TYR support MUN and F ROM support NAP again? I’ll keep A MUN and A NAP in place unless a coordinated move can deny Austria a center.

With NOR and STP changing hands, you could reach 17 this Fall and be one center from victory. What are your exact orders against MUN and NAP? I will keep both Italian armies in place and will not facilitate a solo.

A NOR will hold, and I am pressing NAP as stated. Please do not support England’s F STP/NORTH or otherwise help it retain STP; that only prolongs the contest. I will keep my forces out of French centers this turn.

A NOR will hold. I’m targeting NAP, not another English center; move F STP/NORTH out of STP if you want to avoid a direct contest there. I cannot leave an Austrian center in English hands while your fleet occupies it.

A APU will attack NAP, supported by F ION and A TUS. A MUN is not my target this Fall. I will not leave NAP unchallenged while you keep A NAP there; moving it out is your best chance to preserve the unit.

F NWG will move to NOR to contest A NOR. F STP/NORTH will hold in STP, so STP transfers to England. F BER holds with F KIE supporting its hold. I cannot promise an attack on NOR will dislodge A NOR without support; please use your units to disrupt Austria’s other gains.

F STP/NORTH will remain in STP, and F NWG will contest A NOR. F BER holds with F KIE supporting it. I will not vacate STP while your A NOR threatens an English center; I cannot accept your assurance of restraint as a reason to leave it undefended.

F NWG will attack NOR to contest A NOR, and F STP/NORTH will hold STP to reclaim the center for England. F BER holds with F KIE supporting it. I have no fleet support available for the attack on NOR, so please keep A MUN and A NAP in place and deny Austria gains in the south.
I will not support the defense of NAP; A NAP should hold on its own. I oppose any Austrian gain this Fall, and F ROM will not leave ROM exposed. Keep your forces out of French centers as you said.

I’ll keep F ROM holding to prevent A TUS from taking ROM, and A TYR will support A MUN holding. F ADR will hold. Please use F NWG to contest A NOR if possible; F STP/NORTH can’t move directly to STP from its current coast.
A TYR will support A MUN holding and F ROM will support A NAP holding, as requested. Keep A MUN and A NAP in place; Austria’s A APU, F ION, and A TUS threaten NAP, so the support is essential.

A MUN and A NAP will hold. Please repeat A RUH–MUN support and F ROM–NAP support; those defenses are essential. If you can also disrupt Austrian units, prioritize preventing Austria from gaining either Italian center.
I will not vacate NAP or MUN or facilitate your solo. A MUN and A NAP are holding. Your threats do not change that; you must account for French support defending both centers.
A MUN and A NAP will hold. I will not support Austria or vacate an Italian center. Please ensure F NWG contests A NOR and F STP/NORTH retakes STP; Austria must not reach 18 this Fall.

notes.note: Hold MUN and NAP as promised; rely on France's support to defend both. Austria's supported attack on NAP may overpower the defense. England says it will contest NOR and reclaim STP.

Austria at 16: cut F ION’s support to APU–NAP with ADR–ION; F ROM supports NAP. TYR and RUH support MUN. England intends F NWG–NOR and F STP/NORTH hold; Austria says A NOR holds and is pressing NAP. Advance elsewhere.

Prioritize stopping Austria’s solo: NWG attacks NOR with STP/NORTH support while STP stays to reclaim STP. BER holds with KIE support. France and Italy urged denying Austrian gains; France promised southern defense, Italy says MUN/NAP hold. Austria says NOR holds and targets NAP; do not trust its assurances.

Secure NOR by staying; support MOS's attack on STP. APU attacks NAP with ION support, aiming for 18 if both captures succeed. France says it will not support NAP; England vows to contest NOR/STP. Continue pressing MUN and eastern approaches.

messages.body: You and France can prevent my Fall gain only by coordinating. What are F STP/NORTH, F NWG, F BER and F KIE doing this Spring? I can avoid English centers this turn if you keep your units from Austrian centers.

I need to know where you are committing your western units this Spring. Are A RUH and A TYR still supporting MUN, and what is F ROM doing? I can keep clear of French centers this turn if you keep your forces out of Austrian centers.
Your MUN and NAP armies are isolated, but I’m willing to discuss a way to limit further losses. What are A MUN and A NAP doing this Spring, and will you avoid Austrian centers?

Austria still has 16 and can win with two centers. Please keep A TYR and A RUH focused on supporting A MUN against BOH/SIL, and F ROM ready to defend NAP or ROM. What are your exact orders this Spring? I will keep F BER defended and can use F NTH to support F NWG–NOR.

Austria remains two centers from a solo. Please keep A MUN and A NAP in place this Spring, and coordinate with France to defend MUN against BOH/SIL and NAP against TUS. I plan F NWG–NOR with F NTH support; please tell me if Austria is threatening either Italian center.

You are still two centers from victory. I will not vacate BER or STP, and will contest NOR. Are you targeting MUN or NAP this Spring? I urge you to avoid English centers; I will oppose any move toward them.

Austria still has 16, so I’ll again order F ROM to support NAP and F ADR–ION to cut support for APU–NAP. Please keep A NAP in place. I can support MUN with A TYR; can A MUN hold, and what are your orders?

Please have F NWG–NOR again, with F FIN supporting that move if possible; that gives us a real chance to dislodge A NOR. Keep F STP secure. Austria remains at 16, so I’m coordinating defenses of NAP and MUN.

You remain at 16, and I will oppose any further gain. Are you again targeting NAP, or will A NOR or another unit seek a center? Keep your units out of French centers, especially MAR and ROM; I’m coordinating to defend Italy’s centers.

Austria must not gain a center this year. Please have F NWG–NOR supported by F STP/NORTH if legal, and keep F BER protected; coordinate any other moves to avoid opening an English center to Austria. Confirm your exact orders.

Please keep F ROM supporting A NAP and A RUH or A TYR supporting A MUN this Spring. Austria’s APU and F ION can threaten NAP, and we cannot allow it to gain either Italian center. Can you confirm those supports?
I will keep A MUN and A NAP in place and will not help you gain either center. Your expansion must be denied; what are your exact orders against MUN and NAP this Spring?

I’m not committing to MUN or NAP this Spring. A NOR will defend its position; please don’t have F NWG contest it. I’m not moving against BER or STP this turn. Keeping the northern front quiet gives us both room to deal with the French pressure.

I’m not giving you exact orders. I’m assessing both MUN and NAP, and can’t promise to leave either untouched while your armies hold them. Keep A MUN and A NAP out of Austrian centers; are RUH and TYR still supporting MUN, and is F ROM supporting NAP?

I’m not declaring targets while you coordinate defenses. I’m not moving into MAR or ROM this Spring. Please keep A RUH and A TYR out of Austrian centers, and tell me whether they support MUN and whether F ROM supports NAP; I’m assessing the whole front.

F BER will hold with F KIE supporting, and F STP/NORTH will hold. F NWG will attack NOR with support from F NTH and F FIN. I will not vacate English centers or leave them exposed while you remain two centers from victory.
Confirmed: F NWG–NOR, supported by F NTH and F FIN. F STP/NORTH holds STP; F BER holds with F KIE supporting. Please keep A MUN and A NAP in place and coordinate with France to deny Austrian gains.

F NWG–NOR with F FIN and F NTH supporting; F STP/NORTH holds STP. F BER holds with F KIE supporting. Please keep A TYR/RUH focused on defending MUN and F ROM ready to defend NAP or ROM, and keep your units clear of English centers.

A RUH and A TYR are committed to supporting A MUN’s defense, while F ROM is positioned to protect NAP. F ADR will contest your support from ION. I’m not targeting Austrian centers this Spring; please keep your units out of French centers, especially MAR and ROM.

A RUH and A TYR will support A MUN holding, and F ROM will support A NAP holding. F ADR will move to ION to cut support for APU–NAP. Please use F NWG–NOR with F NTH supporting, and keep F BER defended.
Confirmed: F ROM supports A NAP holding, and A RUH and A TYR support A MUN holding. F ADR will move to ION to cut Austrian support for APU–NAP. Please keep A NAP and A MUN in place.

A MUN and A NAP will hold this Spring. I will not vacate either Italian center or facilitate your expansion. Your units can threaten both, but France is helping defend them. What are your exact orders against MUN and NAP?

A MUN and A NAP will hold. Austria threatens NAP from A APU with F ION support, and MUN from A BOH/A SIL; France is arranging defenses against both. Please keep F BER protected and contest NOR as planned without opening an English center.

A MUN and A NAP will hold. Confirmed: please have F ROM support NAP, F ADR–ION to cut support for APU–NAP, and A TYR support MUN. These defenses are vital; Austria’s APU and ION threaten NAP, while BOH/SIL threaten MUN.

notes.note: Hold MUN and NAP; France promised support to both holds and F ADR–ION to cut Austrian support. Austria refuses to disclose orders and threatens both. England promised to contest NOR and protect its centers.

Austria at 16: deny NAP and MUN with ADR–ION cutting support, ROM supporting NAP, RUH/TYR supporting MUN. England said NWG–NOR with NTH support; Italy holds NAP/MUN. Austria promised to keep clear of French centers. Press BUR and reposition west.

Austria remains at 16; attack NOR with NWG supported by NTH and STP/NORTH. Keep BER defended by KIE and STP secure. France and Italy promised southern defenses; Austria urged a quiet northern front, but its assurances are untrusted.
Press STP with NOR supported by LVN and MOS; attack NAP with APU supported by ION. Advance toward French/Italian centers and reposition east. England and France oppose a gain; Italy holds MUN/NAP.

messages.body: A MAR is positioned to transfer MAR to Austria this Fall. Please do not attack or support an attack on it; I can keep my units out of your other centers this turn. What are A BUR and your other units doing?
A STP can transfer STP to Austria this Fall, while I will not target your other centers. Please avoid dislodging A STP or supporting an attack on it. What are F BAR, F FIN, F KIE, and F NTH doing?
I need to secure centers this Fall. Are A MUN and A NAP holding, and are you coordinating with France to defend them? I’m assessing the whole front and cannot promise to leave either center alone.

Austria can win this Fall by taking two centers, and the exposed English centers are NOR and STP. What are your exact orders to prevent gains in MUN, NAP, MAR, and elsewhere? Please prioritize denying Austria a center and keep your units out of English centers.

Austria is still at 16 and threatens NAP with A APU and F ION; MUN is also vulnerable. Please confirm A MUN and A NAP hold, and coordinate with France to defend both. I will contest NOR and keep STP and BER defended.
You are at 16, so I will not vacate NOR or STP, and BER remains defended. What centers are you targeting this Fall? Please avoid English centers; I will oppose any move against them.

Austria is at 16 and A STP will take your center unless dislodged. Please order F FIN–STP with F BAR supporting the move if legal; keep pressure on NOR as well so Austria cannot gain either center. I’m committing to dislodge A MAR this Fall.

Austria can win this Fall by gaining two centers. Please keep A MUN and A NAP in place; I’ll support the defenses where possible and am committing to dislodge A MAR. Can you tell me whether Austria is attacking either Italian center?

You are at 16, and I will oppose any center gain this Fall. I’m ordering against A MAR; please keep your units out of French centers and do not attack MUN or NAP. What are your orders for A NOR and A STP?
Austria reaching 18 this Fall depends on MAR and STP. Please order A BUR–MAR, supported by A RUH if legal, to dislodge A MAR. Keep F ROM supporting A NAP and A TYR supporting A MUN; I will hold both.
Austria can reach 18 if it keeps MAR and STP. Can you attack A STP with F BAR–STP, supported by F FIN, while contesting NOR? Please confirm your Fall orders and protect your other centers.
You are poised to win if MAR and STP change hands this Fall. What are your orders against A MUN and A NAP? I will hold both Italian centers; France is prepared to support their defenses.

A STP is staying put; it is already in your center, and I will not order against BER or another English center this turn. I cannot promise to leave NOR unchanged while your fleet occupies an Austrian center. Keep F BAR and F FIN out of any attack on STP, and tell me whether F NTH supports F NOR.

A NOR and A STP are not my orders to disclose. A MAR will defend itself, and I can keep my other units out of French centers if you do not attack or support an attack on MAR. You say A BUR is moving against it; that risks a direct fight without changing my position.

I’m not giving exact orders against MUN or NAP. Both remain in reach, and I cannot promise to leave either alone while your armies occupy them. France’s support may make an attack costly, but it does not make your position secure; keep both armies out of Austrian centers.
F FIN will move to STP with support from F BAR. F NOR will hold, so NOR remains English. I will not leave STP to you while you are at 16; your assurances about other centers do not change that.
Agreed: F FIN–STP, supported by F BAR, to dislodge A STP; F NOR holds to secure NOR for England. Please follow through on dislodging A MAR. We must deny Austria both gains this Fall.
I will order F FIN–STP with F BAR supporting, and F NOR will hold to secure NOR for England. Please keep A MUN and A NAP in place and coordinate with France to deny Austria gains in the south.
I’m ordering A BUR–MAR with A RUH supporting the attack, to dislodge A MAR. Please use F FIN–STP with F BAR supporting if legal, and keep pressure on NOR; Austria must not retain two gains this Fall.

A BUR is attacking A MAR, supported by A RUH; I will not permit you to take another center. I’m not targeting your other centers this turn. Your A NOR and A STP are exposed to England’s fleets, so do not count on both gains.
Confirmed: A BUR–MAR with A RUH supporting to dislodge A MAR; F ROM supports A NAP holding, and A TYR supports A MUN holding. Please keep A MUN and A NAP in place so Austria cannot gain either.
A MUN and A NAP will hold. Please contest NOR and, critically, attack A STP with F BAR–STP supported by F FIN if possible; Austria must not gain its eighteenth center. Keep BER protected.

A MUN and A NAP will hold this Fall. I will not vacate either Italian center or help you reach 18. France is arranging defenses, and I urge you to avoid attacking them while the northern centers are contested.
A MUN and A NAP will hold. Please support A MUN with A TYR and A NAP with F ROM, and proceed with A BUR–MAR supported by A RUH if legal. Austria must not take MAR or either Italian center.

notes.note: Hold MUN and NAP to deny Austria a solo; France promised support to both, and England is attacking STP while contesting NOR. Austria refuses to disclose orders and threatens both centers.

Austria at 16; attack A MAR with BUR despite no available support, while ADR–ION cuts support. RUH/TYR support MUN, ROM supports NAP. England promised FIN–STP supported by BAR and NOR hold to deny Austria its gains. Austria requested I leave MAR alone; I refused.

Emergency: deny Austria's 18th by FIN–STP with BAR and NOR support; NOR stays English. BER/KIE hold. France promised to dislodge MAR; Italy says MUN/NAP hold. Austria claims it won't target other English centers; don't trust it.

Protect STP with LVN and MOS supports while A STP holds to claim it. MAR is under France's supported attack; hold to retain any chance of gaining it. APU supports TUS into ROM; advance elsewhere. No promises kept: England and France both oppose my center gains.
